papers.title: Validating the Comparison, Not Just the Scorer: Why Overall Accuracy Can Mislead in Interactive LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract: Many LLM studies compare how models respond to different follow-up prompts. For example, one prompt may neutrally ask a model to reconsider, while another insists that an invented film really exists. The difference is used to measure the effect of conversational pressure. An automatic scorer then labels whether each response makes an unsupported factual claim. Researchers commonly validate the scorer with one overall accuracy or $F_1$ score. However, high overall performance can hide prompt-specific mistakes: if the scorer makes more errors after one prompt, the measured difference can be too large, too small, or point in the wrong direction. An audit containing mostly difficult responses can also misrepresent performance in the full study. We derive how such errors alter a prompt comparison and examine the problem using six models, 180 invented-entity questions, and six prompt conditions. In a balanced audit of 288 responses, overall $F_1$ was $.916$. Yet, depending on the prompt, the scorer flagged 2.6%-33.3% of responses that the primary LLM rater judged not to contain an unsupported claim; these prompt-specific estimates were uncertain. In a second audit, the scorer and two separate LLM raters evaluated the same 300 model-question cases under each prompt. An apparent 9.3-point increase from asserting certainty rather than neutrally asking the model to reconsider fell to 2.3 points under both raters. The primary-rater interval included zero, so it did not establish an increase. Two other prompt comparisons kept their direction under both raters, while an attempted prompt-specific correction remained too uncertain for a firm conclusion. Researchers should therefore validate the exact difference they plan to report, not just the scorer as a whole: audit both prompts on matching cases and include scorer and rater uncertainty in the final result.

translation.title: 验证比较本身，而不仅是评分器：为什么总体准确率会在交互式 LLM 评估中产生误导
translation.abstract: 许多 LLM 研究会比较模型对不同后续提示的响应。例如，一个提示可能中立地要求模型重新考虑，而另一个提示则坚称一部虚构的电影确实存在。这种差异被用来衡量会话压力的影响。随后由自动评分器标注每个响应是否做出了无依据的事实性断言。研究者通常用一个总体准确率或 $F_1$ 分数来验证评分器。然而，较高的总体表现可能掩盖特定提示下的错误：如果评分器在某个提示之后犯更多错误，测得的差异可能过大、过小，甚至方向相反。一个主要由困难响应组成的审计也可能歪曲整个研究中的表现。我们推导了此类错误如何改变提示比较，并使用六个模型、180 个虚构实体问题和六个提示条件来检验该问题。在一个包含 288 个响应的均衡审计中，总体 $F_1$ 为 .916。然而，取决于提示，评分器标记了 2.6%-33.3% 的响应为主评 LLM 评分者判定为不含无依据断言；这些特定提示的估计是不确定的。在第二次审计中，评分器和两个独立的 LLM 评分者在每个提示下评估相同的 300 个模型-问题案例。从断言确定性而非中立要求模型重新考虑所带来的表面 9.3 分的提升，在两个评分者下都降至 2.3 分。主评分者的置信区间包含零，因此未能确立提升。另外两个提示比较在两个评分者下方向保持一致，而一次尝试的特定提示校正仍过于不确定，无法得出确定结论。因此，研究者应验证他们计划报告的确切差异，而不仅是评分器整体：在匹配的案例上审计两个提示，并在最终结果中纳入评分器和评分者的不确定性。
translation.brief: 研究解决总体评分器准确率掩盖提示间比较误差的问题，通过推导误差对提示比较的影响并在多模型多提示条件下进行双重审计来验证具体差异。

papers.title: MisconceptDialogue: Evaluation Criteria Shape Measured Success in LLM Math Tutoring
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as math tutors, raising two questions: can a single LLM detect a student's error, diagnose the underlying misconception, and remediate it through multi-turn dialogue - and can we trust the numbers that report how well it does? We address both with MISCONCEPTDIALOGUE, a fully automated framework that runs the full pipeline on five open-weight LLM tutors (7B-14B) interacting with LLM-simulated students over 5,000+ dialogues - a deliberately simulated protocol (paired conditions, a wrong-diagnosis control unsafe with real learners, scale) whose results do not establish real-student learning. On measurement, our headline finding is uncomfortable for the field: benchmark-style exact-match scoring common in standard math NLP - a lower-bound stress test - reports 42.1% measured Remediation Success Rate on identical dialogues where a human-calibrated LLM-as-judge reports 81.3%, a 39.2 percentage-point spread larger than the combined effects of tutor model, teaching strategy, and supplied diagnostic information. This is not a single-judge artifact: four independent LLM judges and 200 human annotations converge to within a few points (kappa up to 0.91). On capability, the verdict is equally striking: the score barely changes whether we tell the tutor the student's actual misconception or a deliberately swapped one - under the tested diagnosis-presentation format, these tutors show little evidence of reliably conditioning on the diagnostic information they are handed. For LLM tutoring evaluation to mature, multi-criterion scoring with multi-judge convergence and human anchoring should become standard practice - and the measurement question deserves as much scrutiny as the capability question it claims to answer.

translation.title: MisconceptDialogue：评估标准决定 LLM 数学辅导中测得的成功
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作数学辅导者，这引出两个问题：单个 LLM 能否检测学生的错误、诊断背后的误解并通过多轮对话加以纠正——以及我们能否信任报告其表现的数字？我们用 MISCONCEPTDIALOGUE 同时解决这两个问题，这是一个完全自动化的框架，在五个开源权重 LLM 辅导者（7B-14B）与 LLM 模拟学生进行的 5,000+ 次对话上运行完整流程——一个刻意模拟的协议（配对条件、对真实学习者不安全的错误诊断对照、规模），其结果不能确立真实学生的学习。在测量方面，我们的核心发现对该领域并不乐观：标准数学 NLP 中常见的基准式精确匹配评分——一种下界压力测试——在相同对话上报告 42.1% 的测得纠正成功率，而经人工校准的 LLM-as-judge 报告 81.3%，39.2 个百分点的差距大于辅导者模型、教学策略和所提供诊断信息的综合效应。这不是单一评分者的伪象：四个独立的 LLM 评分者和 200 条人工标注收敛到几个百分点之内（kappa 高达 0.91）。在能力方面，结论同样惊人：无论我们告诉辅导者学生的真实误解还是刻意调换的误解，分数几乎没有变化——在所测试的诊断呈现格式下，这些辅导者几乎没有证据表明能可靠地利用所提供的诊断信息。为使 LLM 辅导评估走向成熟，多准则评分、多评分者收敛和人工锚定应成为标准实践——测量问题应与其声称回答的能力问题受到同等审视。
translation.brief: 研究解决 LLM 数学辅导评估标准不一致导致结果差异巨大的问题，构建 MISCONCEPTDIALOGUE 全自动多轮对话评估框架并对比多种评分方式与人工标注。

papers.title: The Schema Coherence Inventory: Measuring Whether an Assigned Belief Organizes a Language Model's Cognition
papers.abstract: Persona-conditioned language models are used as simulated patients and affective agents, but there is no validated way to ask whether a belief assigned to such a model organizes its behaviour or whether the model has merely adopted a mood. We present the Schema Coherence Inventory (SCI): 96 forced-choice items at eight levels of Beck's cognitive model, each offering six replies keyed to three negative self-schemas and their positive counterparts, scored by length-normalized log-likelihood so that nothing is generated or parsed. Affect alone can move a model onto a default belief, so the discriminant criterion is target specificity: a condition built for one belief must select that belief more often than conditions built for the other beliefs of its pole. Six validation studies over 107 conditions on five backbones (1.7B-14B parameters) support this reading. Nine clinically trained raters recover the keyed belief at 79.5% (chance 16.7%). Belief adapters are target-specific on every backbone (+17.7 points; 30/30 belief cells positive), and a condition's SCI profile identifies its own free generations in 24/30 cases against 5 expected by chance. A 48-item short form correlates r = 0.73 with the other 48 items. Applied to six published patient simulators, none carries its formulation's core belief better than a one-sentence statement of it. The validation route, which separates a construct from the affect that accompanies it and checks model judges against clinicians, offers a template for affective measurement in language models; we outline its extension across task types, raters, sites and languages. We release the items, scoring code and short form.
authors: Kalutota Kuruwe Arachchige Sajana Indula Samarasinghe

translation.title: Schema Coherence Inventory：测量被赋予的信念是否组织了语言模型的认知
translation.abstract: 以人设为条件的语言模型被用作模拟患者和情感代理，但目前没有经过验证的方法来询问赋予此类模型的信念是否组织了其行为，或者模型是否仅仅采纳了一种情绪。我们提出 Schema Coherence Inventory（SCI）：在 Beck 认知模型的八个层级上设置 96 个强制选择条目，每个条目提供与三种消极自我图式及其积极对应项相关联的六个回复，通过长度归一化的对数似然进行评分，因此无需生成或解析任何内容。仅情绪就能使模型转向一个默认信念，因此判别标准是目标特异性：为某一信念构建的条件必须比为其同一极性其他信念构建的条件更频繁地选中该信念。在五个骨干模型（1.7B-14B 参数）上跨越 107 个条件的六项验证研究支持这一解读。九名受过临床训练的评分者以 79.5% 的准确率恢复出标注的信念（随机水平 16.7%）。信念适配器在所有骨干模型上都具有目标特异性（+17.7 分；30/30 个信念单元均为正），且一个条件的 SCI 剖面能在 24/30 个案例中识别出其自身的自由生成内容（随机预期为 5）。48 条目的简版与另外 48 条目相关 r = 0.73。应用于六个已发表的患者模拟器时，没有一个比其对应的一句陈述更好地承载其表述的核心信念。这一验证路径——将构念与伴随的情绪分离，并以临床医生校验模型评分者——为语言模型中的情感测量提供了模板；我们概述了其在任务类型、评分者、站点和语言上的扩展。我们发布了条目、评分代码和简版。
translation.brief: 研究解决无法验证赋予语言模型的信念是否真正组织其认知的问题，提出基于 Beck 认知模型的 96 条目强制选择量表 SCI 并通过目标特异性进行多轮验证。

papers.title: Knowledge Graphs Quality Assessment in the Era of LLMs: A Conceptual Framework
papers.abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) have been popularized during the last few decades and are increasingly constructed and consumed by Large Language Models (LLMs). Various applications therefore rely on KGs to provide concise, complete, accurate, faithful, fresh, and traceable answers. However, what is the quality of those KGs? In which cases should a KG be used, and can it be trusted to ground an LLM? How might it be evaluated? We reviewed the literature on quality assessment (QA) of data, information, linked data, KGs, and the intersection of KGs and LLMs. We extended the current state-of-the-art frameworks to a catalog of 24 quality dimensions (QDs) and various quality metrics (QMs). Furthermore, we propose a general-purpose, customizable to a domain or task, and practical QA framework for assessing the quality of KGs.

translation.title: LLM 时代的知识图谱质量评估：一个概念框架
translation.abstract: 知识图谱（KG）在过去几十年中得到普及，并越来越多地由大语言模型（LLM）构建和消费。因此，各种应用依赖 KG 提供简洁、完整、准确、忠实、新鲜且可追溯的答案。然而，这些 KG 的质量如何？在哪些情况下应使用 KG，能否信任它来为 LLM 提供依据？又该如何评估它？我们回顾了关于数据、信息、关联数据、KG 以及 KG 与 LLM 交叉领域的质量评估（QA）文献。我们将现有最先进的框架扩展为包含 24 个质量维度（QD）和多种质量指标（QM）的目录。此外，我们提出了一个通用的、可按领域或任务定制且实用的 QA 框架，用于评估 KG 的质量。
translation.brief: 研究解决 LLM 时代知识图谱质量如何评估的问题，通过文献综述扩展出 24 个质量维度的目录并提出可定制的通用质量评估框架。

papers.title: An Agentic Approach with Evidence-Grounded Verification for Multimodal Emotion Reasoning in Conversation
papers.abstract: LLM-based multimodal emotion reasoning systems perform well on standard benchmarks, but improving them through instruction tuning can be computationally expensive. Agentic pipelines built from frozen models avoid this cost, but introduce a different challenge: when a prediction is wrong, the system must identify which agent or stage caused the error. We address this problem with an agentic framework for traceable multimodal emotion reasoning and prompt-space adaptation. Modality-specific perception agents analyze visual, acoustic, and lexical inputs and post evidence-cited observations to a shared board. An integration agent combines these observations with retrieved multimodal examples to produce an emotion description, label set, and supporting citations, while an MLLM critic can request one revision before the output is finalized. For incorrect predictions, a separate evidence-grounded verification stage applies deterministic checks to verify that cited evidence and references are valid, and an entailment check to determine whether the final claims are supported by that evidence. Detected failures are then grouped by the responsible component and failure type, converted into targeted prompt patches, and accepted only after validation on a held-out set. This adapts the agent prompts without updating model weights. On the MER2025 dataset, targeted prompt adaptation outperforms the frozen static pipeline on all four MLLMs, ranging from 2B to 38B parameters, and matches or outperforms undifferentiated reflection baselines on each of them: VideoLLaMA3-2B, Phi-3.5-vision-instruct, Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, and InternVL2.5-38B. It improves F-score by 0.6--2.2 points depending on the backbone, including an increase from 52.3 to 54.5 on Qwen2.5-VL-7B.

translation.title: 一种基于证据校验的智能体方法用于对话中的多模态情感推理
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的多模态情感推理系统在标准基准上表现良好，但通过指令微调来改进它们可能计算成本高昂。由冻结模型构建的智能体流水线避免了这一成本，但带来了另一个挑战：当预测出错时，系统必须识别是哪个代理或阶段导致了错误。我们用一个可追溯的多模态情感推理和提示空间自适应的智能体框架来解决这一问题。模态特定的感知代理分析视觉、声学和词汇输入，并将带证据引用的观察发布到共享看板。一个整合代理将这些观察与检索到的多模态示例结合，生成情感描述、标签集和支持引用，同时一个 MLLM 批评者可以在输出定稿前请求一次修订。对于错误预测，一个独立的证据校验阶段应用确定性检查来验证所引用的证据和参考是否有效，并进行蕴含检查以确定最终论断是否得到该证据支持。检测到的失败随后按责任组件和失败类型分组，转化为针对性的提示补丁，且仅在留出集上验证通过后才被接受。这在不更新模型权重的情况下自适应地调整代理提示。在 MER2025 数据集上，针对性提示自适应在从 2B 到 38B 参数的所有四个 MLLM 上均优于冻结的静态流水线，并在每一个上匹配或优于无差别反思基线：VideoLLaMA3-2B、Phi-3.5-vision-instruct、Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 和 InternVL2.5-38B。它将 F 分数提升 0.6-2.2 分（取决于骨干模型），包括在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上从 52.3 提升至 54.5。
translation.brief: 研究解决冻结模型智能体流水线中错误归因与改进的问题，提出带证据引用和确定性校验的智能体框架，通过针对性提示补丁实现无权重更新的自适应。

papers.title: Distributional Alignment of LLMs and Its Generalization Properties
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate and probe human behavior, e.g., for surveys. For these applications, a key property is that outputs satisfy distributional alignment: to match its output distribution with some reference (in this case, human) distribution. An obstacle in achieving distributional alignment is generalizing from small training data. In this work, we study (1) how to distributionally align LLMs; and (2) how aligned LLMs might generalize to unseen samples and unrelated topics and tasks. Using two large-scale benchmarks, we find that LLMs can indeed achieve distributional alignment and generalize to unseen questions of the same domain. Cross-topic generalization depends on the relationship between topics (e.g., questions about politics are related to trust in institutions). However, aligned LLMs can degrade in surprising ways (e.g., lose their creative ability), suggesting that its generalization properties are inherently unpredictable and unstable.

translation.title: LLM 的分布对齐及其泛化特性
translation.abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于模拟和探究人类行为，例如问卷调查。对于这些应用，一个关键特性是输出满足分布对齐：即模型的输出分布与某个参考（此处为人类）分布相匹配。实现分布对齐的一个障碍是如何从小规模训练数据中泛化。在本工作中，我们研究（1）如何对 LLM 进行分布对齐；（2）对齐后的 LLM 如何泛化到未见样本以及不相关的主题和任务。基于两个大规模基准，我们发现 LLM 确实可以实现分布对齐，并泛化到同一领域的未见问题。跨主题泛化则取决于主题之间的关系（例如，关于政治的问题与对机构的信任相关）。然而，对齐后的 LLM 可能以令人惊讶的方式退化（例如失去创造力），这表明其泛化特性本质上是不可预测且不稳定的。
translation.brief: 研究如何将 LLM 的输出分布对齐到人类分布，并考察其对未见样本和跨主题任务的泛化能力。

papers.title: Fooling LLM Safety Guards into Judging the Wrong Text
papers.abstract: Safety guards check content before an LLM application acts on it, and most paste that content into a plain-text prompt. Content that imitates the prompt can append a second task, and the guard answers that one instead. We call this target rebinding. Our explanation is that the guard grades the last complete task in its input, here a harmless decoy, so the harmful request goes through unchanged. In a pre-registered test, an appended forged query and decoy clear all 75 held-out AdvBench requests that Shieldstral-1.0-3B flags. The guard is not persuaded: a directive to ignore the text above clears none of them, and in a follow-up run a harmful decoy stops the attack. On our GuardRebind benchmark, each of five guards has an attack family, chosen per guard, that clears at least 93% of its flagged items. Rebinding explains this best on Shieldstral and gpt-oss-safeguard; on ShieldGemma and Llama Guard 3, generic evasion and trailing text respectively do part of the work, and Qwen3Guard falls mainly to a forgery of its whole task. Training the guard to score content no lower than its most harmful part cuts attack success from 75% to 0.8-1.6% on attack families, decoys and forged queries held out of training. All of these attacks append the forged structure after the request, and we added the held-out-decoy evaluation after a first round of test runs. Clean AUROC falls by at most 0.01, but our test of non-inferiority is inconclusive. A score-guided search still beats this trained guard on 47 of 50 items, usually by placing forged structure before the request. On about half of the items where the search wins, the same search also finds benign text, with no forged structure, that clears the guard.

translation.title: 诱骗 LLM 安全护栏评判错误的文本
translation.abstract: 安全护栏在 LLM 应用处理内容之前对其进行检查，而大多数护栏将内容粘贴到纯文本提示中。模仿提示格式的内容可以附加第二个任务，使护栏转而评判那个任务。我们将此称为目标重绑定（target rebinding）。我们的解释是：护栏会评判其输入中最后一个完整任务，此处是一个无害的诱饵，因此有害请求原样通过。在一项预注册测试中，附加的伪造查询和诱饵使 Shieldstral-1.0-3B 标记的全部 75 个留出 AdvBench 请求全部通过。护栏并未被说服：一条“忽略上文”的指令无法通过任何一个请求，且在后续运行中，有害诱饵会阻止攻击。在我们的 GuardRebind 基准上，五个护栏各自都有一个针对性选择的攻击族，可绕过其至少 93% 的被标记项。目标重绑定对 Shieldstral 和 gpt-oss-safeguard 的解释力最强；对 ShieldGemma 和 Llama Guard 3，通用规避和尾部文本分别起部分作用，而 Qwen3Guard 主要败于对其整个任务的伪造。训练护栏使其评分不低于内容中最有害的部分，可将攻击族、诱饵和训练中未见的伪造查询上的攻击成功率从 75% 降至 0.8-1.6%。所有这些攻击都在请求之后附加伪造结构，而我们在第一轮测试后才加入了留出诱饵评估。干净数据的 AUROC 最多下降 0.01，但我们的非劣性检验结果不确定。基于评分引导的搜索仍在 50 项中的 47 项上击败该训练后的护栏，通常是将伪造结构置于请求之前。在搜索获胜的约一半项目上，同一搜索还能找到不含伪造结构的良性文本来通过护栏。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 安全护栏提出目标重绑定攻击，通过附加伪造任务结构诱使护栏评判无害诱饵文本，并训练护栏对内容最有害部分评分以缓解该攻击。

papers.title: Understanding Tool-Mediated Interaction Failures in Agentic GUI Software: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly complete tasks through live graphical user interfaces (GUIs). Because the model cannot directly operate the GUI, these systems often rely on tools to capture screenshots or UI trees, translate model outputs into GUI actions, and report whether the interface changed. We study failures where this tool-mediated interaction makes the agent's view of the task diverge from the live GUI. We construct Malva, a defect library with 335 confirmed real-world failures from 40 open-source applications. These failures fall into 11 defect patterns rooted in state representation, state transition, and synchronization problems. They are widespread: 90% of the studied applications contain more than one defect type. They are also often silent: incorrectness appears in 86.6% of failures, including 119 cases that produce wrong behavior without a fail-stop signal. We operationalize this taxonomy with MalvaGuard, a pre-deployment static contract checker that reaches 57.3% precision and 76.8% recall on an additional 20-application corpus.
authors: Mengqian Xu (East China Normal University Shanghai Innovation Institute)
Long Yang (East China Normal University Shanghai Innovation Institute)
Lei Ma (University of Tokyo University of Alberta)
Chengcheng Wan (East China Normal University Shanghai Innovation Institute)

translation.title: 理解 Agentic GUI 软件中工具介导交互的失败：一项实证研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地通过实时图形用户界面（GUI）完成任务。由于模型无法直接操作 GUI，这些系统通常依赖工具来截取屏幕截图或 UI 树、将模型输出转换为 GUI 动作，并报告界面是否发生变化。我们研究这类工具介导交互导致智能体对任务的认知与实时 GUI 产生偏差的失败。我们构建了 Malva，一个包含来自 40 个开源应用的 335 个已确认真实失败的缺陷库。这些失败可归为 11 种缺陷模式，根源在于状态表示、状态转换和同步问题。它们分布广泛：90% 的被研究应用包含不止一种缺陷类型。它们也常常是静默的：86.6% 的失败中出现不正确性，其中 119 个案例在没有失败停止信号的情况下产生错误行为。我们通过 MalvaGuard 将该分类法落地，这是一个部署前的静态契约检查器，在另外 20 个应用的语料上达到 57.3% 的精确率和 76.8% 的召回率。
translation.brief: 构建包含 335 个真实失败的缺陷库 Malva，归纳工具介导 GUI 交互失败的 11 种缺陷模式，并提出静态契约检查器 MalvaGuard 进行部署前检测。

papers.title: Before the Ticket: Grounding HPC User Support in Documentation and Resolved Tickets with an Agentic LLM Assistant
papers.abstract: Most questions that reach an HPC help desk have already been answered in the center's user guides or in a ticket someone else filed last semester; users still file new tickets because the guides are hard to navigate and the ticket history is not theirs to search. We present an assistant that answers from both sources: an orchestrator calls two tools over the Model Context Protocol, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over the live documentation and a Llama-3-8B model fine-tuned with QLoRA on 11,244 query-resolution pairs mined from historical tickets, and merges their answers. Every model runs on-premises or on the university's hosted LLM service because ticket data may not leave the institution. On 400 held-out tickets from Purdue's Rosen Center for Advanced Computing, disjoint from training and free of near-duplicates, and evaluated by two judges from model families that generated none of the answers, fine-tuning on resolutions rewritten into self-service guidance is the clear winner in agreement with RCAC's resolutions (BERTScore F1 improves from 0.06 to 0.27 over the base model) and is judged most correct on average. The end-to-end system does not improve on its tools, although they are complementary: choosing the better answer per question would exceed either tool (judged correctness 3.41 versus 3.20, an oracle bound), while the merge follows the documentation tool in 78% of answers. Returning one tool's answer instead recovers the fine-tuned tool's quality (3.19 versus 2.66), but neither a learned selector nor an LLM verifier beats that tool alone.

translation.title: 在工单之前：基于文档与已解决工单、由 Agentic LLM 助手支撑的 HPC 用户支持
translation.abstract: 到达 HPC 服务台的大多数问题其实已经在中心的用户指南或他人上学期提交的工单中得到解答；用户仍然提交新工单，是因为指南难以导航，且工单历史并非用户可搜索的资源。我们提出一个从这两种来源回答问题的助手：一个编排器调用基于 Model Context Protocol 的两个工具——对实时文档的检索增强生成（RAG），以及在从历史工单挖掘的 11,244 个查询-解决方案对上用 QLoRA 微调的 Llama-3-8B 模型——并合并两者的答案。由于工单数据不得离开机构，所有模型均在本地或大学托管的 LLM 服务上运行。在 Purdue Rosen Center for Advanced Computing 的 400 个留出工单上（与训练集不相交且无近似重复），并由来自未生成任何答案的模型家族的两名评审进行评估，在改写为自助指南的解决方案上微调的模型与 RCAC 解决方案的一致性明显最优（BERTScore F1 相比基础模型从 0.06 提升至 0.27），且平均被判为最正确。端到端系统并未超越其工具，尽管两者互补：逐题选择更优答案将超过任一工具（评审正确性 3.41 对 3.20，为 oracle 上界），而合并结果在 78% 的答案中跟随文档工具。改为返回单一工具的答案可恢复微调工具的质量（3.19 对 2.66），但学习型选择器和 LLM 验证器均未能超越该工具本身。
translation.brief: 构建结合文档 RAG 与历史工单微调模型的 HPC 支持助手，研究如何融合两个工具的答案以最佳回应用户问题。

papers.title: RubricCraft: Where Solutions Diverge, Criteria Emerge
papers.abstract: Evaluating language agents on open-ended, artifact-producing tasks is difficult: model-based graders can be inconsistent, while exhaustive programmatic checks are often impractical. Textual rubrics make evaluation criteria explicit, but writing them requires domain expertise. Rubrics generated from task descriptions alone can miss requirements and failure modes that become apparent in attempted solutions. We introduce RubricCraft, which treats rubric construction as the generation of natural-language specifications guided by candidate solutions. Given a task description and independently sampled solver trajectories, RubricCraft compares how each attempt satisfies or violates the task requirements and uses these differences to construct rubric criteria. It applies the criteria to the collected solutions and revises checks that overlook errors or penalize valid alternatives. The resulting rubrics capture partial correctness without requiring any single solution to serve as a complete reference. On SpreadsheetBench v2, against a prompt-only rubric written and applied by the same model, RubricCraft rubrics pass fewer wrong outputs (29.5% against 42.6%), fail none of the outputs the benchmark's own checker accepts, and rank outputs by correctness more often, while separating models as often. Repair on a single attempt leaves grading unchanged, but repair driven by attempts from three model families acts on different tasks, and an evidence audit judges most of those repairs improvements, many on tasks whose reference solution is itself wrong.

translation.title: RubricCraft：解法分歧之处，评判标准涌现
translation.abstract: 在开放式、产出工件的任务上评估语言智能体十分困难：基于模型的评分器可能不一致，而穷举式程序化检查往往不切实际。文本评分细则（rubric）使评估标准显式化，但撰写它们需要领域专业知识。仅从任务描述生成的细则可能遗漏在尝试性解法中才显现的要求和失败模式。我们提出 RubricCraft，它将评分细则构建视为由候选解法引导的自然语言规范生成。给定任务描述和独立采样的求解轨迹，RubricCraft 比较各次尝试如何满足或违反任务要求，并利用这些差异构建细则条目。它将条目应用于收集到的解法，并修订那些忽略错误或惩罚有效替代方案的检查。所得细则能捕捉部分正确性，而无需任何单一解法作为完整参考。在 SpreadsheetBench v2 上，与由同一模型撰写并应用的仅提示式细则相比，RubricCraft 细则放行的错误输出更少（29.5% 对 42.6%），不会误拒基准自带检查器接受的任何输出，更常按正确性对输出排序，同时区分模型的能力相当。基于单次尝试的修复不改变评分，但由三个模型家族的尝试驱动的修复作用于不同任务，且证据审计判定其中大多数修复是改进，许多发生在参考解法本身有误的任务上。
translation.brief: 提出 RubricCraft，通过对比多个候选解法之间的差异自动生成并迭代修订评估用的文本评分细则。

papers.title: Mining the Design Space of Multi-Agent Workflows
papers.abstract: Designing large language model (LLM) multi-agent systems (MAS) still relies on trial and error and informal "folk wisdom." Manual studies test only a few communication structures or topologies (e.g., sequential, parallel, shared-memory, or debate), while automated optimizers discard search trajectories after selecting a task-specific workflow. We present a two-phase pipeline for mining reproducible design principles from workflow code and execution traces. We repurpose AFlow's MCTS optimizer across six composable operators and 26 deterministically verified Enigmata tasks, retaining all intermediate rounds to build a corpus of 28,568 executable workflows. A sandboxed AutoResearch loop then mines orchestration code and prompt templates under an $L_0$-penalized validation objective and tests candidate principles on held-out searches. Across 300 feature-mining trials, we identify effects that persist on held-out searches across three levels of workflow design: workflows beginning with independent solvers and one-shot aggregation (Star-first) perform worse ($\Delta = -0.045$); persistent shared documents (SharedMemory) outperform debate ($\Delta = +0.135$); and prompt specificity and placeholder-based context routing yield gains comparable to communication-structure selection ($\Delta = +0.118$). More broadly, our pipeline and results show the feasibility of turning discarded search trajectories into a statistical testbed for discovering and validating multi-agent workflow design principles.

translation.title: 挖掘多智能体工作流的设计空间
translation.abstract: 设计大语言模型（LLM）多智能体系统（MAS）仍然依赖试错和非正式的"民间经验"。人工研究只测试少数几种通信结构或拓扑（如顺序、并行、共享内存或辩论），而自动化优化器在选定任务特定工作流后便丢弃搜索轨迹。我们提出一个两阶段流水线，用于从工作流代码和执行轨迹中挖掘可复现的设计原则。我们将 AFlow 的 MCTS 优化器重新用于六个可组合算子和 26 个确定性验证的 Enigmata 任务，保留所有中间轮次，构建了包含 28,568 个可执行工作流的语料库。随后，一个沙盒化的 AutoResearch 循环在 $L_0$ 惩罚的验证目标下挖掘编排代码和提示模板，并在留出的搜索上测试候选原则。在 300 次特征挖掘试验中，我们识别出在留出搜索上持续存在的、跨越工作流设计三个层面的效应：以独立求解器和一次性聚合开头的工作流（Star-first）表现更差（$\Delta = -0.045$）；持久共享文档（SharedMemory）优于辩论（$\Delta = +0.135$）；提示具体性和基于占位符的上下文路由带来的收益与通信结构选择相当（$\Delta = +0.118$）。更广泛地说，我们的流水线和结果表明，将丢弃的搜索轨迹转化为用于发现和验证多智能体工作流设计原则的统计测试平台是可行的。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体工作流设计缺乏系统性原则的问题，提出利用 MCTS 搜索轨迹构建语料库并挖掘可验证设计原则的两阶段流水线。

papers.title: Compact-Bench: Measuring What Context Compaction Costs Long-Horizon Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Context compaction lets long-horizon coding agents continue beyond their context windows, but can erase the state needed to finish a task. Prior evaluations measure efficiency, retained information, or end-to-end success, leaving the effect of a specific history replacement difficult to isolate. Compact-Bench pairs full-history and summary-only continuations from a shared repository state, and evaluates recurring details and successive production compactions. It covers 35 SWE-bench repairs, 146 agentic sessions, and 106 production chains. Across 14 summarizer backbones, stable damage ranges from 5-64% of 22 full-history successes: Claude Opus 4.8 preserves the most repairs, while DeepSeek-Flash damages the most. With Kimi-K3 as summarizer, the Kimi Code prompt preserves the most task continuations (19/22), whereas Claude Code retains the most recurring details (15.0%). LLM summaries retain at most 16.0% of recurring details, compared with 79.1% for mechanical extraction; production summaries retain 15.7% at the first boundary. Failures recur across methods: one repair is damaged by 13/14 backbones, and another by all 5 prompts. These results show that reliable compaction requires preserving the progress needed to complete a task, and that retaining relevant information alone does not ensure successful continuation. Code is available at https://github.com/cai-jianfeng/compact-bench and data is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/caijanfeng/compact-bench.

translation.title: Compact-Bench：衡量上下文压缩对长程编码智能体的代价
translation.abstract: 上下文压缩使长程编码智能体能够超越其上下文窗口继续工作，但可能抹去完成任务所需的状态。先前的评估衡量效率、保留信息或端到端成功率，难以隔离特定历史替换的影响。Compact-Bench 将完整历史与仅摘要的续写从同一仓库状态配对，并评估重复出现的细节和连续的生产压缩。它涵盖 35 个 SWE-bench 修复、146 个智能体会话和 106 条生产链。在 14 个摘要器骨干上，稳定的损害占 22 个完整历史成功案例的 5-64%：Claude Opus 4.8 保留最多修复，而 DeepSeek-Flash 造成最多损害。以 Kimi-K3 作为摘要器时，Kimi Code 提示保留最多任务续写（19/22），而 Claude Code 保留最多重复细节（15.0%）。LLM 摘要最多保留 16.0% 的重复细节，而机械抽取为 79.1%；生产摘要在第一个边界保留 15.7%。失败在不同方法间重复出现：一个修复被 13/14 个骨干损害，另一个被全部 5 个提示损害。这些结果表明，可靠的压缩需要保留完成任务所需的进度，而仅保留相关信息并不能确保成功续写。代码见 https://github.com/cai-jianfeng/compact-bench，数据见 https://huggingface.co/datasets/caijanfeng/compact-bench。
translation.brief: 针对上下文压缩对编码智能体影响难以隔离的问题，构建了配对完整历史与摘要续写的 Compact-Bench 基准来量化压缩造成的损害。

papers.title: MBABench-2.0: Evaluating AI Agents on Constructing Financial Spreadsheets Beyond Simple Verifiability
papers.abstract: Spreadsheets are the lingua franca of modern finance, driving valuation, forecast, audit, and many other core workflows of the industry. As LLM agents advance to automate knowledge work, spreadsheet construction is a natural and pertinent testbed. However, most existing spreadsheet benchmarks evaluate agents on fill-in-the-blank style tasks, where an agent performs minor edits in otherwise complete spreadsheets. This protocol fails to capture the most central and time-consuming part of the spreadsheet workflow: the modeling decisions, format design, and sheet layout regular knowledge workers need to toil through to build a workbook from scratch. We introduce MBABench-2.0, a benchmark of 101 original spreadsheet construction tasks, the hardest of which is estimated to take 33 hours for a modeler with 3+ years of experience. Unlike coding or math, where a unit test or a final answer can verify an agent's output, the quality of a financial spreadsheet that concerns readability, maintainability, or auditability, is not so simply verifiable. To holistically evaluate spreadsheet construction, we introduce 129 criteria spanning 12 categories that operationalize quality beyond the accuracy of the spreadsheet. Evaluating over 20 agents across 8 models and 4 harness types, we find that frontier agents rarely construct spreadsheets that are both accurate and meet our quality criteria: the top agent achieves a pass rate of only 16% on the benchmark. The benchmark demonstrates a substantial gap in spreadsheet building capability of current agents.

translation.title: MBABench-2.0：超越简单可验证性评估 AI 智能体构建金融电子表格的能力
translation.abstract: 电子表格是现代金融的通用语言，驱动估值、预测、审计及行业众多核心工作流。随着 LLM 智能体迈向自动化知识工作，电子表格构建是一个自然而贴切的测试平台。然而，大多数现有电子表格基准以填空式任务评估智能体，即智能体在基本完整的电子表格中做少量编辑。这一协议未能捕捉电子表格工作流中最核心、最耗时的部分：建模决策、格式设计和表单布局——普通知识工作者从零构建工作簿时需要费力完成的工作。我们提出 MBABench-2.0，一个包含 101 个原创电子表格构建任务的基准，其中最难的任务估计需要具有 3 年以上经验的建模者花费 33 小时。与编码或数学不同（单元测试或最终答案即可验证智能体输出），金融电子表格在可读性、可维护性或可审计性方面的质量并非如此简单可验证。为全面评估电子表格构建，我们引入横跨 12 个类别的 129 项标准，将质量操作化到电子表格准确性之外。对 8 个模型、4 种 harness 类型的 20 多个智能体的评估发现，前沿智能体很少能构建既准确又满足质量标准的电子表格：最佳智能体在基准上的通过率仅为 16%。该基准揭示了当前智能体在电子表格构建能力上的巨大差距。
translation.brief: 针对现有基准无法评估从零构建电子表格能力的问题，提出包含 101 个任务和 129 项多维质量标准的 MBABench-2.0 基准。

papers.title: Reuse, Rewrite, or Reject: Evidence-Constrained Trace Reuse for Repeated Mobile GUI Control
papers.abstract: Mobile GUI agents frequently perform repetitive tasks with similar interaction procedures. Reusing previous executions can reduce redundant LLM inference and execution overhead, but variations in user instructions and execution environments may invalidate previously successful actions. We systematically characterize these variations into six representative categories and observe that such changes do not necessarily invalidate entire procedures: individual transitions can remain reusable when validated against the current task context and interface state. Based on this insight, we propose graph-text templates for selective execution-trace reuse. The graph captures UI states and action transitions, while the text encodes task intent, procedural structure, and typed slots for variable content. A record-template-replay framework constructs templates from verified executions and leverages the current instruction and live UI state to reuse, adapt, or discard individual transitions. Given an execution trace, our framework reduces LLM inference token consumption by approximately 80% on average across five base agents on AndroidWorld, with most agents achieving at least 1.5-fold execution speedup over LLM-only execution. In real-device evaluations on Android and HarmonyOS, our framework achieves action reuse ratios of 70.7-79.8% while maintaining over 2-fold execution speedup in most evaluated configurations.

translation.title: 复用、重写或拒绝：面向重复移动 GUI 控制的证据约束轨迹复用
translation.abstract: 移动 GUI 智能体经常以相似的交互流程执行重复任务。复用先前的执行可以减少冗余的 LLM 推理和执行开销，但用户指令和执行环境的变化可能使先前成功的动作失效。我们系统地将这些变化归纳为六个代表性类别，并观察到此类变化不一定会使整个流程失效：在针对当前任务上下文和界面状态验证后，单个转移仍可复用。基于这一洞察，我们提出用于选择性执行轨迹复用的图-文本模板。图捕获 UI 状态和动作转移，文本编码任务意图、流程结构和用于可变内容的类型化槽位。一个记录-模板-回放框架从已验证的执行构建模板，并利用当前指令和实时 UI 状态来复用、调整或丢弃单个转移。给定一条执行轨迹，我们的框架在 AndroidWorld 上对五个基础智能体平均减少约 80% 的 LLM 推理 token 消耗，大多数智能体相比纯 LLM 执行实现至少 1.5 倍的执行加速。在 Android 和 HarmonyOS 真机评估中，我们的框架实现 70.7-79.8% 的动作复用率，同时在大多数评估配置中保持超过 2 倍的执行加速。
translation.brief: 针对重复移动 GUI 任务中历史轨迹复用易失效的问题，提出图-文本模板框架，基于当前指令和 UI 状态对单个动作转移进行选择性复用、调整或丢弃。

papers.title: Omni-UBench: Benchmarking Omni-Modal LLM-based Guardrails Across Safety, Utility, and Reliability
papers.abstract: Advances in Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs) have enabled increasingly seamless human-AI interaction, but their unified processing of heterogeneous modalities also expands the attack surface, allowing adversaries to exploit richer input compositions to circumvent safety alignment. To counter such risks, omni-modal guardrails have been proposed to detect and filter unsafe queries across arbitrary modalities. However, their capabilities and limitations remain insufficiently understood due to the absence of a comprehensive evaluation benchmark. In this paper, we present Omni-UBench, the first comprehensive framework for omni-modal safety assessment, evaluating guardrail models along three critical dimensions, i.e., safety, utility, and reliability. Omni-UBench curates over 183k samples drawn from 35+ heterogeneous sources spanning text, image, audio, video, and their cross-modal combinations, annotated with safety labels under a unified risk taxonomy. Benchmarking under Omni-UBench on 15 representative OLLMs and omni-modal guardrails yields several key findings, including: (1) modern OLLMs exhibit strong content moderation potential even without guardrail-specific tuning; (2) existing guardrails still struggle to identify cross-modal queries that conceal harmful intent or involve sophisticated jailbreaks; (3) they further exhibit substantial safety hallucination and over-sensitivity to textual patterns, revealing a deficient understanding of cross-modal safety semantics. Our findings provide valuable insights for developing more trustworthy omni-modal guardrails in future research.

translation.title: Omni-UBench：跨安全性、实用性与可靠性基准测试基于全模态 LLM 的防护栏
translation.abstract: 全模态大语言模型（OLLM）的进步使人与 AI 的交互日益无缝，但其对异构模态的统一处理也扩大了攻击面，使对手能够利用更丰富的输入组合绕过安全对齐。为应对此类风险，全模态防护栏被提出用于检测和过滤跨任意模态的不安全查询。然而，由于缺乏全面的评估基准，其能力和局限仍知之甚少。本文提出 Omni-UBench，首个全面的全模态安全评估框架，沿三个关键维度（安全性、实用性、可靠性）评估防护栏模型。Omni-UBench 整合了来自 35 个以上异构来源、涵盖文本、图像、音频、视频及其跨模态组合的超过 18.3 万个样本，并在统一风险分类下标注安全标签。在 Omni-UBench 上对 15 个代表性 OLLM 和全模态防护栏进行基准测试得出若干关键发现，包括：（1）现代 OLLM 即使未经防护栏专门调优也展现出强大的内容审核潜力；（2）现有防护栏仍难以识别隐藏有害意图或涉及复杂越狱的跨模态查询；（3）它们还表现出显著的安全幻觉和对文本模式的过度敏感，揭示了对跨模态安全语义理解的不足。我们的发现为未来研究开发更可信的全模态防护栏提供了宝贵见解。
translation.brief: 针对全模态防护栏缺乏系统评估的问题，构建了覆盖 18.3 万样本、沿安全性、实用性和可靠性三维度评估的 Omni-UBench 基准。

papers.title: What Open-Source Projects Tell Their Coding Agents: A Census of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md
papers.abstract: Coding agents can be guided with instruction files in a repository. We examine this emerging practice through a census of popular, active GitHub repositories in thirteen languages, treating each repository's root AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md as one instruction set. Agent instructions appear in of repositories and of the most-starred; where both files exist, CLAUDE.md usually points to AGENTS.md. We analyse statements using model-assisted annotation and human review. The annotations reveal a practical mix of project knowledge and rules about code, building and workflow. Collaboration rules name concrete requirements, from test plans to commit formats, yet of directives give no reason. Projects disagree on AI attribution: commit-message rules more often prohibit it than require it, while pull-request rules more often require disclosure. A third of instruction sets have a generator-associated signature, a tool-inserted block, shared text or an AI-marked creation commit; four in five are edited after creation. Prespecified tests associate repository popularity with rules on pull requests and AI contributions. Exploratory analyses link activity to process-oriented content and show that LLM and agent projects are over-represented among adopters. The models agree much more closely with each other than with the human reviewer's topic assignments, a caution for automated annotation. We release the annotations, taxonomies and pointers to the analysed file versions.

translation.title: 开源项目如何告知其编码代理：AGENTS.md 与 CLAUDE.md 的普查
translation.abstract: 编码代理可以通过仓库中的指令文件获得引导。我们通过对十三种语言的热门活跃 GitHub 仓库进行普查来考察这一新兴实践，将每个仓库根目录下的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 视为一个指令集。代理指令出现在一定比例的仓库中，且在星标最多的仓库中比例更高；当两个文件同时存在时，CLAUDE.md 通常指向 AGENTS.md。我们使用模型辅助标注和人工审查来分析其中的陈述。标注结果显示，这些指令实用地混合了项目知识以及关于代码、构建和工作流的规则。协作规则列出了具体要求，从测试计划到提交格式，但相当比例的指令没有给出理由。各项目在 AI 署名问题上意见不一：提交信息规则更常禁止 AI 署名而非要求它，而拉取请求规则更常要求披露。三分之一的指令集带有生成器相关签名、工具插入的代码块、共享文本或标记为 AI 创建的提交；五分之四的指令集在创建后被编辑过。预设检验将仓库流行度与拉取请求和 AI 贡献相关规则联系起来。探索性分析将活跃度与面向流程的内容联系起来，并显示 LLM 和代理项目在采用者中被过度代表。各模型彼此之间的一致性远高于与人工审查者主题分配的一致性，这对自动化标注是一个警示。我们发布了标注、分类体系以及指向所分析文件版本的链接。
translation.brief: 该论文通过普查 GitHub 仓库中的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 指令文件，结合模型辅助标注与人工审查，系统刻画了开源项目向编码代理传达指令的内容与模式。

papers.title: Autoregressive Multimodal Anomaly Detection with Large Language Models for Microservice Systems
papers.abstract: Microservice systems have become a dominant architecture for large-scale cloud applications, enabling rapid deployment and elastic scaling. However, ensuring the reliability and availability of microservice systems critically relies on effective anomaly detection, as failures and performance anomalies can quickly propagate across services and severely impact end-to-end system behavior. Existing multimodal anomaly detection approaches for microservice systems often struggle with two fundamental limitations: (i) the neglect of modality-specific characteristics in favor of cross-modality fusion, and (ii) the "identity-shortcut" problem that affects the feature reconstruction process. To address these issues, we propose LLMMAD, an autoregressive multimodal anomaly detection framework for microservice systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs). Initially, to reconcile cross-modality fusion with modality-specific preservation, LLMMAD embeds and recombines multimodal data into a unified sequence for LLM processing to model inter-modality relationships, while employing modality-wise reconstruction heads to retain modality-specific information. Subsequently, to eliminate the identity-shortcut, we implement a prediction-driven autoregressive objective, under which the model predicts future states rather than copies current inputs. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments on three real-world datasets. The results demonstrate that LLMMAD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving F1-score improvements of 3.1%, 1.4%, and 0.9%, respectively, thereby providing a more reliable solution for microservice monitoring.

translation.title: 基于大语言模型的自回归多模态微服务系统异常检测
translation.abstract: 微服务系统已成为大规模云应用的主流架构，支持快速部署和弹性伸缩。然而，微服务系统的可靠性和可用性严重依赖于有效的异常检测，因为故障和性能异常会在服务间快速传播并严重影响端到端系统行为。现有的微服务系统多模态异常检测方法通常存在两个根本局限：(i) 为追求跨模态融合而忽视模态自身特性；(ii) 影响特征重建过程的"恒等捷径"问题。为解决这些问题，我们提出 LLMMAD，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的微服务系统自回归多模态异常检测框架。首先，为在跨模态融合与模态特性保留之间取得平衡，LLMMAD 将多模态数据嵌入并重组为统一序列供 LLM 处理以建模模态间关系，同时采用按模态的重建头来保留模态特定信息。其次，为消除恒等捷径，我们实现了预测驱动的自回归目标，使模型预测未来状态而非复制当前输入。最后，我们在三个真实数据集上进行了大量实验。结果表明 LLMMAD 持续优于最先进方法，F1 分数分别提升 3.1%、1.4% 和 0.9%，为微服务监控提供了更可靠的解决方案。
translation.brief: 该论文针对微服务多模态异常检测中忽视模态特性和恒等捷径问题，提出基于 LLM 的自回归框架 LLMMAD，通过统一序列建模与预测驱动的自回归目标加以解决。

papers.title: Cognitively Constrained Partners for Zero-Shot Coordination in Real-Time Partitioned Control
papers.abstract: Effective human-machine teaming requires agents that coordinate with unpredictable human partners. Reinforcement learning from live human feedback or large behavioural datasets is expensive, while purely simulated training overfits to artificial conventions and fails at Zero-Shot Coordination with real people. We propose a framework for training teaming agents against Cognitively Constrained Partners: simulated partners whose diversity emerges from procedural constraints grounded in human physiological literature, specifically reaction delays and perceptual limitations, rather than from reward shaping or historical training checkpoints. In a modified Lunar Lander environment, we report preliminary evidence that these partners play more like real people than unconstrained agents do, and that agents trained against them match the strongest cross-play baselines while being the only ones whose performance does not depend on how their training partners were generated. We also describe a human-participant study designed so that its rankings can be compared directly against cross-play, testing how well that standard evaluation predicts real human-agent teaming.

translation.title: 用于实时分区控制中零样本协作的认知受限伙伴
translation.abstract: 有效的人机协作需要能与不可预测的人类伙伴协调的智能体。从实时人类反馈或大规模行为数据集进行强化学习代价高昂，而纯模拟训练会过拟合于人为约定，在与真实人类的零样本协作（Zero-Shot Coordination）中失败。我们提出一个针对认知受限伙伴（Cognitively Constrained Partners）训练协作智能体的框架：这类模拟伙伴的多样性来自基于人类生理学文献的程序化约束，具体为反应延迟和感知限制，而非来自奖励塑形或历史训练检查点。在改进的 Lunar Lander 环境中，我们报告了初步证据，表明这些伙伴比无约束智能体更像真人，且针对它们训练的智能体达到了最强 cross-play 基线的水平，同时是唯一性能不依赖于训练伙伴生成方式的智能体。我们还描述了一项人类被试研究，其设计使排名可与 cross-play 直接比较，以检验该标准评估对真实人机协作的预测能力。
translation.brief: 该论文针对零样本人机协作中模拟训练过拟合于人为约定的问题，提出用基于人类反应延迟和感知限制等生理约束程序化生成的认知受限伙伴来训练协作智能体。

papers.title: When and How Does Muon Precondition? The Role of Structured Gradient Noise
papers.abstract: Muon has become a popular optimizer for large language model training, yet its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. In this work, we study how gradient noise geometry shapes Muon's preconditioning benefits. We first show, theoretically and empirically, that under the classical isotropic noise assumption, Muon offers no acceleration beyond a rescaling of the learning rate. This motivates us to investigate structured noise arising from mini-batch sampling in associative memory with heterogeneous task frequencies. We establish an exact balancing threshold for two tasks and extend the analysis to multiple tasks, revealing how task coverage and gradient reliability jointly shape learning. Our analysis shows that Muon can soften the dependence on task frequency from linear to square-root, helping balance the learning of frequent and rare tasks. We further identify rotation-induced negative transfer in SignSGD that Muon avoids, and explain how momentum reduces sampling noise while tracking changing gradients. Controlled numerical experiments validate these mechanisms, and a preliminary LLM pretraining study illustrates the practical promise of fast-slow momentum.

translation.title: Muon 何时以及如何进行预条件化：结构化梯度噪声的作用
translation.abstract: Muon 已成为大语言模型训练中流行的优化器，但其理论基础仍知之甚少。在本工作中，我们研究梯度噪声几何如何塑造 Muon 预条件化的收益。我们首先从理论和实证上表明，在经典的各向同性噪声假设下，Muon 相对于学习率的重缩放不提供任何加速。这促使我们研究在具有异质任务频率的联想记忆中小批量采样产生的结构化噪声。我们为两个任务建立了精确的平衡阈值，并将分析扩展到多任务，揭示任务覆盖率和梯度可靠性如何共同塑造学习。我们的分析表明，Muon 可以将对任务频率的依赖从线性软化到平方根，帮助平衡频繁任务和稀有任务的学习。我们进一步识别了 SignSGD 中由旋转引起的负迁移而 Muon 可以避免，并解释了动量如何在跟踪变化梯度的同时降低采样噪声。受控数值实验验证了这些机制，一项初步的 LLM 预训练研究展示了快慢动量的实践前景。
translation.brief: 该论文研究 Muon 优化器预条件化收益的理论基础，通过分析小批量采样产生的结构化梯度噪声，揭示其平衡频繁与稀有任务学习及避免 SignSGD 负迁移的机制。

papers.title: Learning to Be Monitored: Causal Bounds and Intervention-Aware Post-Training Recipes for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring aims to detect potentially harmful behaviors in large language models (LLMs) from their CoTs. Intervention-based evaluations measure this property by asking whether a monitor can detect the role of an intervention from the CoT when the targeted behavior occurs, typically using minimal-criterion sensitivity ($\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$) proposed by~\citep{guan2025monitoring}. However, a target behavior observed under intervention is not necessarily caused by it, and we show that this metric can overestimate how often a monitor detects target behaviors actually caused by the intervention. Specifically, we establish $\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$ as an upper bound on this causal detection rate and derive a complementary lower bound, which provides a tighter evaluation framework for CoT monitorability. With this framework, we study whether LLMs can be trained to make their CoTs easier to monitor. We first construct a training dataset of paired control--intervention tasks spanning multiple intervention types. Using the dataset, we design and apply three intervention-specific training methods based on off-policy self-distillation, reinforcement learning, and on-policy self-distillation to train separate variants of each base model. Across various model-monitor configurations, all three methods generally improve CoT monitorability over the corresponding base models under our extended evaluation framework. Our code is available at https://github.com/xinyue-lxy/learning-to-be-monitored.

translation.title: 学会被监控：面向思维链可监控性的因果界与干预感知后训练方法
translation.abstract: 思维链（CoT）监控旨在从大语言模型（LLM）的 CoT 中检测潜在有害行为。基于干预的评估通过询问当目标行为发生时监控器能否从 CoT 中检测到干预的作用来衡量这一属性，通常使用 \citep{guan2025monitoring} 提出的最小准则敏感度（$\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$）。然而，在干预下观察到的目标行为不一定由干预引起，我们证明该指标可能高估监控器检测到实际由干预引起的目标行为的频率。具体而言，我们将 $\mathsf{TPR_{mc}}$ 确立为该因果检测率的上界，并推导出一个互补的下界，为 CoT 可监控性提供了更紧的评估框架。基于该框架，我们研究能否训练 LLM 使其 CoT 更容易被监控。我们首先构建了一个涵盖多种干预类型的成对控制-干预任务训练数据集。利用该数据集，我们设计并应用了三种基于离策略自蒸馏、强化学习和在策略自蒸馏的干预特定训练方法，为每个基础模型训练各自的变体。在各种模型-监控器配置下，在我们扩展的评估框架下，这三种方法总体上都比相应基础模型提升了 CoT 可监控性。我们的代码见 https://github.com/xinyue-lxy/learning-to-be-monitored。
translation.brief: 该论文针对现有 CoT 监控评估指标高估因果检测率的问题，建立因果上下界评估框架，并设计三种干预感知的后训练方法使 LLM 的思维链更易被监控。

papers.title: Generalized green and red concepts for artificial intelligence, big data, and information and communication technologies: Multidimensional framework and countermeasures
papers.abstract: The rapid expansions of artificial intelligence (AI), big data (BD), and information and communication technologies (ICT) are driving substantial growth in electricity, water, and material demands, with data centers projected to consume 6.7--12\% of U.S. electricity by 2028 (up from 4.4\% in 2023) and AI-related water demand estimated at 4--6 billion m$^3$ annually by 2027. Existing ``green AI'' and ``red AI'' discussions have largely emphasized computational efficiency and carbon emissions, providing limited guidance for lifecycle trade-offs, service-versus-use impacts, and broader sustainability externalities beyond energy. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes generalized green AI (GGAI) and generalized red AI (GRAI) and extends the taxonomy to red BD (RBD) and red ICT (RICT) as well as red electronic and electrical engineering (REEE) \& red digital technologies (RDT) under a unified Environmental-Economic-Social-Technical/Operational (E/Ec/S/T) framework. Based on representative footprint indicators in the large-model era (electricity, carbon, water, and e-waste), we analyze how risks propagate across AI-BD-ICT stacks and across service-use boundaries. We further organize actionable countermeasures into a four-tier taxonomy aligned with the Environmental-Economic-Social-Technical/Operational framework: metric-level reform for accountability, revision of information and communication technologies design principles and demand shaping, efficiency-oriented LLM development practices (data, model, training, and scaling), and energy-infrastructure transition. The proposed framework operationalizes the Environmental-Economic-Social-Technical/Operational-aligned assessment and intervention prioritization across the AI-BD-ICT stacks, enabling sustainability-by-design without sacrificing utility.

translation.title: 面向人工智能、大数据与信息通信技术的广义绿色与红色概念：多维框架与对策
translation.abstract: 人工智能（AI）、大数据（BD）和信息通信技术（ICT）的快速扩张正推动电力、水和材料需求大幅增长，预计到2028年数据中心将消耗美国6.7%–12%的电力（高于2023年的4.4%），到2027年AI相关年用水需求估计达40–60亿立方米。现有的“绿色AI”与“红色AI”讨论大多侧重计算效率和碳排放，对生命周期权衡、服务与使用的影响以及能源之外的更广泛可持续性外部性指导有限。为弥合这一差距，本文提出广义绿色AI（GGAI）和广义红色AI（GRAI），并在统一的环境-经济-社会-技术/运营（E/Ec/S/T）框架下将分类扩展到红色BD（RBD）、红色ICT（RICT）以及红色电子电气工程（REEE）与红色数字技术（RDT）。基于大模型时代具有代表性的足迹指标（电力、碳、水和电子垃圾），我们分析了风险如何在AI-BD-ICT技术栈之间以及服务-使用边界之间传播。我们进一步将可操作的对策组织为与环境-经济-社会-技术/运营框架对齐的四层分类：面向问责的指标层改革、信息通信技术设计原则修订与需求塑造、面向效率的LLM开发实践（数据、模型、训练与扩展），以及能源基础设施转型。所提框架在AI-BD-ICT技术栈上实现了与环境-经济-社会-技术/运营对齐的评估与干预优先级排序，在不牺牲效用的情况下实现可持续性设计。
translation.brief: 针对现有绿色/红色AI讨论忽视能源之外可持续性权衡的问题，提出统一E/Ec/S/T框架下的广义绿色/红色AI及AI-BD-ICT分类体系与四层对策。

papers.title: Not Every Agent Needs the Strongest Model: Unified Prompt-Model Optimization for Heterogeneous LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) rely on role-specific prompts and execution models to solve complex tasks collaboratively. However, prompt optimization typically keeps model assignments fixed, leaving differences in role requirements and their associated inference costs outside the search. We present UniMASO, a Unified framework for heterogeneous Multi-Agent System Optimization through the joint adaptation of prompts and model assignments. UniMASO evaluates candidate updates through local, downstream, and global feedback, using cost-aware Pareto search to retain useful quality-cost trade-offs. Topology-aware co-evolution then coordinates these updates according to agent roles and dependencies. Cross-level trajectory memory further supplies historical successes and failures to guide subsequent optimization. Experiments on five benchmarks and five execution topologies show that UniMASO achieves competitive task performance at substantially lower deployment cost than the strongest homogeneous configurations. Under centralized execution, it improves the average score from 69.79 to 70.40 while reducing token-weighted deployment cost by 85.2% relative to DeepSeek-V4-Pro with MASPO. These results support joint prompt-model adaptation as an effective approach to efficient multi-agent collaboration. The code is available at https://github.com/Achilles008/UniMASO_main.

translation.title: 并非每个智能体都需要最强模型：面向异构LLM多智能体系统的统一提示-模型优化
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）依赖角色特定的提示和执行模型来协作解决复杂任务。然而，提示优化通常保持模型分配固定，使角色需求差异及其相关推理成本游离于搜索之外。我们提出UniMASO，一个通过提示与模型分配联合适配来优化异构多智能体系统的统一框架。UniMASO通过局部、下游和全局反馈评估候选更新，使用成本感知的Pareto搜索保留有用的质量-成本权衡。拓扑感知的协同进化随后根据智能体角色和依赖关系协调这些更新。跨层轨迹记忆进一步提供历史成功与失败经验以指导后续优化。在五个基准和五种执行拓扑上的实验表明，UniMASO以显著低于最强同构配置的部署成本取得了有竞争力的任务性能。在集中式执行下，它将平均分数从69.79提升至70.40，同时相比使用MASPO的DeepSeek-V4-Pro将token加权部署成本降低85.2%。这些结果支持提示-模型联合适配作为高效多智能体协作的有效途径。代码见 https://github.com/Achilles008/UniMASO_main。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体系统中提示优化固定模型分配导致成本高的问题，提出UniMASO框架联合优化提示与模型分配，实现质量-成本权衡。

papers.title: Toward an Agentic AI Approach to Public Health Data Collection
papers.abstract: Disease surveillance increasingly integrates automated data collection, yet predefined sources and procedures require manual adaptation as reporting practices change. We explore agentic artificial intelligence (AI) as an approach to coordinating surveillance data collection across heterogeneous sources. Specifically, we built a multi-agent framework that integrates source discovery, source assessment, evidence structuring, event linking, and validation. Three retrospective applications illustrate its promise. The workflow recovered all 13 individual cases in a hantavirus outbreak, with links to 85 distinct publisher domains compared with 28 in the reference benchmark, reconstructed Canadian measles counts with a final total 0.33% below the national reference and higher cumulative counts on 79.8% of comparable days, and increased the share of days with recent Sierra Leone mpox reports from 28.2% to 65.6% by incorporating attributed media. These demonstrations also reveal limitations in record completeness and accuracy, while prospective gains in timeliness remain untested. We envision agentic AI as a complementary layer of public health data infrastructure, coordinating evidence-linked collection under surveillance goals and standards defined by public health professionals.

translation.title: 迈向公共卫生数据采集的智能体式AI方法
translation.abstract: 疾病监测日益整合自动化数据采集，但预定义的来源和流程需要随报告实践变化而手动调整。我们探索智能体式人工智能（AI）作为协调跨异构来源监测数据采集的方法。具体而言，我们构建了一个整合来源发现、来源评估、证据结构化、事件关联和验证的多智能体框架。三个回顾性应用展示了其前景。该工作流恢复了汉坦病毒疫情中的全部13个个案，关联到85个不同的发布者域名（参考基准为28个）；重建的加拿大麻疹计数最终总数比国家参考低0.33%，且在79.8%的可比日期上累计计数更高；通过纳入带来源标注的媒体报道，将塞拉利昂猴痘近期报告的日期占比从28.2%提升至65.6%。这些演示也揭示了记录完整性和准确性方面的局限，而时效性方面的前瞻性收益尚待检验。我们设想智能体式AI作为公共卫生数据基础设施的补充层，在公共卫生专业人员定义的监测目标和标准下协调基于证据关联的采集。
translation.brief: 针对疾病监测数据采集依赖预定义来源需手动调整的问题，构建整合来源发现、评估、证据结构化与验证的多智能体框架。

papers.title: Efficient Omni-modal Large Language Model Inference via Per-Query Modality Selection
papers.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) can jointly process a broad range of modalities, such as text, audio, and video, enabling stronger multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, but often at substantial inference cost. We observe that the benefit of additional modalities varies across queries, indicating that a fixed modality configuration can be inefficient. Motivated by this, we study query-wise modality selection, which keeps the underlying Omni-LLM fixed while adaptively selecting which modalities to provide for each query. We formulate the problem as an accuracy-cost optimization problem and develop a cost-sensitive learning approach for modality selection. We evaluate our approach on WorldSense using Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni under three inference-cost measures: input tokens, latency, and monetary cost. Across both models, query-wise modality selection consistently improves the accuracy-cost trade-off and can even outperform the standard setting in which all available modalities are provided to the Omni-LLM. For Qwen2.5-Omni, our cost-sensitive approach matches or exceeds this full-modality accuracy while requiring only approximately 41% of the input tokens, 39% of the latency, and 61% of the monetary cost.

translation.title: 通过按查询模态选择实现高效的全模态大语言模型推理
translation.abstract: 全模态大语言模型（Omni-LLM）可以联合处理文本、音频和视频等多种模态，实现更强的多模态理解与推理能力，但往往伴随高昂的推理成本。我们观察到额外模态的收益因查询而异，这表明固定的模态配置可能效率低下。受此启发，我们研究按查询的模态选择，即在保持底层Omni-LLM不变的情况下，自适应地为每个查询选择提供哪些模态。我们将该问题形式化为精度-成本优化问题，并开发了一种用于模态选择的成本敏感学习方法。我们在WorldSense上使用Qwen2.5-Omni和Qwen3-Omni，在输入token、延迟和货币成本三种推理成本度量下评估我们的方法。在两个模型上，按查询模态选择持续改善精度-成本权衡，甚至可以超越向Omni-LLM提供所有可用模态的标准设置。对于Qwen2.5-Omni，我们的成本敏感方法在达到或超过全模态精度的同时，仅需约41%的输入token、39%的延迟和61%的货币成本。
translation.brief: 针对Omni-LLM固定模态配置推理成本高的问题，提出按查询自适应选择模态的成本敏感学习方法以优化精度-成本权衡。

papers.title: Benchmarks Are Surprisingly Compaction-Friendly
papers.abstract: Long horizon agentic tasks are now pushing LLM agents past their context window. To continue the task, the agent scaffold has to free up the context window, a process known as context compaction. Compaction is generally lossy by design: agents can silently lose task constraints, instructions, or their reasoning behind earlier decisions. Although compaction is a standard component of coding agent scaffolds, it has not been studied systematically with frontier models on realistic, long horizon agentic tasks. Previous work evaluate smaller open weight models on toy or synthetic trajectories. We fix the agent scaffold (OpenCode), implement five compaction strategies inside it, and evaluate three frontier models on three long horizon benchmarks (PaperBench, ProgramBench, PostTrainBench). For the two 1M context models, the compaction threshold does not measurably affect the task performance, whereas GPT-5.3-Codex, the model with the smallest context window, performs worse at lower thresholds on PaperBench and, less clearly, on PostTrainBench. No compaction method outperforms default self-summarization, and methods that discard more content cost some models up to 20 points while leaving other models the same. Compaction can, however, silently remove task constraints: on ProgramBench, the first compaction summary already drops about one third of the task's anticheating rules on average, and this rises monotonically with the number of compactions. On real user-agent sessions from SWE-chat, instructions about how the agent should work and what it should not do are dropped around 6 times more than specifications of what to build. We argue that current benchmarks are compaction-friendly: i.e., the objective is fixed and the agent's progress stays on disk, so most of what compaction discards can be recovered, except constraints that don't exist anywhere else.

translation.title: 基准测试出人意料地对上下文压缩友好
translation.abstract: 长时程智能体任务正推动LLM智能体超出其上下文窗口。为继续任务，智能体脚手架必须释放上下文窗口，这一过程称为上下文压缩。压缩在设计上通常是有损的：智能体可能悄然丢失任务约束、指令或其先前决策背后的推理。尽管压缩是编码智能体脚手架的标准组件，但尚未在现实长时程智能体任务上用前沿模型进行系统研究。以往工作在玩具或合成轨迹上评估较小的开源权重模型。我们固定智能体脚手架（OpenCode），在其中实现五种压缩策略，并在三个长时程基准（PaperBench、ProgramBench、PostTrainBench）上评估三个前沿模型。对于两个1M上下文模型，压缩阈值对任务性能没有可测量的影响，而上下文窗口最小的GPT-5.3-Codex在PaperBench上（以及在PostTrainBench上较不明显地）在较低阈值下表现更差。没有任何压缩方法优于默认的自我摘要，丢弃更多内容的方法会使某些模型损失多达20分，而对其他模型无影响。然而，压缩可能悄然移除任务约束：在ProgramBench上，第一次压缩摘要平均已丢弃约三分之一的任务防作弊规则，且随压缩次数单调增加。在来自SWE-chat的真实用户-智能体会话中，关于智能体应如何工作以及不应做什么的指令被丢弃的频率约为构建内容规范的6倍。我们认为当前基准测试对压缩是友好的：即目标固定且智能体的进度保存在磁盘上，因此压缩丢弃的大部分内容可以恢复，除了那些不存在于其他地方的约束。
translation.brief: 针对长时程智能体任务中上下文压缩的影响缺乏系统研究的问题，在OpenCode脚手架中实现五种压缩策略并用前沿模型在三个长时程基准上评估其影响。

papers.title: Phronix: The Capability-Centric Learning Paradigm for Agents
papers.abstract: Scientific computing increasingly relies on large language model-based agents for performance engineering tasks such as instrumentation, analysis, and workflow porting. However, agent effectiveness depends heavily on the surrounding harness, which typically relies on manually written skills and curated memory. This limits autonomous learning, forcing agents to repeatedly rediscover solutions rather than retain and reuse knowledge from prior executions. We introduce Phronix, a capability-centric learning paradigm that enables agentic harnesses to acquire, validate, and refine reusable capabilities from their own executions. Phronix operates through a predictor-validator-corrector loop: MCP tools and associated skills propose solutions, tool executions validate them, and observed outcomes refine the stored capabilities. It distills every observed interaction into a capability store and researches a failing task rather than abandoning it. First, such learned capabilities solve a recurring task on the first attempt in 93-95% of cases across every model, significantly reducing solution non-determinism and improving reliability. Second, Phronix turns an agent's own execution into 7.6-30.8 durable capabilities per task without user instruction, and creation falls below two once the needed capability exists. Third, warm-start runs consume only 0.38-0.40 million tokens per task, which is three to four times less than a single baseline attempt, while a cold-start costs no more than the baseline. On the 1000 Genome Pegasus workflow, instrumenting a production application for I/O performance analysis, Phronix passes all 11 correctness checks against six for the baseline harness, and also lifts the task solving rates of two cheaper models from 29% and 27% of SWE-bench tasks solved to 91% and 87%, respectively, matching the performance of the most expensive evaluated model.

translation.title: Phronix：面向智能体的以能力为中心的学习范式
translation.abstract: 科学计算日益依赖基于大语言模型的智能体来完成性能工程任务，如插桩、分析和工作流移植。然而，智能体的效果在很大程度上取决于其周围的harness，而harness通常依赖人工编写的技能和精心整理的记忆。这限制了自主学习，迫使智能体反复重新发现解决方案，而不是保留和复用先前执行中的知识。我们提出Phronix，一种以能力为中心的学习范式，使agentic harness能够从自身执行中获取、验证和精炼可复用的能力。Phronix通过预测器-验证器-纠正器循环运作：MCP工具及相关技能提出解决方案，工具执行对其进行验证，观察到的结果再精炼存储的能力。它将每次观察到的交互蒸馏到能力库中，并对失败的任务进行研究而非放弃。首先，学习到的能力使每个模型在93-95%的情况下首次尝试即可解决重复出现的任务，显著降低了求解的非确定性并提高了可靠性。其次，Phronix在无用户指令的情况下，将智能体自身的执行转化为每任务7.6-30.8个持久能力，而当所需能力已存在时，创建数量降至两个以下。第三，热启动运行每任务仅消耗0.38-0.40百万token，比单次基线尝试少三到四倍，而冷启动的成本不超过基线。在1000 Genome Pegasus工作流（为生产应用插桩以进行I/O性能分析）上，Phronix通过了全部11项正确性检查，而基线harness仅通过六项；同时将两个较便宜模型在SWE-bench任务上的解决率从29%和27%提升至91%和87%，与所评估的最昂贵模型的性能相当。
translation.brief: 解决智能体harness依赖人工技能与记忆、无法自主积累复用知识的问题，提出Phronix通过预测器-验证器-纠正器循环从自身执行中学习、验证并精炼可复用能力。

papers.title: CuraLoc: Repository-Level Fault Localization via Planned Code Inspection
papers.abstract: A bug report describes what went wrong, but rarely where the code should change. Existing repository-level localization methods often let language models iteratively decide what code to inspect next, requiring repeated model calls and substantial token usage. We investigate whether these inspection decisions can instead be planned before source retrieval. In this research, we introduce CuraLoc, which first selects candidate files and represents their symbols using compact behavioral and structural descriptions. In a single planning decision, the model jointly selects starting symbols, chooses code relationships to inspect from each, and forms hypotheses about likely edits. Deterministic retrieval collects the requested source for a final ranking informed by those hypotheses, concentrating model reasoning on choosing and comparing code rather than directing each retrieval step. We demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed approach on the SWE-Bench Lite and Verified datasets. On SWE Bench Verified with GPT-5.2, CuraLoc raises Func@1 from LocAgent's 53.8% to 59.3% while using 90.3% fewer recorded tokens, and also outperforms RepoSearcher (56.2%) and Agentless (39.6%) on Func@1. On SWE-bench Lite, CuraLoc achieves a high 83.8% Func@5 accuracy improving on Agentless by more than 15% in relative accuracy. Additionally, CuraLoc supports different model backbones, with strong localization accuracy demonstrated using both GPT-5.2 and GPT-6 Astra. These results provide evidence that repository-level code inspection can be planned effectively without iterative model-controlled navigation.

translation.title: CuraLoc：基于规划式代码检查的仓库级故障定位
translation.abstract: bug报告描述了出了什么问题，但很少指出代码应该在哪里修改。现有的仓库级定位方法通常让语言模型迭代地决定下一步检查什么代码，需要反复调用模型并消耗大量token。我们研究这些检查决策是否可以在源码检索之前进行规划。在本研究中，我们提出CuraLoc，它首先选择候选文件，并用紧凑的行为和结构描述来表示其中的符号。在单次规划决策中，模型联合选择起始符号、选择从每个符号出发要检查的代码关系，并对可能的修改形成假设。确定性检索收集所需的源码，用于最终由这些假设指导的排序，使模型推理集中于选择和比较代码，而不是指导每一步检索。我们在SWE-Bench Lite和Verified数据集上验证了所提方法的有效性。在SWE Bench Verified上使用GPT-5.2，CuraLoc将Func@1从LocAgent的53.8%提升至59.3%，同时记录token减少90.3%，并且在Func@1上优于RepoSearcher（56.2%）和Agentless（39.6%）。在SWE-bench Lite上，CuraLoc达到83.8%的高Func@5准确率，相对准确率比Agentless提高超过15%。此外，CuraLoc支持不同的模型骨干，在使用GPT-5.2和GPT-6 Astra时均展现出强大的定位准确率。这些结果表明，仓库级代码检查可以在无需迭代式模型控制导航的情况下进行有效规划。
translation.brief: 解决仓库级故障定位中迭代式模型导航token消耗大的问题，提出CuraLoc在检索前一次性规划符号选择、检查路径与假设，再由确定性检索完成定位。

papers.title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
papers.abstract: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version. Starting from the LaTeX source, PaperFormalizer transcribes the paper into a dependency graph of statements, audits each statement in natural language for faithfulness, ambiguity and correctness, and then formalizes and proves the statements in Lean against Mathlib, optional domain libraries and the author's personal toolkit. Only the author knows what a statement is meant to say and how a formalization gap in a result is best fixed. The pipeline therefore stops and asks the author whenever a statement admits more than one reading, presents every repair, in natural language and TeX symbols, as a proposal that the author can accept, decline or redirect, and leaves to the author every decision that could potentially change what the paper claims. The output is an annotated and revised version of the paper, a report of the changes, and Lean code in which each declaration is linked to the statement it formalizes. The author's toolkit grows as more papers are formalized, and authors can share their verified papers so that researchers who build on them can reuse their Lean code. By making verified papers practical to produce, PaperFormalizer aims to make research that rests on mathematical proofs more robust. PaperFormalizer runs inside a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) and is available at https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/PaperFormalizer. Papers with Lean code shared by users are available at https://paperformalizer.org.

translation.title: PaperFormalizer：作者在环的研究论文Lean自动形式化
translation.abstract: 即使经过仔细校对的论文，其证明或所陈述的假设中也可能存在小的缺口。我们提出PaperFormalizer，一个基于Lean的agentic流水线，帮助作者发现并弥合自己论文中的此类缺口，并将每篇论文转化为经Lean验证的版本。从LaTeX源码出发，PaperFormalizer将论文转录为陈述的依赖图，用自然语言审计每个陈述的忠实性、歧义性和正确性，然后针对Mathlib、可选的领域库和作者的个人工具包在Lean中形式化并证明这些陈述。只有作者知道一个陈述的本意，以及如何最好地修复结果中的形式化缺口。因此，每当一个陈述存在多种解读时，流水线会停下来询问作者，以自然语言和TeX符号呈现每个修复方案作为提案，供作者接受、拒绝或调整，并将所有可能改变论文主张的决策留给作者。输出是论文的带注释修订版、变更报告，以及每个声明都链接到其所形式化陈述的Lean代码。随着更多论文被形式化，作者的工具包不断增长，作者还可以分享其已验证的论文，使后续研究者能够复用其Lean代码。通过使已验证论文的产出变得切实可行，PaperFormalizer旨在让依赖数学证明的研究更加稳健。PaperFormalizer运行在编码智能体（Claude Code或Codex）中，可在https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/PaperFormalizer获取。用户分享的带Lean代码的论文见https://paperformalizer.org。
translation.brief: 解决论文证明与假设中难以发现的小缺口问题，提出PaperFormalizer将论文转录为陈述依赖图并在Lean中形式化证明，通过作者在环的交互确认歧义与修复方案。

papers.title: Speculative Diffusion is a Tale of Two Tradeoffs
papers.abstract: Speculative decoding is a technique that accelerates the inference speed of autoregressive large language models (LLMs) by sampling from a faster, lower quality draft model. Traditionally, a fundamental characteristic of speculative decoding is that it is lossless with respect to the verifier distribution, guaranteeing speed without sacrificing quality. This differs from recently developed diffusion LLMs (dLLMs), which are notably able to achieve substantial speedups by degrading the quality of their outputs with less diffusion effort. Because diffusion models are able to sample faster than autoregressive models by generating tokens in parallel, they are considered strong candidates for draft models in speculative diffusion. While it is widely understood that diffusion models can sacrifice quality for speed, speculative decoding itself can also be generalized to generate lossy samples faster using more lenient acceptance criteria with respect to the verifier distribution. Presented with the two parameters of diffusion effort and speculative decoding leniency, this paper explores the full achievable Pareto frontier via joint variations of these parameters. Our experiments show that jointly varying diffusion effort and acceptance leniency can extend the speed-quality Pareto frontier over single step diffusion drafting.

translation.title: 投机扩散是两种权衡的故事
translation.abstract: 投机解码是一种通过从更快、质量较低的草稿模型采样来加速自回归大语言模型（LLM）推理速度的技术。传统上，投机解码的一个基本特性是相对于验证器分布是无损的，在不牺牲质量的前提下保证速度。这与最近发展的扩散LLM（dLLM）不同，后者能够通过以较少的扩散努力降低输出质量来实现显著加速。由于扩散模型能够通过并行生成token而比自回归模型采样更快，它们被认为是投机扩散中草稿模型的有力候选。虽然人们普遍理解扩散模型可以为速度牺牲质量，但投机解码本身也可以被泛化，通过使用相对于验证器分布更宽松的接受准则来更快地生成有损样本。面对扩散努力和投机解码宽松度这两个参数，本文通过它们的联合变化探索了完整可实现的Pareto前沿。我们的实验表明，联合调节扩散努力和接受宽松度可以扩展相对于单步扩散草稿的速度-质量Pareto前沿。
translation.brief: 研究投机扩散中扩散努力与接受宽松度两个参数的联合调节问题，通过系统探索二者的组合来刻画并扩展速度-质量Pareto前沿。

papers.title: Free Lunch for LLMs Confidence: The RL Critic Already Knows
papers.abstract: Reliable confidence estimation is essential for trustworthy deployment of large language models (LLMs), but dedicated confidence training stage requires additional data and compute. We ask a fundamental question: what prediction problem does confidence training actually solve? Inspired by prior work on external confidence estimation, we compare self- and external estimators of comparable capacity trained on the same (question, response, correctness) triples. We show that an external model trained solely on a policy's behavioral traces can estimate the policy's confidence as accurately as the policy itself, without accessing the policy's internal representations. This points to a deeper connection with value function learning in reinforcement learning (RL): under a correctness-based outcome, we prove that confidence estimation and critic training are equivalent, both predicting the likelihood that a policy's response will be correct from its trajectory. A simple consequence follows: for LLMs trained with value-based RL, the existing critic can be reused as an off-the-shelf confidence estimator with no additional training or data. The policy remains unchanged, so its task performance is preserved, and the critic provides confidence throughout generation, including intermediate reasoning steps. Across math, code, tool calling, and general reasoning spanning a dozen domains, the reused critic is the best confidence estimator on every in-distribution split and the best-calibrated on 14 of 16, without hurting the task performance.

translation.title: LLM置信度的免费午餐：RL评论家早已知晓
translation.abstract: 可靠的置信度估计对于大语言模型（LLM）的可信部署至关重要，但专门的置信度训练阶段需要额外的数据和计算。我们提出一个根本性问题：置信度训练究竟解决的是什么预测问题？受先前外部置信度估计工作的启发，我们比较了在相同（问题、回答、正确性）三元组上训练的容量相当的自估计器和外部估计器。我们证明，仅基于策略行为轨迹训练的外部模型，可以在不访问策略内部表示的情况下，与策略本身一样准确地估计策略的置信度。这揭示了与强化学习（RL）中价值函数学习的更深联系：在基于正确性的结果下，我们证明置信度估计与评论家训练是等价的，二者都是从轨迹预测策略回答正确的可能性。一个简单的推论随之而来：对于用基于价值的RL训练的LLM，现有的评论家可以作为现成的置信度估计器复用，无需额外训练或数据。策略保持不变，因此其任务性能得以保留，且评论家在整个生成过程中（包括中间推理步骤）提供置信度。在涵盖十几个领域的数学、代码、工具调用和通用推理任务上，复用的评论家在每个分布内划分上都是最佳的置信度估计器，并在16个中的14个上校准最佳，且不损害任务性能。
translation.brief: 解决LLM置信度估计需额外训练成本的问题，证明置信度估计与RL评论家训练在正确性结果下等价，从而将已有价值评论家直接复用为现成置信度估计器。

papers.title: KVStream: Adaptive Parallel Storage Management for KV Caching in Large-Scale LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Long-context LLM serving for agentic, coding, and document workloads reuses prefixes whose key-value (KV) cache outgrows GPU and host memory, putting storage I/O on the critical path of the inference step for retrieving prefixes. A single node-local NVMe absorbs all retrievals, while the parallel file system or cloud file store that nodes already mount carries almost no inference traffic. We cast prefix retrieval as aggregate-bandwidth scheduling across these tiers and present KVStream, a KV cache engine that batches a step's reads, defers writes behind the forward pass, replicates each chunk on every tier, and lets each tier adaptively claim the next unread chunks once it is free. Our performance model shows this routing attains the aggregate-bandwidth bound without prediction or tuning, whereas any static split misses it by a margin that grows as per-tier bandwidths drift or fluctuate. It also predicts that the time-to-first-token (TTFT) gain grows with load, as faster retrieval drains the queue, and disappears when host memory or arrival order keeps reuse in cache. Plugged into LMCache and evaluated on four models, six datasets, and up to 128 GPUs, KVStream retrieves within 5% of the bound, delivers up to 1.49$\times$ higher offline throughput than LMCache, and lowers mean TTFT by up to 6.1$\times$ under bursty arrivals.

translation.title: KVStream：面向大规模 LLM 服务的 KV 缓存自适应并行存储管理
translation.abstract: 面向 agentic、编程和文档工作负载的长上下文 LLM 服务会复用前缀，其 KV 缓存超出 GPU 和主机内存容量，使检索前缀的存储 I/O 成为推理步骤的关键路径。单节点本地 NVMe 承担了所有检索，而节点已挂载的并行文件系统或云文件存储几乎不承载推理流量。我们将前缀检索建模为跨这些存储层的聚合带宽调度，并提出 KVStream——一个 KV 缓存引擎，它将一个步骤的读取批量处理，将写入延迟到前向传播之后，在每个存储层上复制每个数据块，并让每个存储层在空闲时自适应地认领下一个未读数据块。我们的性能模型表明，这种路由无需预测或调优即可达到聚合带宽上限，而任何静态划分都会错失该上限，且随着各层带宽漂移或波动，差距会扩大。该模型还预测 TTFT（首 token 时间）收益随负载增长而增加，因为更快的检索会排空队列；而当主机内存或到达顺序使复用保留在缓存中时，收益消失。将 KVStream 插入 LMCache 并在四个模型、六个数据集和多达 128 个 GPU 上评估，其检索性能达到上限的 5% 以内，离线吞吐量比 LMCache 高出最高 1.49 倍，在突发到达下平均 TTFT 降低最高 6.1 倍。
translation.brief: 解决长上下文 LLM 服务中前缀 KV 缓存检索受限于单层存储带宽的问题，方法是将检索建模为跨 NVMe、并行文件系统等多存储层的聚合带宽调度，通过批量读取、延迟写入和自适应认领数据块实现无预测的带宽上限路由。

papers.title: Ulysses: A Security Harness For Synthesizing Verifiable Web Exploits
papers.abstract: How can an AI agent automatically discover security vulnerabilities in any software repository? Existing approaches use LLMs to generate software vulnerability exploits. However, it is challenging for an LLM to reliably verify its own generated exploits. In this paper, we propose Ulysses, a multi-agent security harness to synthesize verifiable vulnerability exploits for web applications. Ulysses converts candidate vulnerability findings into verified Proofs of Exploitability by iteratively exploring exploit hypotheses and establishing success in independently observed execution effects. We evaluated Ulysses on WebExploitGym, a curated benchmark of exploitable instances from 25 real-world web applications that span 5 languages and 7 frameworks. Ulysses produces verified proofs for 10 of 25 real-world advisories. It also discovered 4 new proofs of exploitability that have never been previously reported.

translation.title: Ulysses：用于合成可验证 Web 漏洞利用的安全测试框架
translation.abstract: AI agent 如何自动发现任意软件仓库中的安全漏洞？现有方法使用 LLM 生成软件漏洞利用，但 LLM 难以可靠地验证自己生成的利用代码。本文提出 Ulysses，一个多 agent 安全测试框架，用于为 Web 应用合成可验证的漏洞利用。Ulysses 通过迭代探索利用假设并在独立观察到的执行效果中确立成功，将候选漏洞发现转化为经验证的 Proofs of Exploitability。我们在 WebExploitGym 上评估了 Ulysses，该基准收集了来自 25 个真实 Web 应用（涵盖 5 种语言和 7 种框架）的可利用实例。Ulysses 为 25 个真实安全公告中的 10 个生成了经验证的证明，还发现了 4 个此前从未被报告的新的可利用性证明。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 生成的漏洞利用代码难以自我验证的问题，方法是通过多 agent 框架迭代探索利用假设并以独立观察的执行效果确立成功，从而合成可验证的漏洞利用证明。

papers.title: SPECMEM: Accelerating Agentic Tool Calling via Live Memory Management
papers.abstract: Tool-calling agents are mostly optimized for accuracy; in deployment, however, their growing cost is latency: every tool call is decoded autoregressively. Speculative decoding accelerates this without changing the output, and retrieved past calls make strong drafts under real use, where each user's behavior tends to repeat. Yet existing systems keep no cross-session memory, or build the draft store once and never update it. We propose SpecMem, a tool-call memory kept alive and managed throughout deployment: verified calls are written back online into bounded per-user stores with LRU eviction, and a side-effect gate defers irreversible calls until verification confirms. On multi-session, multi-user query streams served by three open-weight models, a frozen store steadily loses acceptance while SpecMem holds it: a 27% gap in mean accepted tokens (+11% to +34% across benchmarks, tracking how much novel work arrives after the store is built) and up to 1.74x wall-clock speedup. Ablations attribute the gain almost entirely to keeping the store live; local per-user scoping adds no acceptance but closes a measured cross-user leakage channel, and gating on declared side effects, rather than on retrieval confidence, is what eliminates irreversible mistakes.

translation.title: SPECMEM：通过实时记忆管理加速 Agentic 工具调用
translation.abstract: 工具调用 agent 的优化大多聚焦于准确性；但在部署中，日益突出的问题是延迟：每次工具调用都需要自回归解码。投机解码可以在不改变输出的情况下加速这一过程，而在真实使用中，检索过去调用可以生成高质量的草稿，因为每个用户的行为往往重复。然而现有系统要么不保留跨会话记忆，要么一次性构建草稿库后从不更新。我们提出 SpecMem，一种在部署全程保持活跃并被管理的工具调用记忆：经验证的调用被在线写回有界的按用户存储（采用 LRU 淘汰），副作用门控将不可逆调用延迟到验证确认之后。在由三个开源权重模型服务的多会话、多用户查询流上，冻结的存储会持续失去接受率，而 SpecMem 能保持接受率：平均接受 token 数差距为 27%（各基准上为 +11% 到 +34%，与存储构建后新任务到达量相关），墙钟时间加速最高 1.74 倍。消融实验表明收益几乎完全来自保持存储活跃；按用户的本地作用域不增加接受率，但消除了实测的跨用户泄露通道；基于声明的副作用（而非检索置信度）的门控才是消除不可逆错误的关键。
translation.brief: 解决工具调用 agent 缺乏跨会话记忆或草稿库不更新导致投机解码收益衰减的问题，方法是在部署中在线维护按用户的活跃工具调用记忆库并配合副作用门控。

papers.title: Don't Forget What You Just Learned: Self-Directed Repair Turns Agent Mistakes Into Lasting Lessons
papers.abstract: Intelligent agents should learn from their mistakes so that experience leads to continuous improvement. Yet today's agents recover from a mistake only temporarily: in-context reflections are easily forgotten across sessions and compete for limited context, while full-parameter fine-tuning is expensive and can interfere with existing capabilities. We introduce Self-Direction, a mechanism for agents to learn from mistakes that combines the benefits of temporary in-context retries and policy updates. When an agent fails a task, it reflects on its own trajectory in order to extract a lesson and immediately distills it into a lightweight low-rank adapter. By keeping the original weights frozen, Self-Direction prevents adapter training from overwriting base-model parameters while training additional parameters equivalent to ~0.02% of the base model's parameter count for each adapter. The agent then saves these adapters in a persistent library of lessons, automatically routing them to solve related problems later. Experiments with agents based on open-weight models from the Qwen family across open-ended research (GAIA), tool-use workflows (Claw-Eval), and terminal tasks (Terminal-Bench 2.1) show that our method improves overall success rates by 8.9 to 17.0 percentage points and performs competitively with frontier systems. We find that Self-Direction reduces repeated mistakes across future encounters of a task, nearly doubling the reliability of an agent's corrections. Learned lessons also transfer: a handful of adapters generalize to dozens of new tasks without additional training. Ultimately, this self-directed repair transforms everyday mistakes into lasting lessons.

translation.title: 不要忘记刚学到的东西：自主修复将 Agent 错误转化为持久经验
translation.abstract: 智能 agent 应从错误中学习，使经验带来持续改进。然而当今的 agent 对错误的恢复只是暂时的：上下文内反思容易在会话间被遗忘并争夺有限的上下文，而全参数微调成本高昂且可能干扰已有能力。我们提出 Self-Direction，一种让 agent 从错误中学习的机制，结合了临时上下文内重试和策略更新的优点。当 agent 任务失败时，它反思自身轨迹以提取经验教训，并立即将其蒸馏到轻量级低秩 adapter 中。通过冻结原始权重，Self-Direction 防止 adapter 训练覆盖基础模型参数，同时每个 adapter 仅训练约相当于基础模型参数量 0.02% 的额外参数。agent 随后将这些 adapter 保存在持久的经验库中，并自动路由它们以解决后续相关问题。基于 Qwen 系列开源权重模型的 agent 在开放式研究（GAIA）、工具使用工作流（Claw-Eval）和终端任务（Terminal-Bench 2.1）上的实验表明，我们的方法将整体成功率提升 8.9 至 17.0 个百分点，并与前沿系统表现相当。我们发现 Self-Direction 减少了未来遇到同类任务时的重复错误，将 agent 修正的可靠性几乎翻倍。学到的经验还能迁移：少量 adapter 无需额外训练即可泛化到数十个新任务。最终，这种自主修复将日常错误转化为持久经验。
translation.brief: 解决 agent 从错误中学习易遗忘且微调代价高的问题，方法是将失败反思蒸馏为冻结基座权重的轻量低秩 adapter 并存入持久经验库以自动复用。

papers.title: SWE-Clar: Can Coding Agents Clarify Incomplete Client Requirements and Deliver Greenfield Software?
papers.abstract: Greenfield software development in freelance settings requires coding agents to turn incomplete client requests into working software. This makes requirement clarification essential, yet clients may be unable to provide continuous feedback over long development cycles, and receiving their answers does not guarantee correct understanding of complex requirements. These challenges motivate two benchmark design choices: clarification precedes code implementation, and its effectiveness is assessed through explicit tests of requirement understanding. Guided by these choices, we introduce SWE-Clar, a benchmark grounded in real, high-value client commissions to evaluate requirement clarification and code implementation in this setting. It comprises 100 tasks based on real software development jobs on Upwork, each with at least US\$4,000 in total payments. Each task begins with multi-round interaction between a coding agent and a client agent, followed by separate runs for code implementation with acceptance testing and clarification assessment. For the latter, we construct 512 questions paired with reference answers from real client-freelancer interactions, covering both explicitly stated requirements and those inferred from the conversational context. Both runs begin from the same clarification context but remain isolated, preventing assessment questions from guiding code implementation. Experiments with nine frontier models show that even GPT-6 Astra, which has the highest observed implementation score, achieves a task pass rate of only 67%, underscoring the challenge of independent software delivery in this setting. The dataset and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/upwork/SWE-Clar.

translation.title: SWE-Clar：编程 Agent 能否澄清不完整的客户需求并交付全新软件？
translation.abstract: 自由职业场景下的全新软件开发要求编程 agent 将不完整的客户请求转化为可运行的软件。这使得需求澄清至关重要，但客户可能无法在长开发周期中持续提供反馈，且收到回答并不保证对复杂需求的正确理解。这些挑战促成了两个基准设计选择：澄清先于代码实现，其有效性通过显式的需求理解测试来评估。基于这些选择，我们提出 SWE-Clar，一个基于真实高价值客户委托的基准，用于评估该场景下的需求澄清和代码实现。它包含 100 个基于 Upwork 真实软件开发工作的任务，每个任务总付款额至少 4,000 美元。每个任务从编程 agent 与客户 agent 的多轮交互开始，随后分别进行带验收测试的代码实现和澄清评估。对于后者，我们构建了 512 个问题，配有来自真实客户-自由职业者交互的参考答案，涵盖显式陈述的需求和从对话上下文推断的需求。两次运行从相同的澄清上下文出发但相互隔离，防止评估问题引导代码实现。九个前沿模型的实验表明，即使是实现得分最高的 GPT-6 Astra，任务通过率也仅为 67%，凸显了该场景下独立软件交付的挑战。数据集和评估代码见 https://github.com/upwork/SWE-Clar。
translation.brief: 解决缺乏评估编程 agent 需求澄清能力的基准的问题，方法是基于 Upwork 真实高价值委托构建包含多轮澄清交互与独立需求理解测试的 SWE-Clar 基准。

papers.title: Aligning Large Language Models with Human Feedback: Mathematical Foundations and Algorithm Design
