The components of keys and values along fitted directions carry the transplant effect: copying them alone nearly reproduces the report change; holding them fixed nearly prevents it. Applied during answer generation, the same value directions also change which source supplies the answer, though more weakly and depending on the prompt. Source reporting in this setting thus depends causally on cached state produced while answering. We do not establish general reporting accuracy or a complete interpretation of this state.

translation.title: 上下文还是知识：LLM如何归因自己的答案来源
translation.abstract: 语言模型可以基于提供的文档或其参数化知识回答问题。当之后被问及答案来源时，是什么决定了它们的来源报告？我们通过在答案生成之后、来源问题提出之前对模型的键值（KV）缓存进行干预来研究这一问题。在一个涉及四个模型（7B-32B）的受控事实任务上，修改或删除文档的缓存从不改变报告。相比之下，在问题和答案token相同的两次运行之间移植问答（Q+A）缓存则能转移报告：所有符合条件的报告都跟随供体，而接收方的文档保持不变。在两个较小的模型上，沿事先拟合的方向引导Q+A值，在固定强度下可在四种文档条件下逆转98.9-100%的报告，而范数匹配的随机方向最多翻转1.1%。键和值沿拟合方向的分量承载移植效应：仅复制它们几乎能复现报告变化；固定它们几乎能阻止变化。在答案生成期间应用时，同样的值方向也会改变答案来自哪个来源，尽管效果较弱且依赖于提示。因此，此设定下的来源报告因果地依赖于回答时产生的缓存状态。我们并未确立一般性的报告准确性或对该状态的完整解释。
translation.brief: 研究LLM如何报告答案来源于上下文还是参数知识，通过对KV缓存进行干预和移植实验，发现来源报告因果地依赖于回答时产生的问答缓存状态。

papers.title: Who Verifies the Tools? How Warped Formatters Mislead Agents and Their Verifiers
papers.abstract: Agents and verifiers often rely on the text a tool prints, and that text can misrepresent what the tool actually did, even when the tool's computation is correct. We saw this happen in a production RAG research system used by the Pilsudski Institute in New York, where tool output formatters misled an agent into giving wrong or incomplete information to users. Each tool did its job correctly, but its output omitted search limits, result caps, or identifier namespaces. We also recreated an unlabeled estimate caught in code review before release. We studied whether these formatters misled agents and verifiers and how much the repaired wording helps. We fed tool results to agents using two formatter versions: one with the key omissions and one with all missing details clearly stated. That difference alone changed what the agents claimed and what the verifiers accepted. Unsupported agent claims dropped substantially for three of the four failure types. In one test, verifiers went from accepting incorrect answers 90 out of 90 times to rejecting them 90 out of 90 times. A control showed the verifiers could catch the errors once they were given the missing facts and asked to judge correctness. We include the audit prompt we used with Codex and Claude Code in an exploratory demonstration, written with prior knowledge of our own system's defects. When pointed at an old version of our own system, it rediscovered the defects that were still live and surfaced twelve more we had not catalogued. When pointed at OpenClaw and Hermes, two of the best-known open-source agentic systems, it found warped formatters in both. We opened PRs to fix both, and the OpenClaw fix has already been merged. Practitioners can run the same prompt on their own systems today.

translation.title: 谁来验证工具？扭曲的格式化器如何误导智能体及其验证器
translation.abstract: 智能体和验证器通常依赖工具打印的文本，而这些文本可能歪曲工具实际做的事情，即使工具的计算是正确的。我们在纽约Pilsudski Institute使用的生产级RAG研究系统中目睹了这种情况：工具输出格式化器误导智能体向用户提供错误或不完整的信息。每个工具都正确完成了工作，但其输出省略了搜索限制、结果上限或标识符命名空间。我们还在代码审查中重现了一个在发布前被发现的未标注估计问题。我们研究了这些格式化器是否误导了智能体和验证器，以及修复后的措辞有多大帮助。我们向智能体提供使用两个格式化器版本的工具结果：一个包含关键遗漏，一个明确说明所有缺失细节。仅这一差异就改变了智能体的声明内容和验证器接受的内容。四种失败类型中有三种的无依据智能体声明大幅下降。在一项测试中，验证器从90次中90次接受错误答案变为90次中90次拒绝。对照实验表明，一旦向验证器提供缺失事实并要求判断正确性，它们就能发现错误。我们在探索性演示中附上了与Codex和Claude Code一起使用的审计提示，该提示基于对我们自身系统缺陷的先验知识编写。当指向我们系统的旧版本时，它重新发现了仍然存在的缺陷，并发现了十二个我们未曾记录的新缺陷。当指向OpenClaw和Hermes这两个最著名的开源智能体系统时，它在两者中都发现了扭曲的格式化器。我们提交了修复两者的PR，OpenClaw的修复已被合并。从业者今天就可以在自己的系统上运行同样的提示。
translation.brief: 针对工具输出格式化器省略关键信息而误导智能体和验证器的问题，通过对照实验和审计提示演示了修复措辞的效果，并在开源系统中发现并修复了此类缺陷。

papers.title: Tampered ML: Evaluating LLM Judgment of Machine Learning Research
papers.abstract: One approach to accelerating progress on AI alignment is to automate parts of alignment research itself. Doing so requires systems that can perform reliably on hard-to-supervise research tasks, including identifying flaws in research proposals and evaluating whether a proposed experiment supports its intended claim. To evaluate this capability, we introduce Tampered ML, a benchmark of 1,858 item-pairs, each consisting of an experiment proposal reconstructed from a published machine learning paper and a minimally edited counterfactual that introduces a targeted methodological flaw. Models must identify the more methodologically sound proposal in both presentation orders. A human validation study on a stratified sample estimates that 86% of items are valid (95% CI: 81-91%). Frontier models perform above chance but remain far from reliable (with Opus 5 achieving 77.9% accuracy). They are highly sensitive to the order of presentation and favor flawed designs that appear more specific, transparent, or conventional.

translation.title: Tampered ML：评估 LLM 对机器学习研究的判断力
translation.abstract: 加速 AI 对齐进展的一种途径是将对齐研究本身的部分工作自动化。这要求系统能够在难以监督的研究任务上可靠地执行，包括识别研究提案中的缺陷，以及评估一个提议的实验是否支持其预期结论。为评估这一能力，我们提出了 Tampered ML，一个包含 1,858 个条目对的基准，每个条目对由一个从已发表机器学习论文重构的实验提案和一个经过最小化编辑、引入针对性方法论缺陷的反事实版本组成。模型必须在两种呈现顺序下都识别出方法论上更合理的提案。一项针对分层样本的人类验证研究估计 86% 的条目是有效的（95% 置信区间：81-91%）。前沿模型的表现高于随机水平，但仍远未达到可靠程度（Opus 5 达到 77.9% 的准确率）。它们对呈现顺序高度敏感，并且偏爱那些看起来更具体、更透明或更常规的有缺陷设计。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了 Tampered ML 基准，通过对比原始实验提案与植入方法论缺陷的编辑版本，评估 LLM 识别机器学习研究缺陷的能力。

papers.title: ImageRSI: Verification-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Image Generation
papers.abstract: Complex text-to-image requests remain difficult to satisfy reliably. Verifying and repairing an image can fix an individual output, but a successful repair does not necessarily carry over to other requests. We present ImageRSI, a framework that keeps the image generator frozen and combines three components: five-dimensional verification and repair within each task, an experience library shared across tasks, and offline updating of the judge. Candidate experiences enter the library only after paired A/B validation, and the judge is updated with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on accumulated image-judgment records and evaluated before reuse. We also introduce ImageReq-Bench, a benchmark of 961 requests built around hard cases in real-world image-generation requests, each paired with an evaluation checklist. ImageRSI achieves a Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA) of 52.6% on MindBench (with Nano Banana Pro as the generator) and 65.66% on ImageReq-Bench, and we compare system outcomes across judge-training configurations.

translation.title: ImageRSI：面向智能体图像生成的验证驱动递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 复杂的文生图请求仍然难以可靠地满足。验证并修复一张图像可以修正单个输出，但一次成功的修复并不一定能迁移到其他请求上。我们提出 ImageRSI，一个保持图像生成器冻结的框架，它结合了三个组件：任务内的五维验证与修复、跨任务共享的经验库，以及评判器的离线更新。候选经验只有在经过成对 A/B 验证后才会进入经验库，评判器则基于积累的图像评判记录，通过监督微调和 GRPO 进行更新，并在复用前进行评估。我们还推出了 ImageReq-Bench，一个包含 961 个请求的基准，围绕真实世界图像生成请求中的困难案例构建，每个请求都配有评估清单。ImageRSI 在 MindBench 上（以 Nano Banana Pro 作为生成器）达到 52.6% 的 Checklist Strict Accuracy（CSA），在 ImageReq-Bench 上达到 65.66%，并比较了不同评判器训练配置下的系统表现。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 ImageRSI 框架，通过任务内验证修复、跨任务经验库和离线更新的评判器，实现图像生成器的递归自我改进。

papers.title: Semantically Rich, Metrically Affect-Blind: A Geometric Blind Spot in Modern Text Embedders
papers.abstract: We report a systematic dissociation in modern text embedders: sentiment is almost perfectly decodable from their embeddings, yet almost entirely absent from their metric. Across eleven frozen encoders spanning 2021 to 2026, including 2026-generation models and the 4B-parameter LLM embedder Qwen3-Embedding-4B, a linear probe recovers sentence polarity at up to 91.3% accuracy while cosine similarity separates polarity by a margin of only 0.003-0.064. Qwen3-Embedding-4B, the strongest probe in the panel, reaches 91.3% probe accuracy but only 64.3 retrieval MAP. Because retrieval, clustering, deduplication, and retrieval-augmented generation operate on the metric rather than on a trained probe, these systems are effectively blind to information their encoder demonstrably contains. A task-conditioning control suggests this reflects the pretraining objective rather than a prompting artifact: conditioning Jina-v5 on its classification task rather than its retrieval task recovers only about half of the MAP gain that injection achieves on the same weights (63.2 to 73.8, versus 85.1), and leaves the alignment gap essentially unchanged. Sentiment-Injected Sentence Embeddings (SISE) train a small (0.13M-0.69M-parameter) supervised-contrastive head on a frozen encoder in seconds on a CPU, using the labelled training set. The head improves every encoder released since 2022 on full-data probe accuracy (up to +5.8 points), retrieval MAP (up to +26.0) and polarity margin (7-61x). This is a specialization, not a free gain: the compact 128-d head loses 38-41 Spearman points on STS-B, while a fused variant that concatenates it with the base embedding loses 2.4-12.0. With the head, a 0.6B encoder at 128 dimensions matches a 4B encoder given the same head (91.8 vs. 90.3 MAP). We release a CPU-reproducible pipeline and a reusable diagnostic, the Attribute Alignment Gap.

translation.title: 语义丰富、度量上情感盲区：现代文本嵌入器的几何盲点
translation.abstract: 我们报告了现代文本嵌入器中的一种系统性分离现象：情感几乎可以从其嵌入中完美解码，却几乎完全不在其度量中体现。在涵盖 2021 至 2026 年的十一个冻结编码器上，包括 2026 年代模型和 4B 参数的 LLM 嵌入器 Qwen3-Embedding-4B，线性探针能以高达 91.3% 的准确率恢复句子极性，而余弦相似度区分极性的差距仅为 0.003-0.064。Qwen3-Embedding-4B 是该组中探针最强的模型，达到 91.3% 的探针准确率，但检索 MAP 仅为 64.3。由于检索、聚类、去重和检索增强生成都作用于度量而非训练好的探针，这些系统实际上对其编码器明确包含的信息视而不见。任务条件化控制实验表明这反映的是预训练目标而非提示伪影：将 Jina-v5 条件化到其分类任务而非检索任务上，只能恢复注入方法在相同权重上所获 MAP 增益的一半左右（63.2 到 73.8，而注入为 85.1），且对齐差距基本不变。Sentiment-Injected Sentence Embeddings（SISE）在冻结编码器上训练一个小型（0.13M-0.69M 参数）监督对比头，在 CPU 上几秒钟即可完成，使用带标签的训练集。该头提升了 2022 年以来发布的所有编码器的全量数据探针准确率（最高 +5.8 分）、检索 MAP（最高 +26.0）和极性差距（7-61 倍）。这是一种特化而非免费收益：紧凑的 128 维头在 STS-B 上损失 38-41 个 Spearman 分数，而将其与基础嵌入拼接的融合变体损失 2.4-12.0。使用该头后，一个 128 维的 0.6B 编码器可以匹敌使用相同头的 4B 编码器（91.8 对 90.3 MAP）。我们发布了 CPU 可复现的流水线和一个可复用的诊断指标——属性对齐差距（Attribute Alignment Gap）。
translation.brief: 该论文发现现代文本嵌入器的度量空间对情感信息存在盲区，并提出 SISE 方法，通过在冻结编码器上训练小型监督对比头来注入情感能力。

papers.title: From Noisy Retrieval to Decision Evidence: Silver Evidence Demonstrations for In-Context Learning
papers.abstract: RAG and retrieval-augmented few-shot ICL can struggle when decision-relevant evidence is buried in long, noisy context. Retrieved passages and demonstrations may contain redundant or distracting information. Although expert-labeled development examples may identify the text supporting each decision, these annotations are typically used only as answer-side rationales rather than as supervision for filtering noisy retrieval. We propose silver-evidence demonstrations, which replace raw retrieved passages in ICL examples with generated, target-conditioned evidence summaries. For each labeled development example, an LLM generates silver evidence without access to the expert label or gold evidence; this evidence is then paired with the expert label and gold evidence where available. At test time, a single structured call generates silver evidence from retrieved passages and then predicts the final label and decision evidence. Across EI 2.0, SciFact, synthetic policy retrieval, and HICRIC/IMR data, our full method improves over equally sized gold-only ICL (label-only for policy) on three of four datasets and improves evidence F1 on all annotated datasets. It also achieves higher mean label accuracy than InstructRAG-style ICL on all four datasets. These results suggest that replacing demonstration-side retrieved passages with compact, target-conditioned silver evidence is particularly useful for decisions based on long and noisy text, where it reduces distracting context while preserving decision-relevant signals and expert supervision.

translation.title: 从噪声检索到决策证据：用于上下文学习的银证据示例
translation.abstract: 当决策相关证据被埋在冗长、嘈杂的上下文中时，RAG 和检索增强的少样本 ICL 可能表现不佳。检索到的段落和示例可能包含冗余或干扰信息。尽管专家标注的开发样本可以识别支持每个决策的文本，但这些标注通常仅被用作答案侧的理由，而非用于过滤噪声检索的监督信号。我们提出银证据示例，用生成的、以目标为条件的证据摘要替换 ICL 示例中的原始检索段落。对于每个带标签的开发样本，LLM 在无法访问专家标签或金标准证据的情况下生成银证据；随后将该证据与专家标签以及可用的金标准证据配对。在测试时，通过一次结构化调用从检索段落生成银证据，然后预测最终标签和决策证据。在 EI 2.0、SciFact、合成政策检索和 HICRIC/IMR 数据上，我们的完整方法在四个数据集中的三个上优于同等规模的仅金标准 ICL（政策数据集上为仅标签），并在所有有标注的数据集上提升了证据 F1。它还在所有四个数据集上取得了比 InstructRAG 风格 ICL 更高的平均标签准确率。这些结果表明，用紧凑的、以目标为条件的银证据替换示例侧的检索段落，对于基于冗长嘈杂文本的决策尤为有用，因为它在保留决策相关信号和专家监督的同时减少了干扰性上下文。
translation.brief: 该论文提出银证据示例方法，用 LLM 生成的目标条件证据摘要替换 ICL 示例中的原始检索段落，以过滤噪声上下文并提升决策准确率。

papers.title: Shorter Is Not Cheaper: A Controlled Comparison of Declarative Animation Specifications and Free-Form Code for LLM-Generated Explanations
papers.abstract: Chat assistants increasingly answer conceptual questions with interactive, animated explanations, generated either as free-form HTML/JavaScript or as declarative specifications that a fixed runtime plays. The declarative route is widely expected to be cheaper, faster and more reliable, because its outputs are shorter and constrained. We test this expectation in controlled comparisons whose hypotheses and analysis plans were frozen before the runs. We designed ExplainSpec, a time-indexed declarative animation format, and an observation contract that makes every generated explanation programmatically inspectable; validated, pacing-agnostic checkers score 20 explanation requests from five domains. Three Claude models (360 jobs) and, in a follow-up, the open-weight Qwen3-14B with thinking enabled and disabled (240 jobs) answered every request in both formats. For every model the specifications were 25-48% shorter in answer tokens (output excluding reasoning), yet with reasoning enabled total output fell significantly only for the largest Claude model and no model generated significantly faster. The reasons differed. The Claude models reasoned far more before writing specifications (exploratory; for the two larger models, from 15-20% to 85-88% of generations). Qwen3-14B reasoned about as much in both formats (a pre-registered test of this shift was not supported), and its shorter answers saved little against a reasoning trace more than twice as long. Nor were specifications more reliable: free-form pages were valid after one repair round in 95-100% of jobs for every model, whereas Qwen3-14B produced valid specifications in only 33% of jobs and passed all semantic tests in 17% (HTML/JavaScript: 62%). For reasoning models, a shorter format alone therefore does not make generation cheaper, faster or more reliable, and a format learned in context can cost reliability.

translation.title: 更短不等于更便宜：LLM 生成解释中声明式动画规范与自由代码的受控比较
translation.abstract: 聊天助手越来越多地用交互式、动画化的解释来回答概念性问题，这些解释既可以生成为自由格式的 HTML/JavaScript，也可以生成为由固定运行时播放的声明式规范。人们普遍预期声明式路线更便宜、更快、更可靠，因为其输出更短且受约束。我们在受控比较中检验了这一预期，其假设和分析计划在运行前已冻结。我们设计了 ExplainSpec，一种按时间索引的声明式动画格式，以及一个观察契约，使每个生成的解释都可被程序化检查；经过验证的、与节奏无关的检查器对来自五个领域的 20 个解释请求进行评分。三个 Claude 模型（360 个任务）以及后续加入的开启和关闭思考模式的开放权重 Qwen3-14B（240 个任务）以两种格式回答了每个请求。对于每个模型，规范的答案 token（不含推理的输出）缩短了 25-48%，然而在开启推理时，只有最大的 Claude 模型的总输出显著下降，且没有任何模型生成得显著更快。原因各不相同。Claude 模型在编写规范前进行了多得多的推理（探索性的；对两个较大的模型，从 15-20% 增加到 85-88% 的生成）。Qwen3-14B 在两种格式下的推理量大致相同（针对这一转变的预注册检验未获支持），其更短的答案相对于超过两倍长的推理轨迹节省甚少。规范也不更可靠：自由格式页面在每个模型 95-100% 的任务中经过一轮修复后即有效，而 Qwen3-14B 仅在 33% 的任务中生成了有效规范，且仅在 17% 的任务中通过所有语义测试（HTML/JavaScript 为 62%）。因此，对于推理模型而言，更短的格式本身并不能使生成更便宜、更快或更可靠，而一种在上下文中学习的格式可能损害可靠性。
translation.brief: 该论文通过受控比较发现，声明式动画规范虽然输出更短，但因推理开销增加和可靠性下降，并不比自由格式代码更便宜、更快或更可靠。

papers.title: Pairing Matters: Performance, Failures, and Efficiency in Lightweight Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Self-hosting coding agents is often necessary for software-engineering teams that must keep proprietary code and development traces within controlled infrastructure. Lightweight, open-weight models make such deployment more feasible by reducing hardware requirements, while strong results on repository-level benchmarks demonstrate their potential for demanding coding tasks. Deploying these models as coding agents requires pairing them with an agent harness, making their joint performance a key deployment consideration. Yet existing leaderboards primarily report fixed harness-model configurations rather than controlled comparisons across alternative pairings. To address this gap, we investigate harness-model interactions through a controlled full-factorial evaluation of six open-source harnesses and three lightweight coding models across 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, producing 1,800 graded runs under common serving, metering, and grading conditions. For the same model, resolution rates differ by up to 44 percentage points across harnesses, while harness rankings change across models. We apply an evidence-based failure taxonomy to 1,100 unsuccessful runs and find substantial differences in failure patterns across harness-model pairings. A model's dominant failure modes under one harness need not dominate under another. Efficiency is similarly dependent on the pairing: even among model-directed loop harnesses, charged tokens per resolved task vary by more than 20-fold. These findings make harness-model selection a central deployment decision for lightweight coding agents. Strong performance with one harness or model does not guarantee similar results with another. We translate these findings into practitioner guidance for pairing selection, token-efficiency assessment, and trajectory-informed harness engineering, and release the complete experimental records and analysis artifacts.

translation.title: 配对至关重要：轻量级编码智能体的性能、失败与效率
translation.abstract: 自托管编码智能体对于必须将专有代码和开发痕迹保留在受控基础设施内的软件工程团队来说往往是必要的。轻量级开放权重模型通过降低硬件要求使此类部署更加可行，而其在仓库级基准上的强劲表现也证明了它们处理高要求编码任务的潜力。将这些模型部署为编码智能体需要将其与智能体框架（agent harness）配对，因此二者的联合性能成为部署的关键考量。然而现有排行榜主要报告固定的框架-模型配置，而非跨不同配对的可控比较。为填补这一空白，我们通过对六个开源框架和三个轻量级编码模型在100个SWE-bench Verified任务上进行受控全因子评估来研究框架-模型交互，在统一的服务、计量和评分条件下产生了1,800次评分运行。对于同一模型，不同框架间的解决率差异高达44个百分点，而框架排名也会随模型而变化。我们对1,100次失败运行应用基于证据的失败分类法，发现不同框架-模型配对间的失败模式存在显著差异：一个模型在某框架下的主要失败模式在另一框架下未必占主导。效率同样依赖于配对：即使在模型主导的循环框架中，每个已解决任务的计费token数差异也超过20倍。这些发现使框架-模型选择成为轻量级编码智能体部署的核心决策。与某一框架或模型配合表现强劲并不能保证与其他配对也有类似结果。我们将这些发现转化为关于配对选择、token效率评估和基于轨迹的框架工程的实践指南，并发布了完整的实验记录和分析产物。
translation.brief: 研究智能体框架与轻量级编码模型配对对性能、失败模式和token效率的影响，通过六框架三模型在SWE-bench Verified上的全因子受控实验揭示配对差异。

papers.title: Beyond Data Schedule: Fast LLM Pretraining on Data Mixtures by Loss-Reweighting
papers.abstract: Large language models often acquire specialized capabilities through successive pretraining stages, but these gains can come at the cost of forgetting earlier knowledge. In this work, we investigate whether such trade-offs can be improved by changing how strongly each domain contributes to learning while keeping its data exposure fixed. We find that, in controlled knowledge--mathematics experiments, loss reweighting produces a single checkpoint that surpasses the best knowledge and reasoning scores attained along either stage trajectory. This reveals an independent control that data-mixture ratios alone do not capture. Building on this finding, we propose LARE (Loss-Adaptive Reweighting under fixed Exposure), which automatically adjusts domain weights from running loss statistics. Motivated by a theoretical analysis of gradient noise, its normalized inverse-square-root rule balances relative loss scales without changing the sampled mixture or requiring additional runs to search for weights. Across knowledge, mathematics, and code, \Method{} improves all five evaluated benchmarks for a 1.5B model trained on 240B tokens, averaging +7.84 pp over a matched direct mixture, including gains of +17.06 pp on GSM8K and +9.00 pp on MATH. These findings demonstrate that adjusting domain loss scales can improve joint capabilities without additional domain exposure.

translation.title: 超越数据调度：基于损失重加权的快速LLM预训练数据混合方法
translation.abstract: 大语言模型通常通过连续的预训练阶段获得专门能力，但这些收益可能以遗忘早期知识为代价。在本工作中，我们研究在保持各领域数据暴露量不变的情况下，改变每个领域对学习的贡献强度能否改善这种权衡。我们发现，在受控的知识-数学实验中，损失重加权能产生一个单一检查点，其知识和推理得分均超过任一阶段轨迹上的最佳得分。这揭示了数据混合比例本身无法捕捉的一个独立控制手段。基于这一发现，我们提出LARE（固定暴露下的损失自适应重加权），它根据运行中的损失统计自动调整领域权重。受梯度噪声理论分析的启发，其归一化逆平方根规则在不改变采样混合、也无需额外运行搜索权重的情况下平衡了相对损失尺度。在知识、数学和代码领域，LARE对使用240B token训练的1.5B模型在全部五个评估基准上均有提升，相比匹配的直接混合平均提升7.84个百分点，其中GSM8K提升17.06个百分点，MATH提升9.00个百分点。这些发现表明，调整领域损失尺度可以在不增加领域暴露的情况下提升联合能力。
translation.brief: 解决多阶段预训练中能力提升与知识遗忘的权衡问题，提出LARE方法，通过基于运行损失统计的逆平方根规则自动重加权各领域损失，在不改变数据暴露的情况下提升联合能力。

papers.title: Rethinking LoRA Initialization for Robust Asymmetric Learning Rates
papers.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is often highly sensitive to learning-rate (LR) choices. Recent empirical studies suggest that, once LRs are carefully tuned, vanilla LoRA can remain competitive with many proposed LoRA variants. This shifts the central practical question from designing ever more variants to reducing the cost and brittleness of LR selection. LoRA+ addresses this issue with asymmetric LRs, using a larger LR for the up-projection matrix $B$ than for the down-projection matrix $A$. However, the ratio $\eta_B / \eta_A$ itself becomes an additional hyperparameter: large ratios can improve adaptation, but under the standard LoRA initialization they can also cause unstable training and ratio-dependent performance collapse. We identify the source of this brittleness through a signal--noise decomposition of LoRA dynamics. Under standard \initA, the update contains an initialization-induced noise term whose magnitude can be affected by the LR for $B$, $\eta_B$, the initialization scale $\beta$, and the adapter rank $r$. In practical LLM fine-tuning, this non-vanishing noise can limit the performance gains expected from LoRA+ style asymmetric LRs. To suppress this effect, we propose \initAA, a simple initialization that scales the variance of $A$ as $\sigma_A^2 \propto n^{-2}$ while keeping $B_0=0$. Under matched rank and training time for both initializations, this reduces the initialization-noise energy by an additional factor of $1/n$, stabilizing asymmetric LoRA training while preserving zero initial adapter output. Empirically, \initAA substantially widens the stable LR region across initialization scales, adapter ranks, and LoRA update multipliers. Across tasks and models, \initAA reduces best-ratio drift, prevents the high-ratio collapse observed with standard \initA, and makes the width-based guideline $\eta_B \approx n \eta_A$ a useful starting point for finite pretrained models.

translation.title: 重新思考LoRA初始化以实现稳健的非对称学习率
translation.abstract: 低秩适应（LoRA）通常对学习率（LR）的选择高度敏感。近期的实证研究表明，一旦学习率经过仔细调优，原始LoRA仍可与许多提出的LoRA变体保持竞争力。这将核心实践问题从设计更多变体转向降低学习率选择的成本和脆弱性。LoRA+通过非对称学习率解决这一问题，对上投影矩阵B使用比下投影矩阵A更大的学习率。然而比率η_B/η_A本身成为额外的超参数：大比率可以改善适应效果，但在标准LoRA初始化下也可能导致训练不稳定和依赖比率的性能崩溃。我们通过对LoRA动力学的信号-噪声分解确定了这种脆弱性的来源。在标准初始化下，更新包含一个初始化诱导的噪声项，其大小可受B的学习率η_B、初始化尺度β和适配器秩r的影响。在实际LLM微调中，这种非消失的噪声会限制LoRA+式非对称学习率带来的预期性能收益。为抑制这一效应，我们提出一种简单的新初始化方法，将A的方差按σ_A² ∝ n⁻²缩放，同时保持B₀=0。在两种初始化的秩和训练时间匹配的条件下，这将初始化噪声能量额外降低1/n倍，在保持适配器初始输出为零的同时稳定了非对称LoRA训练。实证表明，该方法在初始化尺度、适配器秩和LoRA更新乘子的变化下显著拓宽了稳定学习率区域。跨任务和模型，它减少了最佳比率的漂移，防止了标准初始化下观察到的高比率崩溃，并使基于宽度的准则η_B ≈ n·η_A成为有限规模预训练模型的有用起点。
translation.brief: 解决LoRA非对称学习率在高比率下训练不稳定的问题，通过信号-噪声分解定位初始化噪声来源，提出将A的方差按n⁻²缩放的新初始化方法以稳定训练。

papers.title: The LLENS Platform for On-Premises Large Language Model Agents in a Japanese University Hospital: Development and Evaluation Study
papers.abstract: Large language model agents that use tools could take on part of the electronic health record and desk work that occupies physicians' time, but in many hospitals the medical information systems run inside closed networks, so the model and the agent harness must also sit inside. We designed, implemented, and deployed LLENS, a clinical support AI agent platform that runs inside the closed network of Hokkaido University Hospital on one host with 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, the open-weight model Kimi K2.6 (~1 trillion parameters), and a web application rebuilt from Open WebUI. The harness has 10 components, including page image reading, full-text attachment input, a path-addressed document tree without a vector index, a network-isolated sandbox, artifact return, self-checking of generated output, subagents, and saved procedures. Kimi K2.6 was chosen from 3 open-weight candidates and scored 480/500 on the 2026 Japanese Medical Licensing Examination; it generated 119 tokens/s for one user and served 16 concurrent requests at 908 tokens/s in total. On 180 questions over hospital documents (3 seeds each), mean accuracy was 10.7% with no documents, 81.3% with fixed retrieval (top 10 chunks of one lexical search), and 97.2% with interactive access, in which the model reads with document tools and the sandbox (15.9 percentage points above fixed retrieval, 95% CI 10.9-21.3); the difference lay in filtering/counting questions (16.7% vs 87.8%). Five scenarios with synthetic data ran on combinations of the components: needlestick injury response, batch adverse event grading, scanned referral letter transcription, falls data aggregation and plotting, and investigation of 3 topics by subagents. The platform has run on the hospital network since September 14, 2026.

translation.title: 日本某大学医院本地部署大语言模型智能体的LLENS平台：开发与评估研究
translation.abstract: 使用工具的大语言模型智能体可以承担部分占用医生时间的电子病历和案头工作，但在许多医院中，医疗信息系统运行在封闭网络内，因此模型和智能体框架也必须部署在内。我们设计、实现并部署了LLENS，一个临床支持AI智能体平台，运行于北海道大学医院的封闭网络内，使用一台配备8块NVIDIA H200 GPU的主机、开放权重模型Kimi K2.6（约1万亿参数）以及基于Open WebUI重建的Web应用。该框架包含10个组件，包括页面图像读取、全文附件输入、无向量索引的路径寻址文档树、网络隔离沙箱、产物返回、生成输出的自检、子智能体和保存的流程。Kimi K2.6是从3个开放权重候选模型中选出的，在2026年日本医师执业考试中得分480/500；单用户生成速度为119 token/s，16个并发请求总吞吐达908 token/s。在基于医院文档的180个问题上（每个3个种子），平均准确率为：无文档10.7%，固定检索（一次词法检索的top 10片段）81.3%，交互式访问97.2%——模型使用文档工具和沙箱阅读，比固定检索高15.9个百分点（95% CI 10.9-21.3）；差异主要体现在过滤/计数类问题上（16.7% vs 87.8%）。五个使用合成数据的场景在组件组合上运行：针刺伤响应、批量不良事件分级、扫描转诊信转录、跌倒数据汇总与绘图，以及子智能体对3个主题的调查。该平台自2026年9月14日起在医院网络上运行。
translation.brief: 解决医院封闭网络内部署临床LLM智能体的问题，构建并部署了基于Kimi K2.6的LLENS平台，通过交互式文档访问与沙箱显著提升医院文档问答准确率。

papers.title: PersonalQuery-Benchmark:Evaluating Retrieval Robustness to Personalized User Expression Differences
papers.abstract: Existing personalized information retrieval methods mainly model differences in user needs through user preferences and query intent, while paying little attention to the personalized expression differences that arise when different users express the same retrieval need. Existing real query data typically lack stable user identities, long-term expression histories, and intent-matched counterparts, making it difficult to systematically evaluate the impact of personalized expression differences on retrieval outcomes. To this end, we propose PersonalQuery-Benchmark (PQB). PQB models personalized syntactic expression and personalized writing errors from users' historical texts, constructs personalized syntactic expression queries and personalized writing-error queries, and validates benchmark quality through LLM assessment and independent human evaluation. PQB covers three Amazon product domains with 6,516 query instances in total, and is evaluated on five retrieval models representing lexical, learned sparse, dense bi-encoder, late-interaction, and hybrid architectures, together with two LLM-based ranking models. Results show that even when the information need is held fixed, personalized expression differences still induce measurable ranking variation; different retrieval models exhibit clearly different sensitivities to syntactic variation and writing-error variation, while higher overall retrieval effectiveness does not necessarily correspond to stronger robustness against expression variation. PQB provides a new benchmark and evaluation framework for systematically studying personalized expression robustness. The associated code and dataset are available at the following address: https://github.com/cpxjazz123/PersonalQuery-Benchmark.

translation.title: PersonalQuery-Benchmark：评估检索对个性化用户表达差异的鲁棒性
translation.abstract: 现有的个性化信息检索方法主要通过用户偏好和查询意图来建模用户需求差异，很少关注不同用户表达同一检索需求时产生的个性化表达差异。现有真实查询数据通常缺乏稳定的用户身份、长期表达历史和意图匹配的对应项，难以系统评估个性化表达差异对检索结果的影响。为此，我们提出PersonalQuery-Benchmark（PQB）。PQB从用户历史文本中建模个性化句法表达和个性化书写错误，构建个性化句法表达查询和个性化书写错误查询，并通过LLM评估和独立的人工评估验证基准质量。PQB覆盖三个Amazon产品领域，共6,516个查询实例，在代表词法、学习型稀疏、稠密双编码器、后期交互和混合架构的五个检索模型以及两个基于LLM的排序模型上进行评估。结果表明，即使信息需求保持不变，个性化表达差异仍会引起可测量的排序变化；不同检索模型对句法变化和书写错误变化的敏感性明显不同，而整体检索效果更高并不一定意味着对表达变化的鲁棒性更强。PQB为系统研究个性化表达鲁棒性提供了新的基准和评估框架。相关代码和数据集可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/cpxjazz123/PersonalQuery-Benchmark。
translation.brief: 解决缺乏评估个性化表达差异对检索影响的基准问题，从用户历史文本构建个性化句法表达和书写错误查询，形成PQB基准并评估多种检索模型的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Not All Information Is Worth Asking For: Decision-Informed Information Seeking with LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support decisions under incomplete information, where deciding what to look up and when to stop matters as much as the final answer. However, LLMs fall into an information trap: They pay for checks, i.e., costly pieces of evidence, that cannot change their decision or are not worth their cost, and they keep asking when the evidence is already sufficient. To this end, we propose Decision-Informed Value-of-information Acquisition (DIVA), a simple yet effective procedure for LLM information seeking based on the decision value of evidence. DIVA 1) lets the LLM specify a small decision model, i.e., how likely a bad outcome is and how each check would shift this probability, through short numeric questions and 2) values each candidate check by how much its imagined outcomes improve the decision net of its cost, stopping when no check is worth its cost. Its variant, DIVA-U, further accounts for the LLM's uncertain estimates of how strongly each check shifts this probability. DIVA is training-free and applies to any LLM. Across four domains and 20 LLMs, DIVA-U has lower regret, i.e., value lost relative to the best possible decision, than every LLM baseline on real-world data, mainly by stopping once evidence suffices, and DIVA cuts the regret of the best LLM baseline by 75% in synthetic scenarios where every check's reliability is given. Code: github.com/seunghan96/diva.

translation.title: 并非所有信息都值得获取：基于 LLM 的决策知情信息获取
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于在不完整信息下支持决策，此时决定查什么、何时停止与最终答案同等重要。然而 LLM 会陷入信息陷阱：它们为无法改变决策或不值得付出代价的检查（即昂贵的证据）付费，并且在证据已经充分时仍继续询问。为此，我们提出决策知情信息价值获取（DIVA），一种基于证据决策价值的简单而有效的 LLM 信息获取方法。DIVA 1) 让 LLM 通过简短的数值问题指定一个小的决策模型，即坏结果的可能性以及每次检查会如何改变该概率；2) 通过想象各候选检查的结果对决策的净改善（扣除成本）来为每次检查赋值，当没有检查值得其成本时停止。其变体 DIVA-U 进一步考虑了 LLM 对每次检查改变概率强度估计的不确定性。DIVA 无需训练，适用于任何 LLM。在四个领域和 20 个 LLM 上，DIVA-U 在真实数据上的后悔值（即相对于最优决策损失的价值）低于所有 LLM 基线，主要得益于在证据充分时及时停止；在每次检查可靠性已知的合成场景中，DIVA 将最佳 LLM 基线的后悔值降低了 75%。代码：github.com/seunghan96/diva。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 在信息获取中为无价值证据付费且不知何时停止的问题，核心方法是通过让 LLM 构建小型决策模型并按证据对决策的净价值（扣除成本）来评估和选择检查。

papers.title: Markets of Minds: A 51-Billion-State Economy of Intelligence
papers.abstract: When intelligence is shared, reasoning becomes a constrained allocation problem. In a population of agents with limited access to expert models, an intervention can benefit its recipient yet still be a poor use of shared capacity if another feasible intervention has greater expected value. Assistance must therefore be evaluated through both its marginal benefit and the opportunity cost induced by budgets, access, scarcity, and service capacity. To this end, we introduce Markets of Minds, a framework for allocating expert reasoning across agents before expert outputs are observed. For each feasible agent-service pair, the framework estimates the expected gain from assistance relative to the agent's default continuation, explicitly separating repair benefit from regression risk, and jointly clears assistance contracts under shared resource constraints. We then study this problem in a dependency-aware agent economy with 51.2 billion addressable persona-market states spanning capabilities, cognitive budgets, provider access, scarcity, and network roles. These dependencies couple allocation feasibility across agents rather than the outcome of a fixed contract. Empirically, in a matched replay of 240 cases under a common 30% assistance quota, the frozen allocator reaches 85.42% task-level persona adherence versus 73.86% for equal-capacity random allocation, a gain of 11.56 percentage points. The results show that assistance value is heterogeneous and can be negative, and that scarcity changes which interventions are worth purchasing. Together, these findings motivate a population-level view of intelligence where the value of assistance depends not only on what it can achieve, but also on which alternative uses of scarce cognitive capacity it displaces.

translation.title: 心智市场：一个 512 亿状态的智能经济
translation.abstract: 当智能被共享时，推理成为一个受约束的分配问题。在一个对专家模型访问受限的智能体群体中，某项干预可能对其接收者有益，但如果存在另一个期望价值更高的可行干预，它仍是对共享容量的糟糕使用。因此，援助必须通过其边际效益以及由预算、访问权限、稀缺性和服务容量引起的机会成本来评估。为此，我们提出 Markets of Minds，一个在观察到专家输出之前跨智能体分配专家推理的框架。对于每个可行的智能体-服务对，该框架估计援助相对于智能体默认延续路径的期望收益，显式区分修复收益与退化风险，并在共享资源约束下联合清算援助合约。随后我们在一个依赖感知的智能体经济中研究该问题，该经济涵盖 512 亿个可寻址的 persona-市场状态，涉及能力、认知预算、提供商访问、稀缺性和网络角色。这些依赖将分配可行性在智能体间耦合，而非固定合约的结果。实证上，在共同 30% 援助配额下对 240 个案例的匹配重放中，冻结分配器达到 85.42% 的任务级 persona 遵循度，而等容量随机分配为 73.86%，提升 11.56 个百分点。结果表明援助价值是异质的且可能为负，稀缺性会改变哪些干预值得购买。这些发现共同推动了一种群体层面的智能观：援助的价值不仅取决于它能实现什么，还取决于它挤占了稀缺认知能力的哪些替代用途。
translation.brief: 解决在资源受限的智能体群体中如何分配专家推理援助的问题，核心方法是在专家输出前通过估计期望收益（区分修复收益与退化风险）并在共享资源约束下联合清算援助合约。

papers.title: Collection-Date Assignment Redirects Answers in Temporal QA
papers.abstract: A collection date records when a source revision was acquired, not when its contents changed. Can assigning this metadata redirect temporal question answering despite unchanged evidence? Swapping the question day and following day between two revisions lowers later-reference exact match (EM) by 37.6-51.4 percentage points across five open-weight LLMs on 595 Wikipedia pages, replicated on 128 disjoint pages. Previous-day swaps retain 29.0-39.6-point losses on 497 pages. Seven prompt variants, including explicit ignore-collection instructions and archived-revision provenance, retain the effect. Fictional answers and English month-name question dates show that remembered answers and identical date strings are unnecessary. Matched thinking reduces Qwen3.5's penalty from 30.1 to 11.1 points, while native reasoners vary. Two API LLMs show small Wikipedia swap effects and rarely shift to earlier answers on fictional records. Large swap-induced losses concentrate around the question date; swaps between distant dates have much smaller effects. Adding fields containing one observed acquisition date lowers EM relative to omission in three of five LLMs after correction. The diagnostic isolates metadata effects from changing evidence or missing the relevant revision, and provides a practical audit for temporal QA inputs.

translation.title: 收集日期赋值会改变时序问答的答案
translation.abstract: 收集日期记录的是源版本被获取的时间，而非其内容变化的时间。在不改变证据的情况下，赋予这一元数据能否改变时序问答的结果？在 595 个 Wikipedia 页面上对五个开源权重 LLM 的实验中，将两个版本的问题日期前后对调会使后向引用的精确匹配（EM）下降 37.6-51.4 个百分点，并在 128 个不相交页面上得到复现；前一日对调在 497 个页面上保留 29.0-39.6 个百分点的损失。包括显式忽略收集指令和存档版本来源在内的七种提示变体均保留了该效应。虚构答案和英文月份名的问题日期表明，记忆中的答案和相同的日期字符串并非必需。匹配思考将 Qwen3.5 的损失从 30.1 降至 11.1 个百分点，而原生推理模型表现不一。两个 API LLM 在 Wikipedia 对调上表现出较小效应，且在虚构记录上很少转向更早的答案。对调引起的大幅损失集中在问题日期附近；远距离日期间的对调效应小得多。在五个 LLM 中的三个中，加入包含一个观测到的获取日期的字段在修正后相比省略会降低 EM。该诊断方法将元数据效应与证据变化或遗漏相关版本区分开来，并为时序问答输入提供了一种实用的审计手段。
translation.brief: 解决元数据（收集日期）是否以及如何误导 LLM 时序问答的问题，核心方法是通过在不变证据上对调问题日期的诊断实验来分离并量化元数据效应。

papers.title: Evidence-Grounded SLM Behavioral Prediction Architecture for Future Assistance Use
papers.abstract: Users often exhibit changes in interaction behavior before explicitly seeking assistance, enabling systems to anticipate future assistance use. This is especially important in high-stakes environments, where delayed assistance can have operational, financial, or safety consequences. However, conventional Large Language Models (LLMs) are often unsuitable for continuous on-device behavioral prediction because of their computational and memory demands. Behavioral patterns are also highly individual and device-specific, motivating local processing that preserves privacy and data sovereignty. Small Language Models (SLMs) offer a promising alternative, but their ability to reason reliably over low-level sequential interaction events remains underexplored. This study introduces Evidence-Grounded Local Behavioral Prediction (ELBP), a four-layer architecture combining deterministic interaction processing, dual-view behavioral representation, SLM-based prediction, and evidence verification with abstention. Three instruction-tuned models of 3B parameters or fewer were evaluated using raw, structured, dual-view, and complete ELBP configurations. The best-performing model, Qwen2.5-3B with ELBP, achieved a full-set F1-score of 0.80 and PR-AUC of 0.84, representing a 15.9\% relative improvement over raw-event prompting and 17.6\% over XGBoost, while full-set ECE decreased by 43.2\% relative to raw-event prompting. With evidence verification and abstention, selective F1 increased to 0.84 at 91\% coverage and evidence support reached 96\%. These results show that structured behavioral representation and evidence-verified selective prediction can improve the reliability of behavioral forecasting in SLMs.

translation.title: 基于证据的 SLM 行为预测架构用于未来援助使用预测
translation.abstract: 用户在明确寻求援助之前往往表现出交互行为的变化，使系统能够预判未来的援助使用。这在高风险环境中尤为重要，因为延迟援助可能带来运营、财务或安全后果。然而，传统大语言模型（LLM）因计算和内存需求往往不适合持续的端上行为预测。行为模式也高度个体化和设备特定，这促使采用保护隐私和数据主权的本地处理。小语言模型（SLM）是有前景的替代方案，但其在低层次顺序交互事件上进行可靠推理的能力仍未被充分探索。本研究提出基于证据的本地行为预测（ELBP），一个四层架构，结合确定性交互处理、双视角行为表示、基于 SLM 的预测以及带弃权的证据验证。使用原始、结构化、双视角和完整 ELBP 配置评估了三个参数量不超过 3B 的指令微调模型。表现最佳的 Qwen2.5-3B 与 ELBP 组合在全集上取得 F1 分数 0.80 和 PR-AUC 0.84，相对原始事件提示提升 15.9%，相对 XGBoost 提升 17.6%，且全集 ECE 相对原始事件提示下降 43.2%。通过证据验证与弃权，选择性 F1 在 91% 覆盖率下提升至 0.84，证据支持率达 96%。这些结果表明，结构化行为表示和经验证的证据选择性预测可以提高 SLM 行为预测的可靠性。
translation.brief: 解决在资源受限设备上用 SLM 可靠预测用户未来援助使用的问题，核心方法是结合双视角行为表示、SLM 预测与带弃权的证据验证的四层架构 ELBP。

papers.title: Principia: Test-Time Hypotheses to Principle Construction for Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract: Scientific discovery requires identifying the scientific principles underlying observed phenomena to guide further investigation. As these empirical principles are often unknown in complex discovery processes, they are constructed via a hypotheses-to-principle pipeline to obtain recurring causalities from progressively accumulated observations during test-time discovery. However, constructing this knowledge requires substantial domain expertise, time, and effort, making this translation stage a bottleneck for scientific discovery. To address this limitation, we propose Principia, an LLM-based framework that constructs and continually refines scientific principles at test time. Drawing on how human researchers develop principles, Principia forms comparative causal hypotheses from related inputs and their observed outcomes, then synthesizes recurring relationships across these hypotheses into inductive principles. By applying the constructed hypotheses and inductive principles to the task, it obtains new observations, revises the hypotheses used based on these new observations, and reconstructs principles from the updated hypotheses, allowing scientific knowledge to continuously evolve throughout test-time discovery. Across benchmarks spanning molecular optimization, protein engineering, gene perturbation, and molecular property prediction, Principia outperforms baselines relying on internal knowledge, external sources, or experience summaries, while generating principles that are plausible and consistent with the scientific literature, demonstrating its effectiveness in constructing and refining task-specific hypotheses and principles at test time for scientific discovery. Our code is available at https://github.com/DongkiKim95/Principia.

translation.title: Principia：面向科学发现的测试时假设到原理构建
translation.abstract: 科学发现需要识别观测现象背后的科学原理以指导进一步研究。由于这些经验原理在复杂的发现过程中往往未知，它们通过假设到原理的流水线构建，在测试时发现过程中从逐步积累的观测中提取反复出现的因果关系。然而，构建这类知识需要大量的领域专业知识、时间和精力，使这一转化阶段成为科学发现的瓶颈。为解决这一局限，我们提出 Principia，一个基于 LLM 的框架，在测试时构建并持续精炼科学原理。借鉴人类研究者发展原理的方式，Principia 从相关输入及其观测结果中形成比较性因果假设，然后将这些假设中反复出现的关系综合为归纳原理。通过将构建的假设和归纳原理应用于任务，它获得新的观测，基于新观测修正所用的假设，并从更新的假设中重建原理，使科学知识在测试时发现过程中持续演化。在涵盖分子优化、蛋白质工程、基因扰动和分子性质预测的基准上，Principia 优于依赖内部知识、外部来源或经验总结的基线，同时生成的原理合理且与科学文献一致，展示了其在测试时为科学发现构建和精炼任务特定假设与原理方面的有效性。代码见 https://github.com/DongkiKim95/Principia。
translation.brief: 解决科学发现中从观测到原理构建耗时耗力这一瓶颈问题，核心方法是用 LLM 在测试时通过形成比较性因果假设并将其反复出现的关系归纳为原理、再随新观测持续修正的闭环框架 Principia。

papers.title: SWE-Shift: Evaluating Coding Agents in Evolving Workspaces
papers.abstract: Repository-level coding benchmarks largely assume that tasks and environments remain unchanged throughout execution. In software development, code, dependencies, runtime state, and requirements can change while an agent is still working. We introduce SWE-Shift, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under such mid-execution changes. From the same saved history and workspace, a Clean continuation proceeds without intervention, while a matched Shifted continuation receives a task-relevant update. Success requires completing the current task, preserving still-valid work, and satisfying the applicable state and evidence checks. The benchmark contains 120 scenarios across 12 change families, each evaluated at nine scheduled intervention positions. We evaluate 17 coding-agent systems, all of which have lower Shifted than Clean success. GPT-6 Astra drops from 67.35% to 24.79%, with 20.34% paired success. Tool/session changes and stale evidence yield zero paired success across all systems. Late-position paired success is lower for some systems and higher for others. These results show that success on the unchanged task can coexist with failures to preserve work, recover state, or refresh evidence after an update.

translation.title: SWE-Shift：在演化工作区中评估编码智能体
translation.abstract: 仓库级编码基准大多假设任务和环境在整个执行过程中保持不变。而在软件开发中，代码、依赖、运行时状态和需求可能在智能体仍在工作时发生变化。我们提出 SWE-Shift，一个用于评估编码智能体在此类执行中途变化下表现的基准。基于同一份保存的历史和工作区，Clean 延续在不干预的情况下继续，而匹配的 Shifted 延续会收到与任务相关的更新。成功要求完成当前任务、保留仍然有效的工作，并满足适用的状态与证据检查。该基准包含 12 个变化族共 120 个场景，每个场景在九个预定干预位置进行评估。我们评估了 17 个编码智能体系统，所有系统的 Shifted 成功率均低于 Clean。GPT-6 Astra 从 67.35% 降至 24.79%，配对成功率为 20.34%。工具/会话变化和过期证据在所有系统上均产生零配对成功。后期位置的配对成功率在某些系统上更低，在另一些系统上更高。这些结果表明，在未变化任务上的成功可能与更新后未能保留工作、恢复状态或刷新证据并存。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体在任务执行中途环境发生变化时的评估缺失问题，构建了包含120个场景的SWE-Shift基准，通过对比Clean与Shifted延续来系统评估智能体应对中途变化的能力。

papers.title: Watermarking Diffusion Language Models with Learned Foresight and Balanced Bands
papers.abstract: Green-red watermarks favor tokens from a green list that a secret key derives from the preceding tokens. Diffusion language models, however, often choose a token before its preceding tokens, and the token later shapes its neighbors' green lists. Prior work therefore tilts each choice to raise the expected number of green tokens at its own and its neighbors' positions. Building on this objective, we first learn two components that prior work keeps fixed: vocabulary bands that serve as green lists, separate competing candidates and keep the null distribution exact, and a foresight predictor that estimates how each candidate shifts its neighbors' predictions. Second, we count green tokens as the detector does, once per distinct context-token pair, so repetition earns nothing. On WaterBench with LLaDA-8B-Instruct, each learned component raises the z-score at equal distortion, and their gains are nearly additive. With a strong watermark, ours detects at least 96% of responses at a 1% false-positive rate while matching the LLM-judge score of unwatermarked text. Ours also detects more responses on Dream and as many or more on code and question answering without a significant loss in task accuracy.

translation.title: 基于学习的前瞻与平衡频带为扩散语言模型添加水印
translation.abstract: 绿-红水印倾向于选择由密钥根据前序 token 导出的绿名单中的 token。然而扩散语言模型常常在选择某个 token 时其前序 token 尚未确定，且该 token 之后会影响其邻居的绿名单。因此先前工作将每次选择向提高自身及邻居位置期望绿 token 数量的方向倾斜。在此目标基础上，我们首先学习先前工作保持固定的两个组件：作为绿名单的词表频带（分离竞争候选并保持零分布精确），以及估计每个候选如何改变邻居预测的前瞻预测器。其次，我们按检测器的方式统计绿 token，即每个不同的上下文-token 对只计一次，使重复不带来收益。在 WaterBench 上使用 LLaDA-8B-Instruct，每个学习到的组件都在相同失真下提高 z-score，且其增益几乎可加。在强水印下，我们的方法在 1% 假阳性率下至少检测出 96% 的回复，同时保持与未加水印文本相同的 LLM-judge 分数。我们的方法在 Dream 上检测出更多回复，在代码和问答任务上检测出相同或更多回复，且任务准确率无显著损失。
translation.brief: 针对扩散语言模型因token生成顺序特殊而难以应用绿-红水印的问题，提出学习式词表频带与前瞻预测器，并按检测器口径统计绿token以提升检测性能。

papers.title: SOPO: Socratic Guided Policy Optimization for Span-Level Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained widespread adoption in various natural language processing tasks, but suffer from hallucination issues where they generate unfaithful or inconsistent content. While Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown promising applications in reasoning tasks, its application to span-level hallucination detection is challenged by localization ambiguity, reward sparsity on hard examples, and uncontrolled length inflation. To address these issues, we introduce Socratic Guided Policy Optimization (SOPO), a multi-turn RL framework for robust hallucination detection. The key innovation of SOPO is a Socratic feedback mechanism, where a teacher model guides the reasoning trajectories during rollout by providing indirect hints inferred from the ground truth. This teacher-guided approach enables the model to generate more effective reasoning trajectories for hard examples, thus alleviating reward sparsity. Furthermore, we incorporate Turn-based Advantage Scaling to penalize verbosity bias, encouraging the model to develop efficient and autonomous reasoning capabilities. Empirical results on RAGTruth demonstrate that SOPO (4B) achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing leading proprietary models (e.g., GPT-5) and standard RL baselines, while obtaining higher reported mean scores than GRPO on four out-of-domain benchmarks, with mixed evidence against CAPO. We release our training and evaluation code alongside the 1.7B and 4B SOPO models at https://github.com/patsnap/SOPO.

translation.title: SOPO：面向片段级幻觉检测的苏格拉底式引导策略优化
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已在各类自然语言处理任务中广泛应用，但存在生成不忠实或不一致内容的幻觉问题。虽然可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在推理任务中展现出良好前景，但将其应用于片段级幻觉检测面临定位歧义、难例奖励稀疏以及长度膨胀失控等挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出苏格拉底式引导策略优化（SOPO），一个用于鲁棒幻觉检测的多轮 RL 框架。SOPO 的关键创新是苏格拉底式反馈机制：教师模型在 rollout 过程中通过提供从 ground truth 推断出的间接提示来引导推理轨迹。这种教师引导方式使模型能为难例生成更有效的推理轨迹，从而缓解奖励稀疏。此外，我们引入基于轮次的优势缩放（Turn-based Advantage Scaling）来惩罚冗长偏差，鼓励模型发展高效自主的推理能力。在 RAGTruth 上的实验结果表明，SOPO（4B）达到最先进性能，超越领先的专有模型（如 GPT-5）和标准 RL 基线，并在四个域外基准上获得比 GRPO 更高的平均分，而与 CAPO 相比证据不一。我们在 https://github.com/patsnap/SOPO 发布了训练与评估代码以及 1.7B 和 4B 的 SOPO 模型。
translation.brief: 针对片段级幻觉检测中奖励稀疏、定位歧义和长度膨胀问题，提出多轮RL框架SOPO，通过教师模型的苏格拉底式间接提示引导推理轨迹并惩罚冗长偏差。

papers.title: Democratizing LLM Training with the Edge: Challenges, Systems, and the Road Ahead
papers.abstract: The growing computational power of modern GPU data centers has let a few industrial giants train and deploy large language models (LLMs) on massive amounts of data. Yet the sheer scale of these models and their training data makes centralized development increasingly hard to sustain, and at the same time shuts out smaller institutions that hold relevant private data but lack comparable infrastructure. In this paper, we organize our positions on distributed LLM training around the pretraining and fine-tuning paradigms, covering federated learning, split learning, and decentralized approaches, and we assess their readiness for geo-distributed settings with heterogeneous hardware and unreliable connectivity. We then present a {\em unified} system architecture built around a cloud-hosted parameter server that coordinates heterogeneous clients over outbound gRPC connections, reusing one communication, compression, and fault-tolerance stack for both pretraining and a family of fine-tuning methods. We validate the design with real geo-distributed experiments on GPT-2 Medium and Llama3-1B pretraining across multiple university sites, showing stable convergence under realistic conditions. Finally, we chart the road ahead, identifying open problems that span frontier model support, elastic fault tolerance, adaptive compression, federated alignment, privacy and trust, incentive design, and system--algorithm co-design, all of which must be addressed to make democratized LLM training a reality.

translation.title: 借助边缘实现 LLM 训练民主化：挑战、系统与未来之路
translation.abstract: 现代 GPU 数据中心不断增长的计算能力使少数工业巨头能够在海量数据上训练和部署大语言模型（LLM）。然而这些模型及其训练数据的庞大规模使集中式开发越来越难以维持，同时也将拥有相关私有数据但缺乏可比基础设施的小型机构拒之门外。本文围绕预训练和微调范式组织我们对分布式 LLM 训练的观点，涵盖联邦学习、拆分学习和去中心化方法，并评估它们在硬件异构、连接不可靠的地理分布式环境下的就绪程度。随后我们提出一个以云端托管的参数服务器为核心的统一系统架构，该服务器通过出站 gRPC 连接协调异构客户端，为预训练和一系列微调方法复用同一套通信、压缩和容错技术栈。我们通过在多所大学站点上对 GPT-2 Medium 和 Llama3-1B 预训练进行真实的地理分布式实验验证了该设计，展示了在现实条件下稳定的收敛。最后我们展望未来，指出涵盖前沿模型支持、弹性容错、自适应压缩、联邦对齐、隐私与信任、激励机制设计以及系统-算法协同设计等开放问题，这些问题都必须得到解决才能使民主化的 LLM 训练成为现实。
translation.brief: 针对集中式LLM训练难以持续且排斥小型机构的问题，提出以云端参数服务器协调异构边缘客户端的统一分布式训练系统架构，并在真实地理分布式环境中验证其可行性。

papers.title: Correct Answers, Closed Gates: SolveBind for GUI Agents at the Verification Barrier
papers.abstract: Websites and applications deploy CAPTCHAs and anti-automation mechanisms that use behavioral signals such as interaction trajectories and timing, not outcomes alone, to distinguish humans from automated agents. We call these protected GUI environments, where correctly solving a verification task is insufficient for end-to-end task completion. Agents must turn solver outputs into accepted interactions and adapt execution to runtime feedback under time constraints. We introduce SolveBind, a GUI-agent framework combining hierarchical solving with runtime supervision. A hierarchical solving tree decomposes verification into interdependent Perceive, Ground, Solve, Act, and Verify capabilities. A runtime supervisor grounds action commitments in tool-derived evidence, revises them as evidence arrives, and mediates execution under explicit recovery budgets. Across nine CAPTCHA task families and nine backbone models, SolveBind achieves the highest success rate on eight backbones, outperforming the strongest baseline by 13.3-34.5 percentage points. It achieves the highest success rate on all six AndroidWorld backbones. In a paired GPT-5.5 analysis, MobileAgent produces correct answers but fails dynamic verification on 13 of 90 tasks; SolveBind succeeds on seven of these tasks. With automatic submission, removing binding reduces success from 82.22% to 71.56% and increases latency and token usage. Recovery caps reduce execution cost with a small observed success trade-off: removing them raises success from 82.22% to 83.56%, while increasing latency and token usage to 3.7x and 2.4x their full-supervision values, respectively. These results support evidence-grounded execution control while identifying a success-cost trade-off in recovery and failure boundaries of heuristic submission rules.

translation.title: 答案正确，闸门紧闭：面向验证屏障的 GUI 智能体 SolveBind
translation.abstract: 网站和应用程序部署的 CAPTCHA 和反自动化机制使用交互轨迹和时序等行为信号（而非仅凭结果）来区分人类与自动化智能体。我们将这类受保护的 GUI 环境称为受保护环境，其中仅正确解决验证任务不足以完成端到端任务。智能体必须将求解器输出转化为被接受的交互，并在时间限制下根据运行时反馈调整执行。我们提出 SolveBind，一个结合分层求解与运行时监督的 GUI 智能体框架。分层求解树将验证分解为相互依赖的 Perceive、Ground、Solve、Act 和 Verify 能力。运行时监督器将动作承诺锚定在工具导出的证据上，随证据到来进行修订，并在明确的恢复预算下调解执行。在九个 CAPTCHA 任务族和九个骨干模型上，SolveBind 在八个骨干上取得最高成功率，超过最强基线 13.3-34.5 个百分点。它在 AndroidWorld 的全部六个骨干上均取得最高成功率。在 GPT-5.5 的配对分析中，MobileAgent 在 90 个任务中的 13 个上产生正确答案但未通过动态验证；SolveBind 在其中七个任务上成功。启用自动提交时，移除绑定会使成功率从 82.22% 降至 71.56%，并增加延迟和 token 用量。恢复上限以较小的成功率代价降低执行成本：移除它们使成功率从 82.22% 升至 83.56%，但延迟和 token 用量分别增至完全监督值的 3.7 倍和 2.4 倍。这些结果支持基于证据的执行控制，同时揭示了恢复中的成功-成本权衡以及启发式提交规则的失败边界。
translation.brief: 针对GUI智能体在CAPTCHA等受保护环境中即使答案正确也难以通过行为验证的问题，提出结合分层求解树与基于证据的运行时监督的SolveBind框架。

papers.title: Training an MoE LLM in MXFP4: How We Closed the Gap to BF16
papers.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) in sub-8-bit arithmetic promises substantial gains in memory bandwidth and compute throughput, yet FP4 formats introduce quantization error severe enough to destabilize optimization if left unaddressed. We present ALTO, an open-source training recipe for GPT-OSS-20B, a 20-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts (MoE) model, on the MLPerf Small MoE Training benchmark under the MXFP4 microscaling format. The recipe combines established techniques from Abecassis, Felix et al. [arXiv:2509.25149] (hybrid 1D/2D block quantization, randomized Hadamard transforms, and stochastic rounding) with a simplified weight de-oscillation scheme adapted from TetraJet-v2 [arXiv:2510.27527]. On C4 validation at global batch size 16, MXFP4 + RHT + SR + de-oscillation reaches a validation loss of 3.3350 at 16,128 steps, only 0.007 above the BF16 baseline (3.3283), closing roughly 50% of the gap left by MXFP4 without de-oscillation (3.3418). Measured by steps to reach the MLPerf quality target (validation loss 3.34), de-oscillation cuts the FP4 convergence overhead relative to BF16 from +20.0% to +5.0%. We also report negative end-to-end results from differential gradient estimation, outlier clipping, and macro-block scaling, despite each showing operator-level SNR gains. All experiments use simulated MXFP4 kernels on AMD MI300 hardware and wall-clock speed has not been optimized.

translation.title: 在 MXFP4 下训练 MoE 大语言模型：我们如何缩小与 BF16 的差距
translation.abstract: 在低于8比特的算术精度下训练大语言模型（LLM）有望在内存带宽和计算吞吐量上带来显著收益，但FP4格式引入的量化误差若不加处理会严重到破坏优化的稳定性。我们提出ALTO，一个开源训练方案，用于在MLPerf Small MoE Training基准上以MXFP4微缩放格式训练GPT-OSS-20B——一个200亿参数的混合专家（MoE）模型。该方案结合了Abecassis、Felix等人[arXiv:2509.25149]的成熟技术（混合1D/2D分块量化、随机Hadamard变换和随机舍入），以及改编自TetraJet-v2 [arXiv:2510.27527]的简化权重去振荡方案。在全局批大小为16的C4验证集上，MXFP4 + RHT + SR + 去振荡在16,128步时达到3.3350的验证损失，仅比BF16基线（3.3283）高0.007，缩小了无去振荡的MXFP4（3.3418）所遗留差距的约50%。以达到MLPerf质量目标（验证损失3.34）所需步数衡量，去振荡将FP4相对BF16的收敛开销从+20.0%降至+5.0%。我们还报告了差分梯度估计、离群值裁剪和宏块缩放的负面端到端结果，尽管它们各自在算子层面显示出SNR增益。所有实验均在AMD MI300硬件上使用模拟的MXFP4内核，且未对实际运行速度进行优化。
translation.brief: 解决FP4训练MoE大模型量化误差导致优化不稳定的问题，核心方法是结合混合分块量化、随机Hadamard变换、随机舍入与权重去振荡方案。

papers.title: Financial Context-Rich Strategy for Actor-Critic based Agents: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Stock Trading
papers.abstract: In modern financial markets, more than 3/4th of the large volume trade is executed by algorithmic trading based on advanced trading strategies to attain higher precision and speed than traditional human traders. The conventional strategies focused on price-based indicators are inadequate in capturing the market dynamism arising from real-world events such as social sentiments, political instability, or sudden economic shifts. With the rise of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and data availability, there is a requirement for more efficient algorithms that can incorporate these external factors in trading strategies. DRL has shown potential in simulating real-world scenarios and in simplifying complex decision-making since DRL agents can automate the trading process i.e. executing trades in a manner comparable to human traders. They have shown reliable performance since they can update their policies based on risk and quantitative factors. In this paper, we propose a DRL approach based on partial and deep-infusion of sentimental analysis. It features distinct policy designs of actor-critic-based agents: only policy optimization (A2C & PPO) and policy optimization along with Q-learning principles (DDPG, TD3 & SAC). Our findings reveal, that the agents based on policy optimization combined with Q-learning, significantly and consistently demonstrate improved performance upon sentiment deep-infusion in profit maximization as well as risk-averse trading.

translation.title: 面向基于Actor-Critic智能体的金融情境丰富策略：一种用于股票交易的深度强化学习方法
translation.abstract: 在现代金融市场中，超过3/4的大宗交易由基于先进交易策略的算法交易执行，以获得比传统人类交易者更高的精度和速度。传统基于价格指标的策略不足以捕捉由社会情绪、政治不稳定或突发经济变化等现实世界事件引发的市场动态。随着深度强化学习（DRL）的兴起和数据的可得性，需要更高效的算法将这些外部因素纳入交易策略。DRL在模拟真实场景和简化复杂决策方面已展现出潜力，因为DRL智能体可以自动化交易过程，即以与人类交易者相当的方式执行交易。由于它们能够基于风险和量化因素更新策略，已表现出可靠的性能。本文提出一种基于部分注入和深度注入情感分析的DRL方法，其特色是基于actor-critic的智能体的不同策略设计：仅策略优化（A2C与PPO）以及策略优化结合Q-learning原则（DDPG、TD3与SAC）。我们的发现表明，结合Q-learning的策略优化智能体在情感深度注入下，在利润最大化和风险规避交易方面均显著且持续地表现出更优性能。
translation.brief: 解决传统价格指标策略无法捕捉情绪等外部市场因素的问题，核心方法是将情感分析部分或深度注入基于actor-critic的DRL交易智能体。

papers.title: BiLoCo: Binary Low-Rank Corrections for Post-Training Quantization
papers.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) to FP4 has emerged as a key technique for reducing large language model inference cost, especially on Blackwell GPUs, which offer native FP4 tensor core support. Direct PTQ to FP4, however, still leaves a noticeable accuracy gap. Recent work on SVDQuant mitigates the errors introduced through FP4 quantization for diffusion models by adding high-precision low-rank corrections obtained via SVD. However, this high-precision low-rank correction requires many bits per rank, and it runs on the same tensor cores as the main FP4 GEMM. We introduce BiLoCo, a low-rank correction method whose left and right factors are stored as binary ${\{\pm 1\}}$ sign vectors rather than as BF16 numbers. The signed format uses $16{\times}$ less storage per rank-one component, and since the correction now consists of additions/subtractions, this can be run on CUDA cores concurrently with the FP4 tensor-core GEMM. On 4B--72B LLMs, BiLoCo matches or improves memory-matched SVDQuant for PTQ. We implement BiLoCo on B300 as a fused single kernel, where the FP4 GEMM runs on tensor cores, the bit-packed correction on the CUDA cores of the same launch, and the two are combined in the GEMM epilogue. With batch size $1$, the fused kernel is at most $11\%$ slower than the FP4-only GEMM for every rank up to $512$. At rank $128$, it is at most $20\%$ slower up to batch size $8$.

translation.title: BiLoCo：用于训练后量化的二值低秩校正
translation.abstract: 训练后量化（PTQ）到FP4已成为降低大语言模型推理成本的关键技术，尤其是在提供原生FP4张量核心支持的Blackwell GPU上。然而，直接PTQ到FP4仍会留下明显的精度差距。近期SVDQuant的工作通过添加经由SVD获得的高精度低秩校正来缓解FP4量化对扩散模型引入的误差。然而，这种高精度低秩校正每个秩需要很多比特，且与主FP4 GEMM运行在相同的张量核心上。我们提出BiLoCo，一种低秩校正方法，其左右因子以二值{±1}符号向量而非BF16数字存储。该符号格式每个秩一分量节省16倍的存储，且由于校正现在由加法/减法组成，可以在CUDA核心上与FP4张量核心GEMM并发运行。在4B–72B的LLM上，BiLoCo在相同内存条件下达到或超越SVDQuant的PTQ效果。我们在B300上将BiLoCo实现为融合的单内核：FP4 GEMM运行在张量核心上，比特打包的校正在同一次启动的CUDA核心上运行，两者在GEMM epilogue中合并。在批大小为1时，对于最高512的每个秩，融合内核最多比纯FP4 GEMM慢11%。在秩为128时，批大小最高到8时最多慢20%。
translation.brief: 解决FP4训练后量化精度不足及高精度低秩校正开销大的问题，核心方法是用二值符号向量存储低秩校正因子并在CUDA核心上与FP4 GEMM并发执行。

papers.title: Minimum Description Length Unsupervisedly Separates Law-Grade from Statistical-Grade Knowledge in a Self-Improving Science Agent - and Reveals 86% of Its Own Discoveries Are Statistical
papers.abstract: AI systems that discover scientific relations now generate candidate "laws" at scale, but the bottleneck has shifted from generation to vetting: which candidates deserve belief? We show that a deployed self-improving science agent - one that has admitted 252 relations through held-out prediction courts - already computes the quantity that answers this question: the Minimum Description Length compression ratio used for model selection doubles, when read under discrete accounting, as an unsupervised epistemic grader. The compression-ranked top band of the agent's ledger recovers exactly the canonical laws among its discoveries (vis-viva across seven planets, Balmer/Rydberg) plus cross-measurement identities - enrichment $p=3.6\times10^{-12}$ under a hypergeometric test - with zero counterexamples and physically coherent band structure. The same lens retroactively reveals that 86% of the ledger compresses nothing ($\mathrm{cr}\approx 1$): the agent had been recording statistical regularities, including a learned predictor with held-out $R^2=0.541$ admitted through the prediction gate, under a narrative of compression as the unified value of knowledge - a narrative that was never true for them. We formalize the resulting dual-axis bookkeeping - prediction value ($R^2$) and compression value (cr) as nearly decoupled axes of knowledge - demonstrate its robustness to quantization, and register forward falsifiable predictions. The episode is, to our knowledge, the first measured instance of a discovery agent auditing its own knowledge ledger by an internal measure and finding itself over-claiming.

translation.title: 最小描述长度在自我改进的科学智能体中无监督地区分定律级知识与统计级知识——并揭示其自身86%的发现属于统计性
translation.abstract: 发现科学关系的AI系统如今大规模生成候选"定律"，但瓶颈已从生成转向审查：哪些候选值得相信？我们展示了一个已部署的自我改进科学智能体——它已通过留出预测法庭接纳了252条关系——已经在计算回答该问题所需的量：用于模型选择的最小描述长度（MDL）压缩比，在离散记账方式下读取时，可兼作无监督的认知评级器。该智能体账本中按压缩比排名的最高区间恰好恢复了其发现中的经典定律（七个行星的活力定理、Balmer/Rydberg）以及跨测量恒等式——超几何检验下富集p=3.6×10⁻¹²——且零反例、区间结构物理上连贯。同一视角回溯性地揭示账本中86%的内容没有压缩任何东西（cr≈1）：该智能体一直在"压缩是知识的统一价值"的叙事下记录统计规律，包括一个通过预测门、留出R²=0.541的学习型预测器——这一叙事对它们而言从未成立。我们将由此产生的双轴记账形式化——预测价值（R²）与压缩价值（cr）作为几乎解耦的知识轴——证明其对量化的鲁棒性，并注册了前瞻性的可证伪预测。据我们所知，这一事件是首个发现型智能体用内部度量审计自身知识账本并发现自己过度声称的实测案例。
translation.brief: 解决如何审查AI科学智能体生成候选定律可信度的问题，核心方法是将MDL压缩比作为无监督认知评级器区分定律级与统计级知识。

papers.title: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
papers.abstract: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery. We present RSIHub, an open-source framework for building, comparing, and extending these methods on shared infrastructure. Recipes compose reusable operators and declare mutable resources; RSIHub supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage. Researchers can focus on evolution policy while evaluation stays outside the mutable surface and results remain tied to candidates and evaluation conditions. We instantiate AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA without modifying the framework core, keeping method-specific logic in recipes and operators. We evaluate them with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and $\tau^3$ Banking under fixed model and evaluator configurations. The largest observed overall pass@1 gain is 13.5 percentage points, while method rankings vary across settings and optimization gains do not always transfer to held-out tasks. RSIHub provides a common protocol for comparing evolution policies, inspectable candidate histories, and reusable components for developing new methods.

translation.title: RSIHub：面向智能体进化方法的可组合框架
translation.abstract: 智能体进化方法利用执行反馈来改进提示、技能、工具和编排，但它们的实现往往需要重建相同的实验机制。我们提出RSIHub，一个开源框架，用于在共享基础设施上构建、比较和扩展这些方法。配方（recipe）组合可复用的算子并声明可变资源；RSIHub提供执行、评估、恢复和谱系管理。研究者可以专注于进化策略，同时评估保持在可变表面之外，结果与候选方案及评估条件保持绑定。我们在不修改框架核心的情况下实例化了AHE、Hyperagents、A-Evolve和GEPA，将方法特定逻辑保留在配方和算子中。我们在固定的模型和评估器配置下，使用MiniSWE和Codex在Terminal Bench 2和τ³ Banking上评估它们。观察到的最大整体pass@1提升为13.5个百分点，而方法排名在不同设置间有所变化，且优化收益并不总能迁移到留出任务上。RSIHub为比较进化策略、检查候选历史以及开发新方法的可复用组件提供了通用协议。
translation.brief: 解决智能体进化方法重复构建相同实验机制的问题，核心方法是提供基于可组合配方与可复用算子的共享开源框架。

papers.title: MedCaseAgent: From Multimodal Clinical Evidence to Rare Disease Case Reports
papers.abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in clinical documentation, generating the rigorous, evidence-based reasoning required for unprecedented, atypical, and rare disease case reports remains a significant challenge. We present MedCaseAgent, an end-to-end agentic reasoning paradigm that bridges this gap by synthesizing publication-quality reports from unstructured clinical notes. MedCaseAgent leverages a hierarchical structure, integrating patient-level data mining with iterative, tool-integrated reasoning. By dynamically querying medical literature and knowledge bases, the agent maintains high clinical fidelity and assesses case novelty. The framework is inherently modular, supporting various backbone LLMs in a plug-and-play fashion. To facilitate this research, we release MedCase-150K, a large-scale multimodal clinical case-report corpus, and MedCase-Bench, a robust temporally held-out evaluation suite. We also introduce an open-source model post-trained from Qwen3.5-9B and optimized specifically for this task. Under both LLM-judged and rule-based evaluation, MedCaseAgent outperforms existing general-purpose and specialized medical LLMs and agents. Blinded expert reviews and ablations further support the system's clinical relevance and evidence grounding.

translation.title: MedCaseAgent：从多模态临床证据到罕见病病例报告
translation.abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在临床文档生成方面已展现出潜力，但为前所未有的、非典型的和罕见疾病的病例报告生成严谨的、基于证据的推理仍是一项重大挑战。我们提出 MedCaseAgent，这是一种端到端的智能体推理范式，通过从非结构化临床笔记中综合生成达到发表质量的报告来弥合这一差距。MedCaseAgent 采用分层结构，将患者级数据挖掘与迭代的、工具集成的推理相结合。通过动态查询医学文献和知识库，该智能体保持高度的临床保真度并评估病例的新颖性。该框架具有天然的模块化特性，支持以即插即用的方式使用各种骨干 LLM。为促进这一研究，我们发布了 MedCase-150K——一个大规模多模态临床病例报告语料库，以及 MedCase-Bench——一个基于时间划分的稳健评估套件。我们还介绍了一个从 Qwen3.5-9B 后训练并针对该任务专门优化的开源模型。在 LLM 评审和基于规则的评估下，MedCaseAgent 均优于现有的通用及专业医学 LLM 和智能体。盲法专家评审和消融实验进一步支持了该系统的临床相关性和证据基础。
translation.brief: 解决从非结构化临床笔记生成罕见病高质量病例报告的问题，核心方法是提出结合患者级数据挖掘与工具集成迭代推理的分层智能体框架 MedCaseAgent。

papers.title: "Not" is Not Lost in Translation: A Causal Analysis of Negation Representations in Multilingual LLMs
papers.abstract: Negation occurs in every language, yet its surface realization differs drastically. Despite this, multilingual large language models (LLMs) translate negation robustly, raising the question of whether they share an underlying representation of negation across languages. We study this question in six open models across English, French, Vietnamese, and Chinese, using causal interventions on a synthetic contrastive dataset and a negation translation dataset derived from FLORES-200. Across models, we find strong evidence that negation representations are causally controllable and largely shared across languages. In particular, we show that a contrastive activation direction extracted from one language can induce or remove negation in the others, and directions extracted from different languages are substantially aligned. We further find that negation is represented in sparse features: a single sparse autoencoder (SAE) feature per model suffices to control polarity across languages, while responding selectively to negated inputs. Finally, both dense and sparse interventions generalize to four additional languages and FLORES-derived sentences. We release data and code to support future work: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/negation-translation/.

translation.title: “Not”在翻译中并未丢失：多语言 LLM 中否定表示的因果分析
translation.abstract: 否定存在于每一种语言中，但其表层实现方式差异巨大。尽管如此，多语言大语言模型（LLM）仍能稳健地翻译否定，这引出了一个疑问：它们是否在不同语言间共享某种底层的否定表示。我们在英语、法语、越南语和中文上对六个开源模型研究这一问题，使用对一个合成对比数据集和一个源自 FLORES-200 的否定翻译数据集的因果干预。在所有模型中，我们发现了强有力的证据表明否定表示是因果可控的，并且在很大程度上跨语言共享。特别地，我们证明从一种语言提取的对比激活方向可以在其他语言中诱导或消除否定，且从不同语言提取的方向高度对齐。我们进一步发现否定以稀疏特征表示：每个模型仅需一个稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征即可控制跨语言的极性，同时对否定输入有选择性响应。最后，稠密和稀疏干预均可泛化到另外四种语言和 FLORES 衍生的句子。我们发布数据和代码以支持后续工作：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/negation-translation/。
translation.brief: 研究多语言 LLM 是否跨语言共享否定表示，核心方法是通过因果干预和稀疏自编码器特征分析否定激活方向。

papers.title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation. However, most existing benchmarks focus on model capabilities and overall agent performance, with limited attention to the evaluation of agent harnesses. To address this gap, we introduce TraceTrial-Bench, which organizes harness reliability into seven components covering context, execution, governance, lifecycle, observability, tools, and verification. We construct 95 expert-level, mechanism-oriented tasks with executable or state-based ground truth to support semantically equivalent comparisons while preserving the native behavior of each harness. We design a Trajectory Tracing (TT) module to capture agent execution traces and introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separately assesses agent performance and harness reliability. In addition, we design a Multi-source Evidence Acquisition (MEA) module to provide evidence from the agent context, harness, and execution environment for LLM-based evaluation, and develop a Failure Attribution (FA) module that uses explicit mechanism chains to support attribution at the run level. Across 4 harnesses, 9 models, and 95 tasks, our evaluation of 3,420 runs yields macro-averaged harness scores ranging from 59.8% to 72.0%, while 31.1% of runs achieve task success despite failing at least one harness criterion. TraceTrial-Bench provides an auditable and reproducible foundation for comparing agent harnesses, diagnosing their failures, and studying how harness design interacts with model behavior.

translation.title: Trial by Trace：面向可靠性与失败归因的 AI 智能体 Harness 基准测试
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体越来越多地被用于解决现实世界问题，其有效性既取决于底层模型，也取决于支持其运行的 harness。然而，现有基准大多关注模型能力和智能体整体表现，对智能体 harness 的评估关注有限。为填补这一空白，我们提出 TraceTrial-Bench，将 harness 可靠性组织为涵盖上下文、执行、治理、生命周期、可观测性、工具和验证的七个组件。我们构建了 95 个专家级、面向机制的任务，并配有可执行或基于状态的真值，以支持语义等价的比较，同时保留每个 harness 的原生行为。我们设计了轨迹追踪（Trajectory Tracing, TT）模块来捕获智能体执行轨迹，并引入一个双层评估框架，分别评估智能体表现和 harness 可靠性。此外，我们设计了多源证据获取（Multi-source Evidence Acquisition, MEA）模块，为基于 LLM 的评估提供来自智能体上下文、harness 和执行环境的证据，并开发了失败归因（Failure Attribution, FA）模块，利用显式机制链支持运行级别的归因。在 4 个 harness、9 个模型和 95 个任务上，我们对 3,420 次运行的评估得到 59.8% 至 72.0% 的宏平均 harness 分数，同时 31.1% 的运行尽管未通过至少一项 harness 准则仍实现了任务成功。TraceTrial-Bench 为比较智能体 harness、诊断其失败以及研究 harness 设计与模型行为的交互提供了可审计、可复现的基础。
translation.brief: 解决智能体 harness 可靠性缺乏评估基准的问题，核心方法是构建包含七个可靠性组件和 95 个机制导向任务的 TraceTrial-Bench，并配合轨迹追踪、多源证据获取与失败归因模块。

papers.title: Lifelong Context Adaptation through Bidirectional Memory-Skill Learning
papers.abstract: Lifelong LLM agents must learn from an expanding history of interactions while making each decision within a bounded context window. Memory makes past experience available, but the agent may still need to infer how to solve each new task from the retrieved records. Skills provide reusable procedures, yet may omit the task-specific facts needed to apply them. Because retrieved memory and skills shape the agent's behavior, they also influence the experience available for future learning. We introduce MemCryst, a framework for lifelong context adaptation through bidirectional learning of memory and skills with a frozen language model. Recurring episodes stored in memory support skill creation and revision, and the interactions guided by those skills supply new memory for subsequent learning. Facts retrieved from memory and learned skills jointly form the agent's context, while task outcomes adjust the future retrieval influence of the records actually served without rewriting their content. Across ten settings spanning embodied control, long-document reading, conversation, mathematics, and code, MemCryst leads seven reported comparisons. On ALFWorld, joint serving achieves 63.17% success, compared with 59.83% for memory-only and 50.50% for skill-only serving. Code is available at https://github.com/tianyi0216/Memcryst.git

translation.title: 通过记忆-技能双向学习实现终身上下文适应
translation.abstract: 终身 LLM 智能体必须从不断扩展的交互历史中学习，同时在有限的上下文窗口内做出每个决策。记忆使过往经验可用，但智能体仍可能需要从检索到的记录中推断如何解决每个新任务。技能提供了可复用的程序，却可能遗漏应用它们所需的任务特定事实。由于检索到的记忆和技能塑造了智能体的行为，它们也影响未来学习可用的经验。我们提出 MemCryst，一个在冻结语言模型下通过记忆与技能双向学习实现终身上下文适应的框架。存储在记忆中的重复出现的情节支持技能的创建与修订，而这些技能引导的交互又为后续学习提供新的记忆。从记忆中检索的事实与已学习的技能共同构成智能体的上下文，同时任务结果会调整实际被使用的记录的未来检索影响力，而不改写其内容。在涵盖具身控制、长文档阅读、对话、数学和代码的十个设置中，MemCryst 在七项已报告的比较中领先。在 ALFWorld 上，联合服务达到 63.17% 的成功率，而仅记忆服务为 59.83%，仅技能服务为 50.50%。代码见 https://github.com/tianyi0216/Memcryst.git
translation.brief: 解决终身智能体在有限上下文窗口下如何利用记忆与技能的问题，核心方法是提出 MemCryst 框架，通过记忆与技能的双向学习相互增强。

papers.title: DMAIC-Bench: From Self-Reflection to Self-Restraint for Agents in Multi-Stage Analytical Tasks
papers.abstract: Multi-stage analytical tasks require LLM agents to use intermediate evidence to decide whether to continue, redirect or stop. Self-reflection, in which an agent critiques its output, is widely studied, yet a critique does not show whether evidence changed the next action. We call that capability self-restraint. Existing agent benchmarks largely measure task completion or output quality and leave it untested. DMAIC-Bench evaluates it with 97 seeded tasks across 15 industrial cases in four sectors, built around Lean Six Sigma's explicit statistical prerequisites. Paired counterfactual variants require opposite actions at the same workflow position, distinguishing warranted restraint from indiscriminate stopping. We assess execution traces with a private scorer and final claims through independent expert review. Across 13 models from six providers, execution-level routing accuracy averages 92% on matched GO decisions and 19% on NO-GO decisions, counting any forbidden downstream computation as a route error. Execution traces show agents reporting correct diagnostics before performing analyses that those results disallow. Separately, blinded expert review of the 11 audited agents estimates that reports act on invalid evidence at 47% of reached NO-GO decisions, with an interval from 31% to 61%. Explicit stopping permission helps some models without consistently restoring correct decisions at both GO and NO-GO forks. Sixteen life-sciences tasks in bulk ribonucleic acid sequencing (RNA-seq) and case-control genome-wide association studies (GWAS) show that the same framework can evaluate evidence-dependent decisions beyond industrial workflows. Project code and data are available at: https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public.

translation.title: DMAIC-Bench：从自我反思到自我克制——多阶段分析任务中的智能体
translation.abstract: 多阶段分析任务要求 LLM 智能体利用中间证据来决定是继续、转向还是停止。自我反思——即智能体批评自身输出——已被广泛研究，但批评并不能表明证据是否改变了下一步行动。我们将这种能力称为自我克制。现有智能体基准大多衡量任务完成度或输出质量，而未对此进行测试。DMAIC-Bench 通过 97 个种子任务（覆盖四个行业的 15 个工业案例）来评估这一能力，这些任务围绕 Lean Six Sigma 明确的统计前提构建。成对的反事实变体要求在同一工作流位置采取相反的行动，从而将有依据的克制与不加区分的停止区分开来。我们使用私有评分器评估执行轨迹，并通过独立专家评审评估最终结论。在来自六家提供商的 13 个模型上，执行级路由准确率在匹配的 GO 决策上平均为 92%，而在 NO-GO 决策上仅为 19%（任何被禁止的下游计算均计为路由错误）。执行轨迹显示，智能体在执行其诊断结果所不允许的分析之前，报告了正确的诊断。另外，对 11 个受审计智能体的盲法专家评审估计，报告在 47% 的已达成 NO-GO 决策上基于无效证据行动，区间为 31% 至 61%。显式的停止许可对某些模型有帮助，但并不能一致地在 GO 和 NO-GO 两个分叉点恢复正确决策。批量核糖核酸测序（RNA-seq）和病例对照全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中的 16 个生命科学任务表明，同一框架可以评估工业工作流之外依赖证据的决策。项目代码和数据见：https://github.com/psptpx/DMAIC-Bench-public。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体缺乏“自我克制”（依据证据决定停止）能力评估的问题，核心方法是构建基于 Lean Six Sigma 统计前提、含反事实变体的 DMAIC-Bench 基准。

papers.title: Solvent: Long-Horizon Reasoning for Multi-Step Retrosynthesis
papers.abstract: Multi-step retrosynthesis requires recursively transforming a target molecule through successive reaction steps into purchasable building blocks, and recent work has begun to draw on large language model (LLM) reasoning to tackle the task. In its latest evolution, LLM reasoning has entered the long-horizon regime: models pursue objectives across interdependent steps, interact with environments, and adapt to feedback. This shift has markedly advanced LLM capabilities, as illustrated by breakthroughs in AI-driven mathematical research. At this frontier, we introduce Solvent, an 8B LLM that successfully extends long-horizon reasoning to multi-step retrosynthesis. Through a two-round post-training curriculum, Solvent learns to interleave iterative synthesis planning, external availability verification, and adaptive route revision. Experiments show that, following a $2.1\times$ performance boost from RL, Solvent scores 61.86% across four benchmarks, surpassing mid-scale language models and prior search-based retrosynthesis systems, and rivaling frontier trillion-parameter LLMs.

translation.title: Solvent：面向多步逆合成的长程推理
translation.abstract: 多步逆合成需要通过连续的反应步骤递归地将目标分子转化为可购买的构建模块，近期工作已开始借助大语言模型（LLM）推理来解决该任务。在其最新演进中，LLM 推理已进入长程（long-horizon）阶段：模型在相互依赖的步骤间追求目标、与环境交互并适应反馈。这一转变显著提升了 LLM 能力，AI 驱动的数学研究突破即是例证。在这一前沿，我们提出 Solvent，一个成功将长程推理扩展到多步逆合成的 8B LLM。通过两轮后训练课程，Solvent 学会交替进行迭代式合成规划、外部可得性验证和自适应路线修正。实验表明，在 RL 带来 2.1 倍性能提升后，Solvent 在四个基准上取得 61.86% 的成绩，超越中等规模语言模型和以往基于搜索的逆合成系统，并可媲美前沿万亿参数 LLM。
translation.brief: 解决多步逆合成问题，方法是通过两轮后训练课程训练 8B LLM，使其学会迭代合成规划、可得性验证与路线修正的长程推理。

papers.title: Large-Scale Study of GitHub Copilot Trajectories
papers.abstract: AI coding agents are increasingly integrated into software development workflows. However, most coding agent studies rely on benchmarks similar to SWE-bench, which assume autonomous agents operating in a single trajectory. This assumption does not mirror real-world usage, where developers interactively collaborate with agents. We address this gap by studying human-in-the-loop agent trajectories in the wild, focusing on 7,581 Copilot-authored PRs with publicly accessible session data. We find that 58% of Copilot PRs have no human intervention, and that when developers do intervene, collaboration is brief (median of 2 Human-AI loops). Merged PRs also tend to have fewer initial trajectory iterations than unmerged ones. We also find that the trajectory following the first human intervention exhibits a significant drop of 20.8 iterations and 8.4 min in duration. However, trajectories following later interventions show minimal iteration drops and no significant duration change, signifying that most of the work happens in the initial trajectory. Our qualitative analysis of illustrative PRs explains this pattern: many developer interventions are small, focused requests that Copilot completes in shorter later trajectories. We also illustrate that developers collaborate with Copilot in multiple ways, including delegated work through feedback as well as adding their own commits. However, we find that developers may need to guide Copilot through multiple (sometimes repeated) interventions in the PR, or even across multiple editions of the PR.

translation.title: GitHub Copilot 使用轨迹的大规模研究
translation.abstract: AI 编程智能体正日益融入软件开发工作流。然而，大多数编程智能体研究依赖类似 SWE-bench 的基准，假设智能体在单一轨迹中自主运行。这一假设与真实世界中开发者与智能体交互协作的用法不符。我们通过研究真实环境中的人在回路（human-in-the-loop）智能体轨迹来填补这一空白，聚焦于 7,581 个具有公开会话数据的 Copilot 撰写 PR。我们发现 58% 的 Copilot PR 没有人类干预，而当开发者确实干预时，协作也很短暂（人机循环中位数为 2 次）。已合并 PR 的初始轨迹迭代次数往往少于未合并 PR。我们还发现，首次人类干预后的轨迹在迭代次数上显著下降 20.8 次、时长下降 8.4 分钟；而后续干预后的轨迹迭代下降极小、时长无显著变化，表明大部分工作发生在初始轨迹中。我们对代表性 PR 的定性分析解释了这一模式：许多开发者干预是小型、聚焦的请求，Copilot 在较短的后续轨迹中即可完成。我们还展示了开发者以多种方式与 Copilot 协作，包括通过反馈委托工作以及添加自己的提交。但我们发现，开发者可能需要在 PR 内通过多次（有时重复的）干预来引导 Copilot，甚至跨越 PR 的多个版本。
translation.brief: 研究真实环境中开发者与 Copilot 的人机协作轨迹，通过分析 7,581 个 PR 的会话数据刻画干预频率、协作模式及其对轨迹的影响。

papers.title: Beyond Gain: Measuring Skill Internalization for Agent Skill Retirement
papers.abstract: LLM agents retrieve skills from public hubs that hold up to about 100,000 entries and serve many models. As models improve, a hub must find the skills a given model has internalized, meaning it can do without them, and retire them for that model, yet internalization has not been measured with known reliability. Published rules that compare runs with and without a skill retire on the gain alone. The gain is near zero both for an internalized skill and when neither the model nor the skill delivers the capability, a state we call uncovered. We instead withhold the skill, score the model on a task synthesized from it, and trust a high unaided score only when another model gains from the skill, since nearly half of high scores come from tasks no model benefits from. Under four models, a published gain rule applied with one task per skill removes over half of the uncovered skills. On SkillsBench, 28 of its 31 retirements rest on probes no run passed in full, while retiring on the unaided score costs no detectable reward. Unaided verdicts reproduce across tasks more often than the gain rule's (Cohen's kappa 0.42 against 0.23) but differ across models, so a hub must read them per model. We release 1,251 skills with tasks and item scores under four models.

translation.title: 超越增益：面向智能体技能退役的技能内化度量
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体从拥有多达约 10 万条目、服务众多模型的公共技能库中检索技能。随着模型进步，技能库必须找出给定模型已内化（即无需该技能也能完成）的技能，并针对该模型将其退役，但内化此前从未被可靠地度量过。已发表的规则通过比较有与无技能的运行结果，仅依据增益（gain）来退役。然而，无论是技能已被内化，还是模型与技能都无法提供该能力（我们称之为 uncovered 状态），增益都接近于零。我们改为在扣留技能的情况下，让模型在由该技能合成的任务上作答，并且仅当另一个模型能从该技能中获益时才信任高分的无辅助得分，因为近半数高分来自没有任何模型能获益的任务。在四个模型下，将已发表的增益规则以每技能一个任务的方式应用，会错误移除超过一半的 uncovered 技能。在 SkillsBench 上，其 31 次退役中有 28 次基于没有任何运行能完整通过的探针，而依据无辅助得分进行退役则不损失可检测的奖励。无辅助判定跨任务的可复现性高于增益规则（Cohen's kappa 0.42 对 0.23），但跨模型存在差异，因此技能库必须按模型分别解读。我们发布了 1,251 个技能及其任务和四个模型下的逐项得分。
translation.brief: 解决技能库中技能内化度量不可靠的问题，方法是用扣留技能后的无辅助任务得分（并以其他模型获益作交叉验证）替代仅看增益的退役规则。

papers.title: TGR-EvoDAG: A DAG-based Multi-Agent Code Evolution Framework for Generative Recommendation on Tencent
