papers.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have enabled automated code evolution for algorithm discovery. However, current recursive self-improvement (RSI) research for sequential recommendation faces a dilemma: general-purpose frameworks lack domain-specific feedback, while recommender-specific frameworks rely on linear evolution. Crucially, naively integrating them fails when applied to Generative Recommendation (GR). Unlike end-to-end models, GR relies on a module-cascaded pipeline (tokenization, pre-training, and alignment). In this paradigm, existing evolution methods suffer from: i) cost blindness, squandering budgets by ignoring stage-asymmetric retraining overheads; and ii) short-sighted evaluation, discarding promising upstream innovations that temporarily regress metrics before downstream adaptation. To bridge these gaps, we propose TGR-EvoDAG, a multi-agent code evolution framework tailored for GR. TGR-EvoDAG models code evolution as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) to maintain multiple evolution branches and merge complementary innovations, unifying advanced search with rich GR diagnostic feedback. We further introduce stage-aware cost planning to optimize GPU-hour budgets, and active downstream co-adaptation to navigate temporary regressions and unlock cross-stage gains. On public Amazon datasets, TGR-EvoDAG enables the first autonomous evolution of a complete GR pipeline, improving offline metrics by up to 37.4% and Agent4Rec simulated user satisfaction by 19.7% over the strongest baseline. Furthermore, in industrial deployment on Tencent's large-scale commercial media platform, the evolved GR achieves a 12.16% relative improvement in offline Hit@1 and a statistically significant 0.40% increase in online click-through rate (CTR).

translation.title: TGR-EvoDAG：腾讯生成式推荐中基于 DAG 的多智能体代码演化框架
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体已实现算法发现的自动化代码演化。然而，当前面向序列推荐的递归自我改进（RSI）研究面临困境：通用框架缺乏领域特定反馈，而推荐专用框架依赖线性演化。关键在于，将二者简单整合在应用于生成式推荐（GR）时会失败。与端到端模型不同，GR 依赖模块级联的流水线（tokenization、预训练与对齐）。在这一范式下，现有演化方法存在：i）成本盲视，忽略阶段不对称的重训练开销而浪费预算；ii）短视评估，丢弃那些在下游适应前暂时使指标回退的有前景的上游创新。为弥合这些差距，我们提出 TGR-EvoDAG，一个为 GR 量身定制的多智能体代码演化框架。TGR-EvoDAG 将代码演化建模为有向无环图（DAG），以维护多个演化分支并合并互补创新，将先进搜索与丰富的 GR 诊断反馈统一起来。我们进一步引入阶段感知的成本规划以优化 GPU 小时预算，以及主动的下游协同适应，以应对暂时回退并释放跨阶段收益。在公开 Amazon 数据集上，TGR-EvoDAG 实现了首个完整 GR 流水线的自主演化，相比最强基线将离线指标提升至多 37.4%，Agent4Rec 模拟用户满意度提升 19.7%。此外，在腾讯大规模商业媒体平台的工业部署中，演化后的 GR 在离线 Hit@1 上取得 12.16% 的相对提升，在线点击率（CTR）取得统计显著的 0.40% 提升。
translation.brief: 解决生成式推荐流水线自动化代码演化中成本盲视与短视评估的问题，方法是将演化建模为 DAG 多分支搜索并结合阶段感知成本规划与下游协同适应。

papers.title: 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents
papers.abstract: Humans efficiently process multimodal streams spanning hours to years, building persistent, fine-grained spatiotemporal memories that support reasoning about and predicting long-horizon events. In contrast, existing benchmarks focus on short- and medium-context tasks, and most foundation models struggle to preserve fine-grained information over long horizons. To evaluate and improve long-horizon spatiotemporal reasoning, we introduce the LongVideo dataset and the 4DMemoryBench. LongVideo comprises about 900 hours of video and over 5,000 manually reviewed questions covering visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning across diverse context lengths. We further develop the 4DMemory Harness, which integrates four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and a model-specific retrieval-augmented generation system. Evaluating 13 leading models, we find that standalone foundation models struggle with long-horizon tasks, while the 4DMemory Harness improves all of them by over 50\%. Compared to previous benchmark, the same models exhibit a performance drop of more than 10\% on 4DMemoryBench. We hope 4DMemory will facilitate the development of spatiotemporal agents capable of addressing complex, long-horizon tasks.

translation.title: 4DMemory：基于 Harness 增强的智能体长程时空记忆基准测试
translation.abstract: 人类能高效处理跨越数小时至数年的多模态流，构建持久的细粒度时空记忆，以支持对长程事件的推理与预测。相比之下，现有基准聚焦于短、中上下文任务，且大多数基础模型难以在长时程中保留细粒度信息。为评估和改进长程时空推理，我们提出 LongVideo 数据集和 4DMemoryBench。LongVideo 包含约 900 小时视频和超过 5,000 道人工审核的问题，涵盖不同上下文长度下的视觉、文本和时空推理。我们进一步开发了 4DMemory Harness，它整合了四种互补技能、22 个以上专用工具模型以及模型特定的检索增强生成系统。对 13 个领先模型的评估表明，独立的基础模型在长程任务上表现挣扎，而 4DMemory Harness 使所有模型提升超过 50%。与以往基准相比，相同模型在 4DMemoryBench 上性能下降超过 10%。我们希望 4DMemory 能促进能够处理复杂长程任务的时空智能体的发展。
translation.brief: 解决基础模型长程时空记忆能力缺乏评估基准的问题，方法是构建约 900 小时的 LongVideo 数据集与 4DMemoryBench，并开发集成多种技能与工具模型的 4DMemory Harness。

papers.title: Beyond Final Outcomes: Quantifying Claim-Level Information Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Interaction
papers.abstract: When LLM-powered agents interact, information is repeatedly shared, expanded, and forgotten, yet multi-agent evaluation typically focuses on final task outcomes. We study such interaction as claim-level information dynamics and propose RIVER, which decomposes agent outputs into atomic claims and evaluates three complementary dimensions: convergence, exploration, and retention. Convergence captures cross-agent claim correspondence and stance alignment; exploration captures semantic breadth and extension beyond the source; and retention tracks source preservation and the persistence of new claims across stages and lineages. We evaluate five interaction strategies on 40 controlled news-generation cases. Repeatedly pooled interaction promotes convergence but narrows the information space, whereas distributed relay yields broader, less shared information. Further comparisons show that method-specific constraints increase exploration while weakening convergence and retention. Our findings suggest that collective information dynamics are better explained by underlying information-flow mechanisms than by simple downstream performance.

translation.title: 超越最终结果：量化多智能体 LLM 交互中的声明级信息动态
translation.abstract: 当基于 LLM 的智能体交互时，信息被反复共享、扩展和遗忘，然而多智能体评估通常只关注最终任务结果。我们将这种交互视为声明级信息动态进行研究，并提出 RIVER，它将智能体输出分解为原子声明，并评估三个互补维度：收敛、探索和保留。收敛刻画跨智能体的声明对应关系和立场一致性；探索刻画语义广度以及对源信息的延伸；保留追踪源信息的保持以及新声明在各个阶段和谱系中的持续性。我们在 40 个受控新闻生成案例上评估了五种交互策略。反复汇聚式交互促进收敛但缩小了信息空间，而分布式接力则产生更广泛、共享更少的信息。进一步比较表明，方法特定的约束会增加探索，但削弱收敛和保留。我们的发现表明，集体信息动态更适合用底层信息流机制来解释，而非简单的下游性能。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体评估只看最终结果的问题，提出 RIVER 方法将智能体输出分解为原子声明，从收敛、探索、保留三个维度量化声明级信息动态。

papers.title: SkillRep: Characterizing and Understanding the Representation Design Space of Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.abstract: Retrieving the right skill from a large library is essential for LLM agents, yet requests and skills are written for different purposes and in different words. Existing retrievers narrow this request-skill gap with one or two representation choices each, so it is unknown whether their gains hold in combination. No prior work measures the gap itself, so it is also unclear which part of it each choice narrows. We define a representation design space by five choices -- encoder fine-tuning, query-side and document-side expansion, background projection and a lexical channel -- and evaluate them together for the first time, as modules of one retriever, SkillRep. With a 0.6B encoder and LLM expansion, SkillRep improves MRR@10 on SRA-Bench over the strongest same-size retriever by 7.02 points with the official skill pool and 8.79 with UniPool, a 111,247-skill pool we build from public registries, and is best on SkillsBench. The value of each choice depends on the others. Fine-tuning, for instance, reverses the ranking of the four training-free modules and turns them from complementary into overlapping. To understand why, we measure the gap with three quantities: background, the embedding component that does not separate skills; unsaid vocabulary, the gold skill's content a request leaves unsaid; and dilution, the information lost when a skill is encoded into a single vector. They show which part each module narrows and by what mechanism. This reveals that modules narrowing the same part compete for it, while those narrowing different parts complement each other.

translation.title: SkillRep：刻画与理解智能体技能检索的表示设计空间
translation.abstract: 从庞大的技能库中检索正确的技能对 LLM 智能体至关重要，然而请求和技能是为不同目的、用不同措辞编写的。现有检索器各自通过一两个表示选择来缩小这种请求-技能差距，因此尚不清楚它们的收益在组合后是否仍然成立。此前没有工作测量该差距本身，因此也不清楚每种选择缩小了差距的哪一部分。我们通过五种选择定义了一个表示设计空间——编码器微调、查询侧和文档侧扩展、背景投影以及词法通道——并首次将它们作为一个检索器 SkillRep 的模块进行联合评估。凭借 0.6B 编码器和 LLM 扩展，SkillRep 在 SRA-Bench 上使用官方技能池时，MRR@10 比最强的同规模检索器提升 7.02 分，使用我们基于公开注册表构建的 111,247 技能池 UniPool 时提升 8.79 分，并在 SkillsBench 上表现最佳。每种选择的价值取决于其他选择。例如，微调会逆转四个免训练模块的排名，并使它们从互补变为重叠。为了理解原因，我们用三个量来测量差距：背景（嵌入中不区分技能的成分）、未言词汇（请求未言明的目标技能内容）和稀释（技能被编码为单一向量时丢失的信息）。它们揭示了每个模块缩小了差距的哪一部分以及通过什么机制。这表明缩小同一部分的模块会相互竞争，而缩小不同部分的模块则相互补充。
translation.brief: 针对请求与技能之间的语义差距缺乏系统测量的问题，提出 SkillRep 检索器联合评估五种表示选择，并用背景、未言词汇、稀释三个量刻画各模块缩小的差距部分。

papers.title: From Faulty Claims to Incorrect Patches: An Empirical Study of Task-Grounded Reasoning in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based coding agents increasingly resolve real-world software engineering tasks, yet still fail on many of them. Prior trajectory studies characterize these failures through task-agnostic patterns of agent behavior, such as repeated actions. However, an agent may follow a sound workflow yet act on a faulty understanding of the existing code, the task requirements, or a candidate fix. Reasoning models, which power most state-of-the-art coding agents, reveal this understanding in their native chain-of-thought (CoT), whose claims about the task can be checked against the facts. Yet it remains unclear how many such checkable claims the CoT contains, how many are faulty, and whether faulty claims actually cause incorrect patches. We present the first empirical study of such claims, which we term task-grounded reasoning, analyzing 400 trajectories of four open-weight reasoning models on SWE-bench Pro. We extract atomic claims from the CoT with an LLM, assess them against evidence gathered by an LLM agent, and manually trace the defects of incorrect patches back to faulty claims, confirming each link with a claim-corrected replay. Task-grounded reasoning covers only 18.5% of the CoT tokens, yet yields 191 atomic claims per trajectory, at least 9.6% of which are faulty. Faulty claims also occur in 96.7% of the resolved trajectories, so their mere presence is a weak signal of failure. Yet two thirds of the 188 incorrect patches trace back to faulty claims. Correcting such a claim makes the agent fix the linked defect in 89.0% of the cases, and correcting all such claims resolves 11.7% of the failed tasks. Our findings show that the CoT carries task-specific signals for diagnosing and repairing agent failures, but exploiting them requires pinpointing the few faulty claims that actually cause patch defects.

translation.title: 从错误声明到错误补丁：编码智能体中任务接地推理的实证研究
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码智能体日益能够解决真实世界的软件工程任务，但在许多任务上仍然失败。先前的轨迹研究通过任务无关的智能体行为模式（如重复动作）来刻画这些失败。然而，智能体可能遵循合理的工作流程，却基于对现有代码、任务要求或候选修复方案的错误理解行事。驱动大多数最先进编码智能体的推理模型在其原生思维链（CoT）中揭示这种理解，其中关于任务的声明可以对照事实进行核查。然而，CoT 中包含多少此类可核查声明、其中多少是错误的，以及错误声明是否真的导致错误补丁，仍不清楚。我们对此类声明（我们称之为任务接地推理）进行了首次实证研究，分析了四个开源权重推理模型在 SWE-bench Pro 上的 400 条轨迹。我们用 LLM 从 CoT 中提取原子声明，由 LLM 智能体收集证据进行评估，并手动将错误补丁的缺陷追溯到错误声明，通过声明修正重放确认每个环节。任务接地推理仅占 CoT token 的 18.5%，但每条轨迹产生 191 个原子声明，其中至少 9.6% 是错误的。错误声明也出现在 96.7% 的已解决轨迹中，因此其存在本身是失败的弱信号。然而，188 个错误补丁中有三分之二可追溯到错误声明。修正此类声明后，智能体在 89.0% 的情况下修复了关联缺陷，修正所有此类声明可解决 11.7% 的失败任务。我们的发现表明，CoT 携带可用于诊断和修复智能体失败的任务特定信号，但利用它们需要精确定位真正导致补丁缺陷的少数错误声明。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体失败原因不明的问题，首次实证研究 CoT 中的任务接地声明，将错误补丁的缺陷追溯到错误声明并验证修正声明的修复效果。

papers.title: DeepAVR: Deep Analysis via Multi-Agent Collaboration for Automated Vulnerability Repair
papers.abstract: Automated Vulnerability Repair (AVR) has emerged as a critical defense against software security flaws, aiming to triage and fix bugs autonomously. Early LLM-based approaches focused on patch generation under the assumption of perfect fault localization, while recent end-to-end methods attempt to repair vulnerabilities directly from sanitizer logs. However, these methods often fail when the root cause is deeply hidden--either physically distant from the crash site or logically masked by interdependent errors--making the initial report insufficient. We propose DeepAVR, a multi-agent framework for end-to-end AVR that performs deep analysis by transforming intermediate repair outcomes into structured diagnostic feedback. DeepAVR decomposes repair into specialized roles--Fault Localization, Patch Generation, Compile Validation, Security Validation, Functionality Validation, and Patch Review--and routes feedback across these roles to iteratively refine both localization and patch hypotheses. In particular, DeepAVR introduces patch-conditioned re-localization, which treats execution results from intermediate patches as diagnostic signals to uncover hidden root causes, and a root-cause-oriented patch review stage that detects symptom-level fixes and incomplete repairs beyond execution-based validation. Evaluation on the real-world C/C++ vulnerability repair dataset VulnLoc shows that DeepAVR significantly outperforms prior methods, generating correct patches for 92.3% of vulnerabilities. Furthermore, results on SAN2VULN demonstrate strong generalization, with DeepAVR effectively repairing vulnerabilities unseen during training.

translation.title: DeepAVR：基于多智能体协作的自动化漏洞修复深度分析
translation.abstract: 自动化漏洞修复（AVR）已成为对抗软件安全缺陷的关键防御手段，旨在自主分诊并修复漏洞。早期基于 LLM 的方法在假设故障定位完美的情况下专注于补丁生成，而近期的端到端方法尝试直接从 sanitizer 日志修复漏洞。然而，当根因深藏不露时——要么在物理上远离崩溃点，要么在逻辑上被相互依赖的错误所掩盖——这些方法常常失败，使得初始报告不充分。我们提出 DeepAVR，一个用于端到端 AVR 的多智能体框架，通过将中间修复结果转化为结构化诊断反馈来执行深度分析。DeepAVR 将修复分解为专门角色——故障定位、补丁生成、编译验证、安全验证、功能验证和补丁审查——并在这些角色之间路由反馈，以迭代细化定位和补丁假设。特别是，DeepAVR 引入了补丁条件重定位，将中间补丁的执行结果作为诊断信号以揭示隐藏的根因，以及一个面向根因的补丁审查阶段，用于检测基于执行的验证无法发现的症状级修复和不完整修复。在真实世界 C/C++ 漏洞修复数据集 VulnLoc 上的评估表明，DeepAVR 显著优于先前方法，为 92.3% 的漏洞生成了正确补丁。此外，在 SAN2VULN 上的结果显示出强泛化能力，DeepAVR 能有效修复训练中未见过的漏洞。
translation.brief: 针对根因深藏导致端到端漏洞修复失败的问题，提出多智能体框架 DeepAVR，通过补丁条件重定位和面向根因的补丁审查迭代细化定位与补丁。

papers.title: Why Full-Duplex Speech Models Collapse in Long Conversations
papers.abstract: Full-duplex speech models listen and speak at the same time, which makes them promising for natural, open-ended conversation. But can they sustain a coherent conversation for tens of minutes? Because they generate a token every frame, even while listening, they exhaust their context windows within minutes. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate only single turns or a few conversational rounds, too short to expose the long-horizon problem. We introduce the Full-Duplex Long-Horizon Benchmark (FD-LHB), which tests five recent full-duplex models on long replayed conversations and in live conversation with an LLM partner. Every evaluated model eventually either degrades or exhausts its context. Models that keep the full history often degrade before their context runs out, while sliding-window models still fall into repetition, silence, and gibberish. For sliding-window models, we identify two contributing mechanisms. Gibberish and silence are linked to Initialization-Anchor Eviction, where the sliding window discards the first KV entry. Repetition is also reinforced by the model's own recent outputs. Guided by this diagnosis, we apply two simple fixes: Initialization-Anchor Pinning (IAP) keeps that first entry, and Duplex Repetition Penalty (DRP) discourages echoing while guarding against prolonged silence. Together, they support the diagnosis and, without retraining, substantially reduce conversational collapse in replays of up to an hour while running in real time.

translation.title: 为什么全双工语音模型在长对话中崩溃
translation.abstract: 全双工语音模型可以同时听和说，这使其有望实现自然、开放式的对话。但它们能否在数十分钟内维持连贯对话？由于它们每帧生成一个 token，即使在聆听时也是如此，它们会在几分钟内耗尽上下文窗口。然而现有基准仅评估单轮或少数几轮对话，太短而无法暴露长时程问题。我们引入全双工长时程基准（FD-LHB），在长回放对话和与 LLM 伙伴的实时对话中测试五个近期的全双工模型。每个被评估的模型最终都会退化或耗尽上下文。保留完整历史的模型往往在上下文耗尽前就退化，而滑动窗口模型仍会陷入重复、沉默和胡言乱语。对于滑动窗口模型，我们识别出两种促成机制。胡言乱语和沉默与初始化锚点驱逐有关，即滑动窗口丢弃了第一个 KV 条目。重复还受到模型自身近期输出的强化。基于这一诊断，我们应用两个简单的修复：初始化锚点固定（IAP）保留第一个条目，双工重复惩罚（DRP）在防止长时间沉默的同时抑制回声。两者共同支持了诊断，且无需重新训练，在长达一小时的回放中实时运行的同时大幅减少了对话崩溃。
translation.brief: 针对全双工语音模型长对话崩溃的问题，构建 FD-LHB 基准并诊断出初始化锚点驱逐和自我重复两种机制，提出 IAP 与 DRP 两个免训练修复方法。

papers.title: Adaptive Control of Scientific Instruments with Nonstationary Responses through Multimodal Agents
papers.abstract: Controlling scientific instruments requires parameters to be adjusted progressively in response to feedback from successive operations. When unobserved operating conditions evolve with operational history, responses become nonstationary, and a static mapping from actions to responses becomes inadequate for decisions across shots. Shot-to-shot tuning of neutral beam injection (NBI) ion sources in magnetic confinement fusion devices is representative of this class of problems: the conditions of electrode surfaces and vacuum are difficult to observe directly, discharge outcomes vary between shots, and experiments are costly and carry operational risks. We propose a physically grounded multimodal agent with three independently auditable components. Deterministic algorithms extract symbolic physical quantities and visual evidence from multichannel waveforms; a memory with two layers organizes trajectories from the current task, experience from earlier tasks, and procedural knowledge, from which a multimodal large language model (MLLM) generates candidate actions; and an independent action feasibility check enforces action constraints before execution. In a strictly chronological replay of 455 shots from four EXL-50U platforms, physical symbols alone outperformed waveform images alone by 0.21-0.32 in macro-F1 for quality classification across all four evaluated models. Retrieved context increased the mean agreement with historical action directions by 22.4-42.7 percentage points, whereas the contribution of visual evidence varied across models. Under supervised operation on five ion sources, the system achieved a beam-extraction rate of 86.80% across 409 executed shots. These results demonstrate the engineering feasibility of the framework for supervised sequential tuning on a physical scientific instrument.

translation.title: 基于多模态智能体的非平稳响应科学仪器自适应控制
translation.abstract: 控制科学仪器需要根据连续操作的反馈逐步调整参数。当未观测到的运行条件随操作历史演化时，响应变得非平稳，从动作到响应的静态映射不再适用于跨炮次决策。磁约束聚变装置中中性束注入（NBI）离子源的逐炮调谐是这类问题的典型代表：电极表面和真空条件难以直接观测，放电结果在炮次间变化，且实验成本高并带有运行风险。我们提出一个具有物理基础的多模态智能体，包含三个可独立审计的组件。确定性算法从多通道波形中提取符号化物理量和视觉证据；一个两层记忆组织当前任务的轨迹、先前任务的经验和程序性知识，多模态大语言模型（MLLM）据此生成候选动作；独立的动作可行性检查在执行前强制约束动作。在对来自四个EXL-50U平台的455个炮次的严格按时间顺序回放中，仅使用物理符号在所有四个评估模型上的质量分类宏F1比仅使用波形图像高0.21-0.32。检索到的上下文使与历史动作方向的平均一致性提高22.4-42.7个百分点，而视觉证据的贡献因模型而异。在五个离子源的监督运行下，系统在执行的409个炮次中实现了86.80%的束流引出率。这些结果证明了该框架在物理科学仪器上监督式顺序调谐的工程可行性。
translation.brief: 解决科学仪器在非平稳响应下的逐次参数调谐问题，采用包含符号物理量提取、两层记忆与可行性检查的多模态LLM智能体框架。

papers.title: Do LLM-derived text features improve electricity price forecasts beyond document activity? Evidence from Australia's National Electricity Market
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can turn market notices and news into features for electricity price forecasting. Such features also record when documents arrive and whether their extraction failed, so a gain measured against a model without text can reflect document activity as well as content. We add the counts of the same documents and of their failed extractions to a no-text LightGBM model and measure each LLM representation against this activity reference, which needs no additional LLM requests. With gpt-6-luna as the extractor, we forecast Australian electricity prices from operator notices (5-30 minutes ahead) and WattClarity news (day-ahead) after the extractor's documented knowledge cutoff, averaging forecasts over three training seeds. For news, the counts alone lower mean absolute error (MAE) by 3.0%, most of the 3.6% reduction that the better LLM representation achieves relative to the no-text model; its increment beyond the counts is not significant. For notices, two of the three LLM representations lower MAE beyond the counts, by 0.14-0.21% and 0.45-0.52%, whether the counts are cumulative or cover recent windows, whereas the third shows no significant reduction. Time-shifted placebos give mixed evidence on whether these gains require text aligned with the target. Benchmarks using the operator's pre-dispatch forecasts (notices) or price history alone (news) are more accurate than all these text models. Gains against the no-text model and the activity reference differ in sign at individual seeds and, for notices with cumulative counts, in seed-averaged forecasts. Text gains should be reported against both references.

translation.title: LLM文本特征能否在文档活动之外提升电价预测？来自澳大利亚国家电力市场的证据
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以将市场公告和新闻转化为电价预测的特征。此类特征还记录了文档到达时间及提取是否失败，因此相对于无文本模型测得的增益可能反映文档活动而非内容。我们在无文本的LightGBM模型中加入相同文档的数量及其失败提取的计数，并将每个LLM表示与这一活动参考进行对比，后者无需额外的LLM请求。以gpt-6-luna作为提取器，我们在提取器记录的知识截止日期之后，基于运营商公告（提前5-30分钟）和WattClarity新闻（日前）预测澳大利亚电价，并在三个训练种子上平均预测结果。对于新闻，仅计数就使平均绝对误差（MAE）降低3.0%，占较好的LLM表示相对无文本模型3.6%降幅的大部分；其超出计数的增量不显著。对于公告，三个LLM表示中有两个在计数之外进一步降低MAE，分别为0.14-0.21%和0.45-0.52%，无论计数是累积的还是覆盖近期窗口，而第三个没有显著降低。时间平移安慰剂检验对这些增益是否需要与目标对齐的文本给出了混合证据。使用运营商日前预测（公告）或仅价格历史（新闻）的基准比所有文本模型更准确。相对无文本模型和活动参考的增益在单个种子上符号不同，且对于使用累积计数的公告，在种子平均预测中也不同。文本增益应同时对照两个参考进行报告。
translation.brief: 研究LLM文本特征对电价预测的增益是否只是文档活动的反映，通过引入文档计数活动参考基线进行对照评估。

papers.title: DealsFlow: An Evidence-Gated Agentic Harness for Venture Capital Deal Triage
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can read startup pitch decks, but letting them emit investment scores directly invites score inflation, run-to-run variance and rationales that are hard to audit. We describe DealsFlow, a human-in-the-loop agentic harness deployed at a UK early-stage fund. The LLM reads the deck, cites evidence and rates each category; code combines the ratings, caps them and only ever lowers them. Three mechanisms implement this: a stage-aware corroboration ceiling (78, 70 or 60 out of 100) on factual categories without external evidence; a sceptic call that may lower but never raise a score; and a pre-fetch pattern that retrieves and indexes all evidence before a single generation pass. We evaluate on $N=243$ SEIS/EIS investments with recorded outcomes. Because recent investments have unresolved outcomes, we use the 142 that are at least three years old. There, the full pipeline's score has Spearman $\rho=0.45$ (95% CI 0.32 to 0.57) with the total-value multiple and AUC 0.71 for identifying write-offs, against $\rho=0.38$ and AUC 0.68 for an unconstrained LLM. The gain is small and comes mostly from the sceptic call; we did not test whether its lower-only rule matters. Investments that later exceeded $2\times$ had 64% of factual categories corroborated, against 38% for write-offs (omnibus Kruskal-Wallis test over five outcome groups, $p=0.031$), and our retrieval was not date-restricted, so these figures may overstate screening skill. In a study of 20 inbound applications, analyst time per application fell from 44.7 to 18.9 minutes including verification and correction, and 84% of 240 cited claims were fully supported by their sources, but 70% of reports needed at least one correction.

translation.title: DealsFlow：面向风险投资交易初筛的证据门控智能体框架
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可以阅读初创公司路演材料，但让它们直接给出投资评分会导致分数虚高、运行间方差大以及难以审计的理由。我们介绍DealsFlow，一个部署于英国某早期基金的人在回路智能体框架。LLM阅读路演材料、引用证据并对每个类别评分；代码组合评分、设置上限且只会下调评分。三个机制实现这一点：对无外部证据的事实类别的阶段感知佐证上限（100分中的78、70或60）；一个只能下调不能上调评分的怀疑者调用；以及在单次生成前检索并索引所有证据的预取模式。我们在N=243个有记录结果的SEIS/EIS投资上进行评估。由于近期投资结果未定，我们使用142个至少三年历史的投资。在那里，完整流程的评分与总价值倍数的Spearman ρ=0.45（95% CI 0.32至0.57），识别减记的AUC为0.71，而无约束LLM为ρ=0.38和AUC 0.68。增益较小且主要来自怀疑者调用；我们未测试其只下调规则是否重要。后来超过2倍回报的投资有64%的事实类别得到佐证，而减记投资为38%（五个结果组的综合Kruskal-Wallis检验，p=0.031），且我们的检索未受日期限制，因此这些数字可能高估筛选能力。在一项对20份入站申请的研究中，分析师每份申请的时间（含验证和修正）从44.7分钟降至18.9分钟，240条引用声明中84%被来源完全支持，但70%的报告需要至少一处修正。
translation.brief: 解决LLM直接输出投资评分导致的分数虚高和不可审计问题，采用证据引用、佐证上限和怀疑者下调等门控机制的智能体流程。

papers.title: KnitTrans: Coordinated Trajectory Transfer for Effective and Efficient LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Trajectory transfer from rollout to training affects both learning quality and system efficiency in large language model reinforcement learning (RL). Enforcing batch-wide training requirements can delay the admission of completed trajectories, resulting in higher architectural staleness: the additional parameter-version gap from disaggregated pipelining relative to colocated execution. Beyond admission, misalignment between data access and training consumption causes redundant movement and unnecessary waiting when transferring large trajectory payloads. We present KnitTrans, a system that coordinates the rollout-to-training path through three designs. First, constraint-preserving mini-batch admission allows flexibility in early mini-batch composition, while checking that enough capacity remains to satisfy the remaining quotas. Second, on-demand trajectory data access matches storage units to consumer assignments and overlaps micro-batch data preparation with computation. Third, multimodal encoding deduplication supports reuse across a mini-batch while preserving gradient contributions from all backbone micro-batches. Experiments show up to 93% lower architectural staleness than with train-batch admission, narrowing the learning-quality gap between disaggregated execution and colocated execution. On multimodal workloads, KnitTrans reduces transfer latency by two orders of magnitude and achieves a speedup of up to 5.8 times in transfer plus training over the baseline.

translation.title: KnitTrans：面向高效LLM强化学习的协同轨迹传输
translation.abstract: 从rollout到训练的轨迹传输影响大语言模型强化学习（RL）的学习质量和系统效率。强制执行全批次训练要求会延迟已完成轨迹的准入，导致更高的架构陈旧度：即分离式流水线相对于共置执行产生的额外参数版本差距。除准入外，数据访问与训练消费之间的错位在传输大型轨迹负载时造成冗余移动和不必要的等待。我们提出KnitTrans，通过三个设计协调rollout到训练的路径。首先，保持约束的迷你批次准入允许早期迷你批次组成的灵活性，同时检查剩余容量是否足以满足剩余配额。其次，按需轨迹数据访问将存储单元与消费者分配匹配，并将迷你批次数据准备与计算重叠。第三，多模态编码去重支持迷你批次内的复用，同时保留所有骨干迷你批次的梯度贡献。实验显示架构陈旧度比训练批次准入最多降低93%，缩小了分离式执行与共置执行之间的学习质量差距。在多模态工作负载上，KnitTrans将传输延迟降低两个数量级，传输加训练相对基线实现最高5.8倍加速。
translation.brief: 解决LLM强化学习中rollout到训练轨迹传输导致的架构陈旧和传输低效问题，采用约束保持准入、按需数据访问和编码去重的协同传输系统。

papers.title: Can LLM Annotators Match Human Consistency? Benchmarking Human Agreement and Optimizing Multi-Agent with Contrastive Knowledge
papers.abstract: LLM-based annotation has advanced rapidly, yet existing benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world practice. Actual annotation often involves lengthy, task-specific guidelines, and different annotators may produce divergent but reasonable judgments, especially on boundary cases, where single-labeled dataset fail to reflect this disagreement. This gap also limits existing single-agent and workflow-based annotation systems, which often lack adaptability to complex, evolving guidelines. To bridge this gap, we introduce ANT-A Benchmark, a real-world multi-annotator benchmark spanning 7 datasets across domains and modalities, with task-specific guidelines and 5 independent human labels per instance. ANT-A enables a distribution-aware evaluation, using Fleiss kappa to assess how closely model annotations align with human labeling distributions. We further propose ANT-OR, a multi-agent annotation framework that refines prompts by distilling contrastive decision rules from positive and negative feedback. Experiments show that ANT-OR improves agreement@>=2 accuracy by 4.5 points over the strongest baseline and achieves the highest alignment with human annotator distributions as measured by Fleiss kappa within 2 points. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/Krueske/ANT-OR.

translation.title: LLM标注者能否匹配人类一致性？基于人类一致性的基准测试与对比知识优化的多智能体
translation.abstract: 基于LLM的标注发展迅速，但现有基准与现实实践脱节。实际标注通常涉及冗长的任务特定指南，不同标注者可能产生分歧但合理的判断，尤其是在边界案例上，而单标签数据集无法反映这种分歧。这一差距也限制了现有的单智能体和基于工作流的标注系统，它们往往缺乏对复杂、不断演变的指南的适应性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出ANT-A基准，一个覆盖7个跨领域、跨模态数据集的真实世界多标注者基准，包含任务特定指南和每个实例5个独立的人类标签。ANT-A支持分布感知评估，使用Fleiss kappa衡量模型标注与人类标注分布的接近程度。我们进一步提出ANT-OR，一个多智能体标注框架，通过从正负反馈中蒸馏对比决策规则来优化提示。实验表明，ANT-OR将agreement@>=2准确率比最强基线提高4.5个百分点，并在Fleiss kappa衡量的人类标注者分布对齐上取得最高水平，差距在2个百分点以内。代码和基准可在https://github.com/Krueske/ANT-OR获取。
translation.brief: 解决LLM标注基准与真实多标注者分歧场景脱节的问题，构建多标注者一致性基准并提出通过对比决策规则蒸馏优化提示的多智能体框架。

papers.title: Measuring the Energy Cost of Completing Tasks with Quantized Language-Model Agents
papers.abstract: Quantization reduces the memory and energy needed to serve large language models (LLMs) and AI agents for coding and data analysis can now run on locally hosted LLMs. In practice, this benefit is commonly benchmarked per output token. Yet an agent calls its model repeatedly, runs tools, and revises its work, and quantization can change both how much the agent generates and whether it succeeds. Existing energy studies either compare quantized models on single requests or measure agents at one fixed precision, overlooking how a change in precision plays out across a complete agent task. To address this gap, this paper presents the first characterization of the task-level energy trade-offs of model quantization in locally hosted agents. We develop 29 agent tasks with automatic pass/fail checks in six families, ranging from single-answer SQL analytics to multi-step repository bug fixing, and measure CPU and GPU energy per output token and per completed task for 4-bit and 8-bit versions of two open-weight models on bare-metal NVIDIA A100 nodes with llama.cpp. Our findings reveal that 4-bit precision generally saves energy per token, though whether it saves energy per completed task is task dependent and changes with the model and the execution budget (i.e., limits on turns, tokens, and time). We trace this discrepancy to the extra tokens needed to complete a task in full, which translates into using up to 3.5 times as much energy per completed task. These findings offer actionable guidance for developers and operators choosing model precision for agents, showing how tokens per completed task, set against the per-token saving, reveal whether lower precision completes the work with less energy.

translation.title: 量化语言模型智能体完成任务的能耗测量
translation.abstract: 量化可以降低服务大语言模型（LLM）所需的内存和能耗，用于编程和数据分析的AI智能体现在可以运行在本地部署的LLM上。实践中，这一收益通常按每个输出token来基准测试。然而智能体会反复调用模型、运行工具并修改其工作，量化既会改变智能体的生成量，也会影响其是否成功。现有能耗研究要么在单个请求上比较量化模型，要么在单一固定精度下测量智能体，忽略了精度变化在完整智能体任务中的表现。为填补这一空白，本文首次刻画了本地部署智能体中模型量化的任务级能耗权衡。我们开发了六大类共29个带自动通过/失败检查的智能体任务，从单答案SQL分析到多步骤代码仓库bug修复，并在裸机NVIDIA A100节点上使用llama.cpp测量了两个开源权重模型的4-bit和8-bit版本在每个输出token和每个完成任务上的CPU与GPU能耗。研究发现，4-bit精度通常能节省每token能耗，但能否节省每个完成任务的能耗则取决于任务本身，并随模型和执行预算（即轮次、token和时间的限制）而变化。我们将这一差异归因于完整完成任务所需的额外token，这导致每个完成任务的能耗最高可达3.5倍。这些发现为开发者和运营者选择智能体模型精度提供了可操作的指导，表明将每个完成任务的token数与每token节省量对比，可以揭示更低精度是否能以更少能耗完成工作。
translation.brief: 针对量化对智能体完整任务能耗影响不明的问题，通过构建29个带自动检查的智能体任务并测量4-bit与8-bit模型在token级和任务级的CPU/GPU能耗来刻画其权衡。

papers.title: Async-RBench: Benchmarking Asynchronous Task Execution in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute tasks asynchronously: a main agent continues working while its subagents run, and the task state may change before their results arrive. The main agent must decide which work to update or preserve and which checks to repeat, while avoiding prohibited changes. Final task success alone does not reveal whether these results were handled correctly, and natural asynchronous arrivals are hard to reproduce. We introduce Async-RBench, a benchmark for asynchronous task execution in LLM agents, with 200 executable tasks covering eight scenarios. A scenario controller regulates result delivery using predefined task-state conditions, while an Event Response Contract (ERC) specifies what each response must change, preserve, avoid, and re-verify. The Dynamic Replanning Score (DRS) weights the response process and outcome equally and is reported separately from task success. We evaluate nine agents and find DRS scores of 19.2 to 45.1, with the lowest scores on duplicate reports and subagent failures. Under our execution protocol, all nine agents obtain lower task success with asynchronous than with batched delivery (26.0% vs. 29.7% on average). For three agents, prompting the main agent to rebuild its plan after every result improves DRS by only 2.6 to 3.5 points. Together, these findings highlight the challenges of reliable asynchronous task execution and the need to evaluate how agents handle incoming results alongside end-to-end task success.

translation.title: Async-RBench：面向LLM智能体异步任务执行的基准测试
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地异步执行任务：主智能体在其子智能体运行期间继续工作，而任务状态可能在结果到达之前发生变化。主智能体必须决定更新或保留哪些工作、重复哪些检查，同时避免被禁止的更改。仅凭最终任务成功与否无法揭示这些结果是否被正确处理，而自然的异步到达也难以复现。我们提出Async-RBench，一个面向LLM智能体异步任务执行的基准，包含覆盖八个场景的200个可执行任务。场景控制器使用预定义的任务状态条件来调控结果交付，同时事件响应契约（ERC）规定每次响应必须更改、保留、避免和重新验证的内容。动态重规划分数（DRS）对响应过程和结果赋予同等权重，并与任务成功率分开报告。我们评估了九个智能体，发现DRS分数在19.2到45.1之间，重复报告和子智能体失败场景得分最低。在我们的执行协议下，所有九个智能体在异步交付下的任务成功率均低于批量交付（平均26.0%对29.7%）。对于三个智能体，提示主智能体在每次收到结果后重建计划仅能将DRS提高2.6到3.5分。这些发现共同凸显了可靠异步任务执行的挑战，以及除端到端任务成功外还需评估智能体如何处理传入结果的必要性。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体异步任务执行中结果处理难以评估的问题，构建含200个可执行任务的Async-RBench基准，用场景控制器、事件响应契约和动态重规划分数来评估智能体。

papers.title: Profile-Driven User Simulation via Reinforcement Learning with Hierarchical Rewards for Task-Oriented Dialogues
papers.abstract: Building Task-Oriented Dialogue (TOD) systems for high-value scenarios such as financial marketing requires large volumes of domain-specific dialogue data, which privacy regulations, annotation costs, and the need for expert labor make hard to obtain. User simulation offers a remedy, but existing methods target general-domain dialogue and exhibit two key limitations: insufficient modeling of domain-specific business processes and compliance constraints, and inadequate capture of the colloquial, spoken-language character of voice interactions. We propose ProfileSim, a profile-driven user simulation framework for financial marketing outbound calls. It jointly models user profiles---demographics and Big Five personality traits---and business profiles---intents reverse-engineered from real call logs---enabling fine-grained control over simulated behavior. The base model is fine-tuned on real voice dialogue data and refined by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with hierarchical rewards at the dialogue and utterance levels. Paired with a customer service agent integrating Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) constraints and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), ProfileSim achieves the highest colloquial naturalness, the strongest user profile adherence and the lowest agent score on long-tail intents among all evaluated user generators, while producing substantially shorter user utterances at comparable business compliance. The generated dialogue data is designed to support intent recognition training, agent evaluation, and rapid cold-start deployment.

translation.title: 基于分层奖励强化学习的画像驱动任务型对话用户模拟
translation.abstract: 为金融营销等高价值场景构建任务型对话（TOD）系统需要大量领域特定对话数据，而隐私法规、标注成本和对专家人力的需求使其难以获取。用户模拟提供了一种补救手段，但现有方法面向通用领域对话，存在两个关键局限：对领域特定业务流程和合规约束建模不足，以及对语音交互口语化、口语语言特征的捕捉不够。我们提出ProfileSim，一个面向金融营销外呼的画像驱动用户模拟框架。它联合建模用户画像——人口统计特征和大五人格特质——以及业务画像——从真实通话记录逆向工程得到的意图，实现对模拟行为的细粒度控制。基础模型在真实语音对话数据上微调，并通过带对话和话语两级分层奖励的组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行精调。与集成了标准操作流程（SOP）约束和检索增强生成（RAG）的客服智能体配对后，ProfileSim在所有被评估的用户生成器中实现了最高的口语自然度、最强的用户画像一致性和长尾意图上最低的智能体得分，同时在相当的业务合规性下生成显著更短的用户话语。生成的对话数据旨在支持意图识别训练、智能体评估和快速冷启动部署。
translation.brief: 针对金融营销领域对话数据稀缺且现有用户模拟缺乏领域建模的问题，提出ProfileSim框架，联合建模用户与业务画像并用带分层奖励的GRPO精调来生成可控的口语化对话。

papers.title: SCI-AGENT-EXAM: Benchmarking Agents on Scientific Research Tasks
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of supporting scientific workflows, but their capabilities across diverse research activities remain difficult to assess systematically. Existing benchmarks often focus on selected scientific capabilities or task types, limiting a comprehensive characterization of scientific agents' strengths and weaknesses in realistic research workflows. We introduce SCI-AGENT-EXAM, a workflow-oriented benchmark comprising 120 expert-curated tasks across 11 scientific fields and 7 research task types defined by the Scientific Workflow Task Taxonomy (SWTT). Each task requires both executable artifacts (e.g., code and scripts) and textual artifacts (e.g., reports and explanations). To evaluate the heterogeneous task outputs, we develop a hybrid evaluation protocol combining deterministic programmatic verification for executable artifacts with a calibrated, expert-validated LLM-based judge for textual artifacts. Beyond outcome assessment, we analyze progress and solution stability along execution trajectories to characterize how agents reach their final results. Experiments with 10 frontier LLM agents reveal substantial performance gaps: GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest overall score of 80.9, yet only 26.0% of its runs exceed the 0.95 success threshold. Further analyses uncover distinct capability profiles across scientific task types and substantial variation in execution efficiency and stability. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/SKYLENAGE-AI/Sci-Agent-Exam.

translation.title: SCI-AGENT-EXAM：在科学研究任务上对智能体进行基准测试
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越有能力支持科学工作流程，但其在多样化科研活动中的能力仍难以系统评估。现有基准往往聚焦于选定的科学能力或任务类型，限制了对科学智能体在真实研究工作流程中优势与劣势的全面刻画。我们提出SCI-AGENT-EXAM，一个面向工作流程的基准，包含由专家精心整理的120个任务，覆盖11个科学领域和由科学工作流程任务分类法（SWTT）定义的7种研究任务类型。每个任务既需要可执行产物（如代码和脚本），也需要文本产物（如报告和解释）。为评估异构的任务输出，我们开发了混合评估协议，将针对可执行产物的确定性程序化验证与针对文本产物的经校准、专家验证的基于LLM的评判器相结合。除结果评估外，我们还分析执行轨迹中的进展和解方案稳定性，以刻画智能体如何达到最终结果。对10个前沿LLM智能体的实验揭示了显著的性能差距：GPT-6 Astra取得80.9的最高总分，但其运行中仅有26.0%超过0.95的成功阈值。进一步分析揭示了不同科学任务类型上各异的能力特征，以及执行效率和稳定性的显著差异。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/SKYLENAGE-AI/Sci-Agent-Exam获取。
translation.brief: 针对科学智能体能力难以系统评估的问题，构建覆盖11个领域、7类任务的120个专家任务基准，采用程序化验证与LLM评判相结合的混合评估协议。

papers.title: Decoupling Patient Personas and Clinical Workflows: A Dual-Agent Approach to Realistic Medical Dialogue Generation
papers.abstract: Pre-consultation medical dialogues are essential for collecting comprehensive patient information, but are costly to obtain at scale due to privacy and ethical constraints. Existing LLM-based synthesis methods often rely on prompt engineering or rigid rules, limiting their ability to balance clinical relevance with realistic patient diversity. We propose CoRPS-Dial, a controllable dual-agent framework for pre-consultation medical dialogue synthesis that integrates patient personas with guideline-aligned clinical workflow rules. CoRPS-Dial generates dialogues through interactions between a persona-driven patient agent and a process-guided doctor agent, followed by post-hoc quality control for role consistency, workflow completeness, and textual consistency. Experiments on coronary heart disease demonstrate that CoRPS-Dial improves alignment between synthetic and real dialogues in information coverage, clinical compliance, and dialogue naturalness. Downstream fine-tuning experiments further confirm the utility of the generated synthetic data for medical dialogue tasks. These results highlight the effectiveness of CoRPS-Dial for clinically grounded and controllable medical dialogue synthesis.

translation.title: 解耦患者画像与临床工作流程：面向真实医疗对话生成的双智能体方法
translation.abstract: 诊前医疗对话对于收集全面的患者信息至关重要，但由于隐私和伦理约束，大规模获取成本高昂。现有基于LLM的合成方法通常依赖提示工程或僵化规则，限制了其在临床相关性与真实患者多样性之间取得平衡的能力。我们提出CoRPS-Dial，一个用于诊前医疗对话合成的可控双智能体框架，将患者画像与符合指南的临床工作流程规则相集成。CoRPS-Dial通过画像驱动的患者智能体与流程引导的医生智能体之间的交互生成对话，随后进行事后质量控制，包括角色一致性、工作流程完整性和文本一致性。在冠心病上的实验表明，CoRPS-Dial在信息覆盖、临床合规性和对话自然度方面提升了合成对话与真实对话的一致性。下游微调实验进一步证实了所生成合成数据在医疗对话任务中的实用性。这些结果凸显了CoRPS-Dial在临床可靠且可控的医疗对话合成方面的有效性。
translation.brief: 针对诊前医疗对话数据获取困难且现有合成方法难以兼顾临床规范与患者多样性的问题，提出CoRPS-Dial双智能体框架，由画像驱动的患者智能体与流程引导的医生智能体交互生成对话并辅以事后质量控制。

papers.title: POSEIDON: Scaling Training Environments for Scientific Agents from Code Repositories
papers.abstract: Training environments remain a major bottleneck for agents in data-driven scientific discovery. Existing collections of executable and verifiable training environments are small, and their construction remains difficult to scale. To address this limitation, we introduce Poseidon, an automated pipeline for generating diverse, verifiable training environments from scientific code repositories at scale. From the same repository budget, Poseidon extracts nearly 10 times as many training environments as a prior approach by decomposing scientific workflows into four complementary task types: Reproduction, Subflow, Completion, and Correction, where each type targets a distinct capability for scientific research. A recursive improvement loop further refines failed candidates and recovers otherwise discarded environments. Using Poseidon, we construct Pearl, a collection of 97,659 executable and verifiable environments from 7,110 public repositories spanning 10 scientific disciplines. To the best of our knowledge, Pearl is the largest and most broadly multidisciplinary collection of scientific-agent training environments to date. Qwen3.5 models (9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B) trained on Pearl achieve consistent gains across six challenging scientific-agent benchmarks. Overall, the scale and diversity of Pearl offer opportunities for training scientific discovery agents.

translation.title: POSEIDON：从代码仓库扩展科学智能体的训练环境
translation.abstract: 训练环境仍是数据驱动科学发现中智能体面临的主要瓶颈。现有的可执行、可验证训练环境集合规模小，且构建难以扩展。为解决这一局限，我们提出Poseidon，一个从科学代码仓库大规模自动生成多样化、可验证训练环境的自动化流水线。在相同的仓库预算下，Poseidon通过将科学工作流分解为四种互补任务类型：复现（Reproduction）、子流程（Subflow）、补全（Completion）和修正（Correction），提取的训练环境数量是先前方法的近10倍，其中每种类型针对科学研究的一项不同能力。一个递归改进循环进一步精炼失败的候选环境，并挽回原本会被丢弃的环境。利用Poseidon，我们构建了Pearl，一个从跨越10个科学学科的7,110个公共仓库中收集的包含97,659个可执行、可验证环境的集合。据我们所知，Pearl是迄今为止规模最大、学科覆盖最广的科学智能体训练环境集合。在Pearl上训练的Qwen3.5模型（9B、27B和35B-A3B）在六个具有挑战性的科学智能体基准上取得了一致的提升。总体而言，Pearl的规模和多样性为训练科学发现智能体提供了机会。
translation.brief: 针对科学智能体可验证训练环境稀缺且难以规模化构建的问题，提出从科学代码仓库自动生成训练环境的Poseidon流水线，通过将科学工作流分解为四种任务类型并配合递归改进循环，大规模构建了Pearl环境集合。

papers.title: Beyond Copying: Lifelong Smart Contract Security Task Construction via Protocol Mutation
papers.abstract: AI agents can inspect code and run tests to support smart contract security. SlowMist reports about $38.6 billion in losses across the broader blockchain ecosystem. Existing evaluations can reward memorized or copied answers, including attack code recovered from public blockchain transactions. Reconstructing contracts and validating tasks also require costly manual effort. To address these issues, we propose CONSTRAINTDIAL, a framework for lifelong construction of smart contract security tasks via protocol mutation. It automates local contract reconstruction and uses attack execution to select changes to the required calls or inputs. Execution checks guide revisions that make the original attack fail while preserving exploitability, the security objective, and normal functionality. New incidents and audit findings enter the same procedure. With CONSTRAINTDIAL, we construct 3,045 task inputs from 203 public cases, covering detect, exploit, and patch. Compared with reconstruction alone, protocol mutation reduces success with supplied public answers by 10.9 percentage points on average across detect, exploit, and patch. The fraction of tasks solved by copying online answers falls by 9.3 points.

translation.title: 超越复制：通过协议变异进行终身智能合约安全任务构建
translation.abstract: AI智能体可以检查代码并运行测试以支持智能合约安全。SlowMist报告，整个区块链生态系统的损失约为386亿美元。现有评估可能奖励记忆或复制的答案，包括从公开区块链交易中恢复的攻击代码。此外，重建合约和验证任务也需要昂贵的人工投入。为解决这些问题，我们提出CONSTRAINTDIAL，一个通过协议变异终身构建智能合约安全任务的框架。它自动化本地合约重建，并利用攻击执行来选择对所需调用或输入的修改。执行检查引导修订，使原始攻击失败，同时保持可利用性、安全目标和正常功能。新的事件和审计发现也进入同一流程。借助CONSTRAINTDIAL，我们从203个公开案例构建了3,045个任务输入，覆盖检测、利用和修补。与仅重建相比，协议变异使提供公开答案后的成功率在检测、利用和修补任务上平均降低10.9个百分点；通过复制在线答案解决的任务比例下降9.3个百分点。
translation.brief: 针对智能合约安全评估中任务易被记忆答案复制且人工构建成本高的问题，提出通过协议变异终身构建安全任务的CONSTRAINTDIAL框架，自动化重建合约并用攻击执行引导变异使原攻击失效。

papers.title: Agentic Memory Management Is the Next Frontier of Information Retrieval
papers.abstract: Information retrieval has long been focusing on connecting people with information they need to complete their tasks. Recently, the meaning of this has changed dramatically as more and more AI agents now consume, retain, and act on information on a user's behalf. Consequently, information management now also takes place \emph{inside} the agent in the form of memory management. In this perspective paper, we argue that \emph{agentic memory management} (AMM), which studies the structure, analysis, organization, storage, searching, retrieval, and \emph{use} of information in an intelligent agent's memory, is a natural extension of IR research and an area in which the IR community can make distinctive contributions. Specifically, we first present a system-level framework for AMM and introduce a computational taxonomy of memory objects as \emph{constants}, \emph{functions}, and \emph{operators}, each with distinct retrieval semantics. Then, we compare AMM with established IR research and identify their difference and connections. Last but not least, we outline a research agenda covering benchmarks, candidate principles of memory utility, optimization procedures that mix parametric and non-parametric updates, and more. We hope this paper could attract more people, both inside and outside the IR communities, to think more about AMM problems and research from IR perspectives.

translation.title: 智能体记忆管理是信息检索的下一个前沿
translation.abstract: 信息检索长期以来专注于连接人与完成其任务所需的信息。最近，这一含义发生了巨大变化，因为越来越多的AI智能体现在代表用户消费、保留并基于信息采取行动。因此，信息管理现在也以记忆管理的形式发生在智能体内部。在这篇观点论文中，我们论证智能体记忆管理（AMM）——研究智能体记忆中信息的结构、分析、组织、存储、搜索、检索及使用——是IR研究的自然延伸，也是IR社区可以做出独特贡献的领域。具体而言，我们首先提出AMM的系统级框架，并引入记忆对象的计算分类法，将其分为常量、函数和算子，每种类型具有不同的检索语义。然后，我们比较AMM与已有的IR研究，识别它们的差异与联系。最后，我们概述了一个研究议程，涵盖基准测试、记忆效用的候选原则、混合参数与非参数更新的优化流程等。我们希望本文能吸引IR社区内外更多的人从IR视角思考AMM问题与研究。
translation.brief: 针对AI智能体内部信息管理这一新问题，提出将智能体记忆管理（AMM）作为信息检索研究的自然延伸，给出系统级框架、记忆对象计算分类法及研究议程。

papers.title: Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithms
papers.abstract: Adversarial sharpness penalty per iteration of a base optimizer, known as sharpness-aware minimization (SAM), is an accepted technique to improve generalization in deep learning. Recently, Muon has emerged as a dominant optimization algorithm for training large language models (LLMs). It achieves lower sample complexity for heavy-tailed gradient updates - a phenomenon common in LLM training. However, sharpness penalties with Muon updates are yet largely unexplored in the literature. Moreover, the behavior of SAM under heavy-tailed noise is unknown both theoretically and empirically. A potential reason for this gap is the additional cost of extra gradient computation per iteration for penalty perturbations in SAM, which becomes prohibitive for LLMs. This paper introduces Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithm (SOMA) to combine a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded perturbation scheme with the Muon algorithm. The key idea is to use stale (purely) stochastic gradient noise for adversarial perturbations. Theoretically, we show that SOMA's sample complexity is invariant to the perturbation direction. We provide explorations and insights into SOMA's robustness to heavy-tailed gradient noise. We extensively explore SOMA's efficacy in (a) mitigating quality degradation due to post-training quantization, and (b) catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning of LLMs.

translation.title: 锐度感知正交化动量算法
translation.abstract: 在基础优化器的每次迭代中加入对抗性锐度惩罚，即锐度感知最小化（SAM），是提升深度学习泛化能力的公认技术。最近，Muon已成为训练大语言模型（LLM）的主导优化算法，它对重尾梯度更新（LLM训练中的常见现象）实现了更低的样本复杂度。然而，结合Muon更新的锐度惩罚在文献中仍基本未被探索；而且SAM在重尾噪声下的行为在理论和实证上都是未知的。造成这一空白的一个潜在原因是SAM为惩罚扰动每次迭代需要额外的梯度计算，这对LLM来说代价过高。本文提出锐度感知正交化动量算法（SOMA），将一种计算高效且有理论依据的扰动方案与Muon算法相结合。其核心思想是使用陈旧的（纯）随机梯度噪声作为对抗扰动。理论上，我们证明SOMA的样本复杂度对扰动方向不变。我们探索并洞察了SOMA对重尾梯度噪声的鲁棒性。我们广泛探索了SOMA在以下方面的有效性：（a）缓解训练后量化导致的质量下降，（b）LLM微调期间的灾难性遗忘。
translation.brief: 针对SAM与Muon结合时额外梯度计算代价过高且重尾噪声下行为未知的问题，提出SOMA算法，用陈旧随机梯度噪声作为对抗扰动，实现高效且有理论保证的锐度感知优化。

papers.title: Complexity concentration as a god-class and god-method detector: a pre-registered test of a scale-free outlier rule against tool definitions and human labels
papers.abstract: God-class and god-method detectors mark concentrated complexity with a raw-scale threshold, a constant fitted on a corpus and re-fitted when the population moves. This paper pre-registers a test of a rule with no raw-scale constant: a unit is a god unit when its complexity is a robust outlier for its own codebase, a modified z-score of 3.5 or more. On 445 repositories in ten languages, 171 of them Java, and the 492 Java repositories of MLCQ, the rule is scored against PMD's GodClass, MLCQ's reviewers and two further definitions, with signal and cutoff chosen on half the repositories and read on the rest. LLM-written code may gather its complexity differently, the case for a detector that needs no re-fitting; the first question is whether one can match the scale of existing human-written code. The verdict is inconclusive on both populations, by different arms. The rule ranks PMD's god classes from the per-file maximum of cognitive complexity at per-repository AUCs of 0.916 and 0.908. On the main run it is, at its default, non-inferior within the margin to a cutoff tuned on the same population on recovery, and flags about twice as many non-god classes; on MLCQ it flags about as many and falls short of the margin on pooled recovery. Pooled, the raw value ranks god classes better than the per-repository score, and a cutoff carried between the populations lost almost nothing: both are human-written code on one scale, so the test is of matching that scale, not of surviving a shift. The rule's extra flags are small classes, just over half holding a method at PMD's own method-level threshold; its misses are large classes whose complexity is spread over many methods. Two readers of the source did not agree on what the extra flags are. Concentration finds where the complexity is; whether that place is a god unit is a question about coupling, which a registered follow-on study takes up.

translation.title: 复杂度集中作为上帝类与上帝方法检测器：无标度离群点规则对工具定义与人工标注的预注册检验
translation.abstract: 上帝类和上帝方法检测器用原始尺度阈值标记集中的复杂度，该阈值是在语料库上拟合的常数，并在总体变化时重新拟合。本文预注册了一项对无原始尺度常数规则的检验：当一个单元的复杂度是其自身代码库的稳健离群点（修正z分数达到3.5或以上）时，即为上帝单元。在十种语言的445个仓库（其中171个为Java）以及MLCQ的492个Java仓库上，该规则与PMD的GodClass、MLCQ的评审者及另外两个定义进行对比评分，信号和截止值在一半仓库上选择、在另一半上读取。LLM编写的代码可能以不同方式聚集其复杂度，这正是需要一个无需重新拟合的检测器的理由；第一个问题是能否匹配现有人工编写代码的规模。判定在两个人群上都不确定，原因各不相同。该规则基于每文件认知复杂度最大值对PMD的上帝类排序，在每仓库AUC上达到0.916和0.908。在主运行中，按其默认设置，它在召回率上不劣于在同一人群上调优的截止值，但标记的非上帝类约为其两倍；在MLCQ上它标记数量相当，但在合并召回率上未达到边际。合并来看，原始值比每仓库分数更好地排序上帝类，且在人群之间迁移的截止值几乎没有损失：两者都是同一尺度上的人工编写代码，因此该检验是关于匹配该尺度，而非应对分布漂移。该规则的额外标记是小类，其中刚过半数包含一个达到PMD自身方法级阈值的方法；其漏检是复杂度分散在多个方法上的大类。两位源码阅读者对额外标记是什么未能达成一致。集中度找到了复杂度所在之处；该处是否为上帝单元则是关于耦合的问题，一项注册的后续研究将对此展开。
translation.brief: 针对上帝类/上帝方法检测依赖需重新拟合的原始尺度阈值的问题，提出并预注册检验一种无标度规则——以代码库内的稳健复杂度离群点（修正z分数≥3.5）判定上帝单元，并与工具定义和人工标注对比。

papers.title: ALLMTS: Automated LLM-based Medical Triage System
papers.abstract: Telephone triage is a safety critical task: from a brief intake note, a nurse must decide whether a caller needs an ambulance, an emergency department, an appointment, or self care at home. Queried directly, large language models (LLMs) are unreliable: they over-escalate routine cases and cannot justify their recommendations against an auditable clinical standard. We present the Automated LLM-based Medical Triage System (ALLMTS), which grounds every disposition in the same commercially maintained telehealth guidelines nurses use. Rather than asking an LLM to triage, ALLMTS makes it execute the guideline: it selects the appropriate guideline and evaluates its triage assessment questions. The disposition follows deterministically from the first positive answer, using the same traversal rule a nurse follows. We evaluate ALLMTS on 566 synthetic, expert-validated scenarios spanning 14 dispositions and designed to test specific guideline questions. ALLMTS achieves 0.95 accuracy, compared with 0.47 for a raw-LLM baseline. On a curated 50-scenario subset released as an open benchmark, ALLMTS reaches 0.98 accuracy, on par with the 0.944 correct disposition rate that a five nurse expert panel recorded on those same scenarios. Critically, on that subset the baselines have over-triage rates of up to 0.50 (0.44 on the full dataset), whereas ALLMTS reduces the over-triage rate to at most 0.02 while maintaining low under-triage. These results support coupling LLM language understanding with executable clinical guidelines for triage from intake notes.

translation.title: ALLMTS：基于LLM的自动化医疗分诊系统
translation.abstract: 电话分诊是一项安全攸关的任务：护士需要根据简短的接诊记录判断来电者是需要救护车、急诊、预约就诊还是居家自我护理。直接查询大语言模型（LLM）并不可靠：它们会过度升级常规病例，且无法依据可审计的临床标准为建议提供理由。我们提出了基于LLM的自动化医疗分诊系统（ALLMTS），它将每一个处置决策都建立在护士使用的同一套商业维护的远程医疗指南之上。ALLMTS不是让LLM直接分诊，而是让它执行指南：选择合适的指南并评估其分诊评估问题。处置决策确定性地源自第一个肯定回答，采用与护士相同的遍历规则。我们在566个经专家验证、覆盖14种处置类型、专为测试特定指南问题而设计的合成场景上评估了ALLMTS。ALLMTS达到0.95的准确率，而原始LLM基线仅为0.47。在一个作为开放基准发布的50个场景的精选子集上，ALLMTS达到0.98的准确率，与五位护士专家小组在这些场景上记录的0.944的正确处置率相当。关键的是，在该子集上基线的过度分诊率高达0.50（完整数据集上为0.44），而ALLMTS将过度分诊率降至最多0.02，同时保持低分诊不足率。这些结果支持将LLM的语言理解能力与可执行的临床指南相结合，以实现基于接诊记录的分诊。
translation.brief: 针对LLM直接做医疗分诊不可靠的问题，提出让LLM逐步执行护士使用的远程医疗指南、以确定性规则得出处置决策的ALLMTS系统。

papers.title: CauProphet: Teaching Agents to Develop Causal Cognition like Humans
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly support long-horizon tasks by leveraging external memory and past experience. However, existing agents mainly retrieve records or summaries, lacking the ability to form and refine causal understanding of the world. Inspired by human causal cognition, we introduce CauProphet, an agent that develops and updates causal knowledge within its Causal Cognition. For each task, CauProphet combines relevant knowledge in Causal Cognition with current evidence to construct a Causal Belief, a structured belief capturing causal factors and the effects of possible actions. It uses this belief for decision-making and continuously updates both the belief and Causal Cognition as new observations emerge, enabling causal knowledge that persists beyond individual experiences. Evaluations demonstrate that CauProphet progressively acquires causal knowledge and transfers it to future decision-making. In financial research, CauProphet leverages prior discoveries to improve downstream analyses and outperforms all baselines in mean rank correlation with next-day returns, achieving a 25.4% improvement over a baseline agent. It also improves prediction accuracy from 21.3% to 28.6% in dynamic real-world settings. Further experiments validate its ability to perform reliable causal analysis and action selection across scientific and everyday tasks, demonstrating the potential of causal experience learning for next-generation LLM agents.

translation.title: CauProphet：教会智能体像人类一样发展因果认知
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益通过利用外部记忆和过往经验来支持长程任务。然而，现有智能体主要检索记录或摘要，缺乏形成和完善对世界因果理解的能力。受人类因果认知启发，我们提出了CauProphet，一个在其因果认知中发展和更新因果知识的智能体。对于每个任务，CauProphet将因果认知中的相关知识与当前证据相结合，构建一个因果信念（Causal Belief），即捕获因果因素和可能行动效果的结构化信念。它利用该信念进行决策，并随着新观察的出现持续更新信念和因果认知，使因果知识能够超越单次经验而持续存在。评估表明，CauProphet逐步获取因果知识并将其迁移到未来的决策中。在金融研究中，CauProphet利用先前的发现改进下游分析，在与次日收益率平均秩相关性上超越所有基线，相比基线智能体提升25.4%。它还将动态真实环境中的预测准确率从21.3%提升至28.6%。进一步的实验验证了其在科学和日常任务中执行可靠因果分析和行动选择的能力，展示了因果经验学习对下一代LLM智能体的潜力。
translation.brief: 针对LLM智能体缺乏持续因果理解能力的问题，提出CauProphet，通过维护可演化的因果认知并构建结构化因果信念来指导决策与知识积累。

papers.title: CASE: Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution for Frozen Multimodal Emotion Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) by enabling fine-grained emotion understanding through reasoning over multimodal evidence. However, they still exhibit systematic confusion between semantically adjacent emotions with highly overlapping multimodal cues. Existing approaches typically address these errors through global parameter adaptation, making confusion correction costly and inflexible. We instead observe that emotion confusion is highly localized and therefore better addressed through reusable pair-specific expertise. Building on this insight, we propose Confusion-Aware Skill Evolution (CASE), the first agent-skill framework for MER. CASE maintains a sparse, self-evolving library of pair-specific EmotionSkills that externalize affective expertise from model parameters, enabling the learned expertise to be continuously refined and readily transferred across diverse frozen MLLM backbones. During inference, CASE dynamically retrieves the appropriate EmotionSkill to reinforce boundary-aware reasoning while keeping the MLLM backbone frozen. Extensive experiments on CA-MER, DFEW, and EMER demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of CASE across both general-purpose and emotion-specialized MLLMs. Notably, CASE improves the average accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B on the CA-MER benchmark from 46.80% to 59.13%, while achieving consistent gains across MLLMs.

translation.title: CASE：面向冻结多模态情感模型的混淆感知技能演化
translation.abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通过基于多模态证据的推理实现细粒度情感理解，极大地推动了多模态情感识别（MER）的发展。然而，它们在具有高度重叠多模态线索的语义相近情感之间仍然表现出系统性混淆。现有方法通常通过全局参数适配来解决这些错误，使得混淆纠正成本高且不灵活。我们转而观察到情感混淆是高度局部化的，因此更适合通过可复用的成对特定专长来解决。基于这一洞察，我们提出了混淆感知技能演化（CASE），这是首个面向MER的智能体技能框架。CASE维护一个稀疏、自演化的成对特定EmotionSkill库，将情感专长从模型参数中外化，使学到的专长能够被持续精炼，并可轻松迁移到不同的冻结MLLM骨干模型上。在推理时，CASE动态检索合适的EmotionSkill以强化边界感知推理，同时保持MLLM骨干冻结。在CA-MER、DFEW和EMER上的大量实验证明了CASE在通用和情感专用MLLM上的有效性和可迁移性。值得注意的是，CASE将Qwen3-VL-8B在CA-MER基准上的平均准确率从46.80%提升至59.13%，同时在各MLLM上取得一致的增益。
translation.brief: 针对MLLM在语义相近情感间系统性混淆的问题，提出CASE框架，通过维护自演化的成对特定情感技能库在冻结模型上实现可迁移的混淆纠正。

papers.title: WaitLens: Temporal VLM-Based Adaptive Waiting for Industrial GUI Testing Agents
papers.abstract: Improving the efficiency of GUI testing agents is important for industrial deployment. Beyond LLM inference, fixed waiting between consecutive interactions introduces substantial overhead. Our industrial study reveals that fixed waiting accounts for 42.3% of the time within the sampled interaction intervals, comparable to the 54.8% spent on model calls. Moreover, 62.9% of the waiting time is spent after the GUI has already finished loading. Although prior studies have proposed adaptive waiting strategies, their reliance on app-specific data or platform-specific information limits their applicability across diverse industrial environments. To this end, we propose WaitLens, which fine-tunes a lightweight VLM on GUI loading trajectories annotated with waiting end times. We introduce temporal resampling to construct diverse training examples, enabling the model to learn varying GUI loading behaviors from temporal observations. Experiments show that WaitLens achieves 86.08% accuracy in deciding whether to keep waiting, compared with 54.13% for the backbone VLM. Our evaluation using recordings from Meituan's industrial testing pipeline shows that WaitLens reduces mean extra waiting after the interface is ready by 94.98% compared with a 20-second fixed wait.

translation.title: WaitLens：面向工业GUI测试智能体的时序VLM自适应等待
translation.abstract: 提升GUI测试智能体的效率对工业部署十分重要。除了LLM推理之外，连续交互之间的固定等待也引入了可观的 overhead。我们的工业研究发现，固定等待占采样交互间隔时间的42.3%，与模型调用所占的54.8%相当。此外，62.9%的等待时间发生在GUI已经完成加载之后。尽管先前的研究提出了自适应等待策略，但其对应用特定数据或平台特定信息的依赖限制了它们在多样化工业环境中的适用性。为此，我们提出WaitLens，它在标注了等待结束时间的GUI加载轨迹上微调一个轻量级VLM。我们引入时间重采样来构建多样化的训练样本，使模型能够从时间观测中学习不同的GUI加载行为。实验表明，WaitLens在判断是否继续等待上达到86.08%的准确率，而骨干VLM仅为54.13%。使用美团工业测试流水线的录屏进行评估显示，与20秒固定等待相比，WaitLens将界面就绪后的平均额外等待时间减少了94.98%。
translation.brief: 针对GUI测试智能体固定等待造成大量时间开销的问题，提出在带时间重采样标注的加载轨迹上微调轻量VLM来自适应判断是否继续等待。

papers.title: When Agents Fail: Model or Harness--Who's to Blame?
papers.abstract: LLM agents combine models with execution harnesses, so agentic benchmark performance reflects their joint behavior. We argue that harnesses should therefore be evaluated through their interactions with underlying models. We develop a framework combining five complementary measures: (i) Valid Completion Rate (VCR), how reliably agents finish normally and deliver evaluable results, irrespective of task correctness; (ii) Model-Harness Fit, how well a harness supports task achievement through valid completion for a given model; (iii) Cross-Model Fit, a harness's overall suitability across evaluated models; (iv) Interaction Residuals, pairing-specific execution strengths and weaknesses hidden by component-level summaries; and (v) Token Load, the token demands of agent execution, including failed attempts. We evaluate four general-purpose harnesses (OpenCode, Codex CLI, Pi CLI, and DeepAgents) with four core models, plus two fixed native model-harness systems, on six benchmarks covering context management, tool use, long-context planning, multimodal interaction, and artifact handoff. Including native references and stress conditions, 111 evaluation settings yield 52,168 trajectories. Harness rankings vary across models and benchmarks; task performance and valid completion can favor different pairings, and similar task scores can accompany distinct execution profiles. OpenCode ranks first in cross-model performance, while DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview maintains consistently high Mean VCR across harnesses on the shared four-benchmark panel. These findings support evaluating model-harness interactions, training transferable harness-use capabilities in models, and harness designs adapted to the model and task.

translation.title: 当智能体失败时：该怪模型还是Harness？
translation.abstract: LLM智能体由模型和执行harness组合而成，因此智能体基准性能反映了二者的联合行为。我们认为harness应当通过其与底层模型的交互来评估。我们开发了一个包含五个互补指标的框架：(i) 有效完成率（VCR），即智能体正常完成并交付可评估结果的可靠性，与任务正确性无关；(ii) 模型-Harness适配度，即harness在给定模型上通过有效完成任务来支持任务达成的程度；(iii) 跨模型适配度，harness在被评估模型上的整体适用性；(iv) 交互残差，被组件级汇总所掩盖的配对特有的执行优劣势；(v) Token负载，智能体执行（包括失败尝试）的token需求。我们在六个涵盖上下文管理、工具使用、长上下文规划、多模态交互和产物交接的基准上，评估了四个通用harness（OpenCode、Codex CLI、Pi CLI和DeepAgents）与四个核心模型，外加两个固定的原生模型-harness系统。包含原生参照和压力条件在内，111个评估设置共产生52,168条轨迹。Harness排名因模型和基准而异；任务性能和有效完成可能偏好不同的配对，相似的任务得分可能伴随截然不同的执行特征。OpenCode在跨模型性能上排名第一，而DeepSeek V4 Flash Preview在共享的四基准面板上跨harness保持持续较高的Mean VCR。这些发现支持评估模型-harness交互、在模型中训练可迁移的harness使用能力，以及针对模型和任务适配harness设计。
translation.brief: 针对智能体基准结果难以区分模型与执行harness各自责任的问题，提出包含有效完成率、适配度、交互残差和token负载等五项指标的模型-harness交互评估框架。

papers.title: MusicTwins: Training Audio-Language Models to Listen like Their Persona
papers.abstract: People differ in how they perceive music, what associations they make with it, what they like about it, and how they respond to it. Computational models intended to simulate people in environments that include music should account for these differences. Although LLMs have been shown to reproduce aspects of human behavior, whether audio-language models (ALMs) can reproduce a specific person's responses to textual and musical stimuli remains underexplored. We introduce MusicTwins, a framework that combines persona summaries, personal memory, and post-training to generate person-specific responses. We construct persona representations from human writings, capturing background, views, personality, writing style, and a musical profile, and post-train Audio Flamingo Next through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Evaluation on ten held-out personas shows notable improvements for Audio Flamingo Next in persona fidelity, including personality, writing style, and responses to music, supporting MusicTwins as a foundation for training audio-language models to listen like their persona.

translation.title: MusicTwins：训练音频-语言模型像其人格角色一样聆听
translation.abstract: 人们对音乐的感知、联想、喜好和反应各不相同，旨在模拟包含音乐环境中人的计算模型应考虑这些差异。尽管 LLM 已被证明能再现人类行为的某些方面，但音频-语言模型（ALM）能否再现特定人对文本和音乐刺激的反应仍缺乏研究。我们提出 MusicTwins，一个结合人格摘要、个人记忆和后训练来生成特定个体响应的框架。我们从人类文字中构建人格表征，捕捉背景、观点、性格、写作风格和音乐偏好，并通过监督微调和强化学习对 Audio Flamingo Next 进行后训练。在十个保留人格上的评估显示，Audio Flamingo Next 在人格保真度方面（包括性格、写作风格和对音乐的反应）取得显著提升，支持 MusicTwins 作为训练音频-语言模型像其人格角色一样聆听的基础。
translation.brief: 针对音频-语言模型无法模拟特定个体对音乐和文本反应的问题，提出结合人格摘要、个人记忆并通过监督微调与强化学习后训练 Audio Flamingo Next 的 MusicTwins 框架。

papers.title: IGG: A Benchmark for Interactive GUI Grounding under Visibility Constraints
papers.abstract: GUI grounding benchmarks ask whether an agent can localize a target that is already visible in a static screenshot. Real interfaces often violate this assumption: a target may be off-screen, appear only after a state change or hover, remain occluded, or become actionable after a delay. This leaves the ability to recover target visibility unevaluated. To measure this reveal step, we introduce Interactive GUI Grounding (IGG), a benchmark in which an agent must first make the target visible through interaction and then click it. IGG contains 601 tasks across 16 controllable GUI environments and seven visibility-constraint sub-types, with a compact action space of scrolling, moving, dragging, waiting, and clicking. In our human study, participants achieve 94.6% accuracy, while GPT-5.5 reaches 79.4% and the strongest evaluated open-source VLM reaches only 31.6%. To identify the source of this gap, we conduct two controlled interventions. Telling Qwen3-VL which interaction to perform raises its accuracy only from 30.8% to 33.9%, whereas performing the interaction for the model raises it to 81.9%. The bottleneck is executing the reveal interaction, not recognizing the target once it is exposed. We further show that this capability is learnable, demonstrating that visibility recovery can be strengthened consistently across model families.

translation.title: IGG：可见性约束下的交互式 GUI 定位基准
translation.abstract: GUI 定位基准通常假设目标在静态截图中已经可见，但真实界面往往不满足这一假设：目标可能不在屏幕上、需状态变化或悬停后才出现、被遮挡或延迟后才可操作，这使恢复目标可见性的能力未被评估。为衡量这一揭示步骤，我们提出交互式 GUI 定位（IGG）基准，要求智能体先通过交互使目标可见再点击。IGG 包含 16 个可控 GUI 环境中的 601 个任务和七种可见性约束子类型，动作空间精简为滚动、移动、拖拽、等待和点击。人类研究中参与者达到 94.6% 准确率，而 GPT-5.5 为 79.4%，最强的开源 VLM 仅为 31.6%。为定位差距来源，我们进行了两项受控干预：告诉 Qwen3-VL 应执行哪种交互仅将其准确率从 30.8% 提升至 33.9%，而替模型执行交互则提升至 81.9%。瓶颈在于执行揭示交互，而非在目标暴露后识别目标。我们进一步证明该能力是可学习的，可见性恢复能力可在不同模型家族中一致地得到加强。
translation.brief: 针对现有 GUI 定位基准忽略目标不可见需交互揭示的问题，提出要求智能体先交互恢复可见性再点击的 IGG 基准，并发现瓶颈在于执行揭示交互而非识别目标。

papers.title: Beyond Coverage and Mutation: A Blind-Spot Analysis of LLM-Generated Unit Tests
papers.abstract: Existing evaluation protocols for unit tests rely on aggregate metrics such as branch coverage and mutation score. These metrics quantify the extent to which a test suite exercises program behavior, but do not identify the behavioral obligations it systematically leaves unchecked. We propose BlindSpotEval, an obligation-based evaluation framework aligned with the Arrange-Act-Assert pattern. The framework comprises three metrics, Boundary-Value Adequacy, Control-Flow Adequacy, and Oracle Strength, complemented by an assessment of execution reliability. We also introduce ObligBench, a complexity-stratified Java benchmark comprising 895 complex and 700 low-complexity functions with source-side obligation annotations. Evaluating 14,320 tests from four LLMs under four prompting strategies reveals systematic blind spots. Incorrect assertions account for 15.6% of test failures, illustrating that coverage alone does not establish oracle correctness. Among executable tests, coverage of null, negative, and empty arguments reaches only 34.8%, 23.8%, and 38.8%, compared with average coverage above 93% for booleans. Catch blocks and default groups have Control-Flow Adequacy scores of only 0.100 and 0.312. Across both dimensions, LLM-generated tests exhibit the happy-path bias observed in human-written tests, concentrating on normal inputs and expected flows while leaving unusual values and exceptional paths unchecked. Oracle strength is high on average but uneven, with weaker assertions for object return property values and exceptions. These blind spots also occur in low-complexity functions, suggesting that code complexity alone does not explain them. BlindSpotEval provides construct-level adequacy profiles that identify under-tested obligation types and can guide targeted improvements beyond those supported by aggregate scores alone.

translation.title: 超越覆盖率和变异得分：LLM 生成单元测试的盲点分析
translation.abstract: 现有单元测试评估协议依赖分支覆盖率和变异得分等聚合指标，这些指标量化测试套件对程序行为的覆盖程度，但无法识别其系统性遗漏的行为义务。我们提出与 Arrange-Act-Assert 模式对齐的基于义务的评估框架 BlindSpotEval，包含边界值充分性、控制流充分性和 Oracle 强度三项指标，并辅以执行可靠性评估。我们还引入按复杂度分层的 Java 基准 ObligBench，包含 895 个复杂函数和 700 个低复杂度函数并带源代码侧义务标注。对四个 LLM 在四种提示策略下生成的 14,320 个测试的评估揭示了系统性盲点：错误断言占测试失败的 15.6%，说明覆盖率不能确立 Oracle 正确性；在可执行测试中，null、负数和空参数的覆盖率仅为 34.8%、23.8% 和 38.8%，而布尔值的平均覆盖率超过 93%；catch 块和 default 分组的控制流充分性得分仅 0.100 和 0.312。在两个维度上，LLM 生成的测试都呈现人类编写测试中观察到的快乐路径偏差，集中于正常输入和预期流程，遗漏异常值和异常路径。Oracle 强度总体较高但不均衡，对对象返回属性值和异常的断言较弱。这些盲点在低复杂度函数中同样出现，表明代码复杂度并非其原因。BlindSpotEval 提供构件级充分性画像，可识别测试不足的义务类型并指导超越聚合分数的针对性改进。
translation.brief: 针对覆盖率与变异得分无法识别单元测试系统性遗漏的问题，提出基于行为义务的评估框架 BlindSpotEval 和分层 Java 基准 ObligBench，揭示 LLM 生成测试的快乐路径偏差等盲点。

papers.title: HGWM: Hierarchical Graph-Guided World Model for Zero-Shot Object Navigation via Graph Matching
papers.abstract: Zero-shot object navigation requires an embodied agent to choose where to search while retaining evidence from previous observations. HGWM couples an LLM-generated room-anchor prior with persistent spatial-semantic memory. A coarse stage assigns visual-semantic scores to candidate headings on a 0-10 scale; a fine stage measures symbolic compatibility between observed objects, room context, and the goal prior. Phase-dependent fusion combines these scores with an LLM direction recommendation before local action selection. On HM3D v0.1, the reported HGWM configuration achieves 62.6% success rate (SR) and 31.5% success weighted by path length (SPL), compared with 58.1% and 31.2% for WMNav. On MP3D, the corresponding values are 46.8% and 17.9%, compared with 45.4% and 17.2%. The results indicate higher success point estimates and modest path-efficiency gains. On HM3D v0.2, the full model obtains 74.4% SR and 31.9% SPL. Additional component ablations reduce SR by 0.9-2.3 percentage points and SPL by 0.6-1.5 points. These are author-reported aggregate measurements. The accompanying implementation repairs pass offline tests; episode-level rerun records are not available. Evaluation is confined to simulation.

translation.title: HGWM：基于图匹配的层次图引导世界模型零样本物体导航
translation.abstract: 零样本物体导航要求具身智能体在选择搜索位置时保留先前观察的证据。HGWM 将 LLM 生成的房间锚点先验与持久空间-语义记忆相结合：粗粒度阶段在 0-10 分制上为候选朝向分配视觉-语义分数；细粒度阶段衡量观察到的物体、房间上下文与目标先验之间的符号兼容性；阶段相关融合将这些分数与 LLM 的方向建议结合后再进行局部动作选择。在 HM3D v0.1 上，HGWM 报告配置达到 62.6% 成功率（SR）和 31.5% 按路径长度加权的成功率（SPL），而 WMNav 为 58.1% 和 31.2%；在 MP3D 上分别为 46.8% 和 17.9%，WMNav 为 45.4% 和 17.2%。结果显示更高的成功率点估计和适度的路径效率提升。在 HM3D v0.2 上，完整模型获得 74.4% SR 和 31.9% SPL。额外的组件消融使 SR 降低 0.9-2.3 个百分点、SPL 降低 0.6-1.5 个百分点。这些均为作者报告的汇总测量；配套实现通过了离线测试，但无 episode 级重跑记录。评估仅限于仿真环境。
translation.brief: 针对零样本物体导航中搜索位置选择问题，提出融合 LLM 房间锚点先验与持久空间-语义记忆、通过粗细两阶段评分与图匹配融合的层次世界模型 HGWM。

papers.title: Tool-Calling LLM Agents Under Realistic MCP Faults: Scale Does Not Purchase Fault Tolerance
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on external tools exposed via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), yet current benchmarks assume tools respond correctly and on time, leaving agent resilience to realistic tool failures untested. We introduce MCP-Injector, a drop-in, protocol-aware fault-injection middleware that interposes on the MCP tool-call path with controlled persistence (permanent, transient, intermittent) and seedable schedules. Its fault model is calibrated to the observed incident distribution (failure mode x persistence) of the public MCP ecosystem, mined from 57,240 issue and pull-request threads across 1,774 open-source MCP repositories. In a 1,350-cell experiment crossing two backbone sizes (20B, 120B), three agent stacks (custom multi-round plan-and-execute, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain), and three fault injection conditions, we find that faults drawn from this permanent-heavy stress profile cause severe quality degradation (task-completion score falls by 60%, from 8.08 to 3.23 out of 10), and that scale does not purchase fault tolerance for the two gpt-oss backbones we test: the 120B retains no larger share of its fault-free score under faults (resilience-ratio model, $p = 0.96$), and its completion rate under faults is, if anything, lower (91.1% vs. 95.6%; difference 4.4 points, 95% CI $[-0.2, 9.3]$). Agent stacks differ in how well they absorb faults, which suggests that framework-level error handling matters more than model scale. These results demonstrate that capability benchmarks alone can mask operational brittleness, motivating protocol-aware fault injection as a complementary evaluation dimension for tool-calling agents.

translation.title: 真实 MCP 故障下的工具调用 LLM 智能体：规模换不来容错能力
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体日益依赖通过 Model Context Protocol（MCP）暴露的外部工具，但现有基准假设工具正确且按时响应，未检验智能体对真实工具故障的韧性。我们提出 MCP-Injector，一个即插即用、协议感知的故障注入中间件，可在 MCP 工具调用路径上以受控持续性（永久、瞬时、间歇）和可播种调度进行干预。其故障模型根据从 1,774 个开源 MCP 仓库的 57,240 条 issue 和 pull-request 线程中挖掘的公共 MCP 生态故障分布（故障模式×持续性）进行校准。在跨越两种骨干规模（20B、120B）、三种智能体栈（自研多轮规划-执行、OpenAI Agents SDK、LangChain）和三种故障注入条件的 1,350 格实验中，我们发现该永久故障为主的压力配置导致严重的质量下降（任务完成得分下降 60%，从 8.08 降至 3.23，满分 10），且规模换不来容错能力：120B 骨干在故障下保留的无故障得分比例并未更大（韧性比模型，$p = 0.96$），其故障下完成率甚至更低（91.1% vs. 95.6%；差 4.4 个百分点，95% CI $[-0.2, 9.3]$）。不同智能体栈吸收故障的能力不同，表明框架级错误处理比模型规模更重要。这些结果表明仅靠能力基准会掩盖运行脆弱性，因此应将协议感知故障注入作为工具调用智能体的补充评估维度。
translation.brief: 针对工具调用 LLM 智能体对真实 MCP 故障韧性未经验证的问题，构建基于真实故障分布的故障注入中间件 MCP-Injector，发现模型规模无法提升容错能力而框架级错误处理更关键。

papers.title: PHYRD: A Living Benchmark for Reproducing and Extending Theoretical Physics Research
papers.abstract: Large language models and agents have shown significant power in advanced physical research. In this paper, We introduce PHYRD, a living benchmark for theoretical-physics reasoning with 63 Reproduce and 43 Discover problems. Reproduce tests derivation of published results; Discover tests consequences of modified theoretical conditions. FormulaForest constructs the tasks with reference solutions and subquestion-level rubrics. Across five models, whole-problem accuracy ranges from 49.21% to 68.25% on Reproduce and from 18.60% to 74.42% on closed-book Discover. With tools, four models complete more Discover problems, but conceptual errors and missing arguments persist. Besides, our experimental results demonstrate the value of FormulaForest as synthetic data. On FrontierScience, a benchmark developed by OpenAI, it raises the accuracy of a Qwen-35B-A3B model from 61% to 72%.

translation.title: PHYRD：一个用于复现与拓展理论物理研究的动态基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型与智能体在高级物理研究中已展现出显著能力。本文介绍PHYRD，一个面向理论物理推理的动态基准，包含63道Reproduce（复现）题和43道Discover（发现）题。Reproduce测试对已发表结果的推导；Discover测试修改理论条件后的推论。FormulaForest构建了这些任务，并配有参考解答和子问题级评分标准。在五个模型上，Reproduce的整题准确率介于49.21%至68.25%之间，闭卷Discover的准确率介于18.60%至74.42%之间。借助工具，四个模型能完成更多Discover题，但概念性错误和论证缺失依然存在。此外，实验结果证明了FormulaForest作为合成数据的价值：在OpenAI开发的FrontierScience基准上，它将Qwen-35B-A3B模型的准确率从61%提升至72%。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了包含复现与发现两类任务的理论物理推理动态基准PHYRD，并利用FormulaForest生成带评分标准的任务及合成数据来评估和提升模型能力。

papers.title: Lessons Outlive Their Failures: A Case Study of Rules for AI Coding Agents
papers.abstract: AI coding agents increasingly work inside a harness: rule files such as AGENTS.md, on-demand skills, runtime hooks and automated checks. Most studies of harnesses look at a single point in time or at short benchmark runs. I report a six-week case study of my personal system of record, a plain-markdown repository that three AI agent tools edited daily under one shared rule set. I built a ledger of 118 agent failures, their fixes and whether they came back. I also tested the system's monthly LLM documentation audit against 47 known stale statements and 20 planted errors. Finally, I replayed five past failures in isolated git clones, with and without their fixes. All results come from one repository with three runs per condition, so I report them as exploratory. Stale documentation (drift) was the largest failure class (48 of 118), although 35 of those were found on one audit day. A single audit run found about half of the known drift (Claude Sonnet 5.5 mean: 50%), and at least 93% of its findings were correct. On Sonnet 5.5, the agent finished four of the five replayed tasks. In three of those four, the failure did not happen, with or without its fix. Only the stale-count failure came back without its check, and the check stopped it in every run. On older models, an agent drafted an em-dash once while the em-dash lint check was active, and the check rejected it. A written rule on run-time estimates did not change Sonnet 4.5's overestimates. These results suggest that harness lessons can outlive the failures they were written to fix, while drift persists and still needs mechanical checks. Tools that evolve a harness add lessons faster than they retire them, so they should re-test their rules from time to time and retire the obsolete ones.

translation.title: 经验教训比其针对的失败更长久：AI编码智能体规则案例研究
translation.abstract: AI编码智能体越来越多地在harness（脚手架）中工作：如AGENTS.md等规则文件、按需技能、运行时钩子和自动化检查。大多数harness研究只关注单一时间点或短期基准运行。我报告了一项为期六周的案例研究，对象是我的个人记录系统——一个纯markdown仓库，三个AI智能体工具在共享规则集下每日编辑它。我建立了一个记录118次智能体失败、其修复方案及是否复发的台账。我还用47条已知过时陈述和20个植入错误测试了系统的月度LLM文档审计。最后，我在隔离的git克隆中重放了五次历史失败，分别带和不带其修复。所有结果均来自一个仓库、每种条件运行三次，因此我将其作为探索性结果报告。过时文档（漂移）是最大的失败类别（118次中的48次），尽管其中35次是在同一天审计中发现的。单次审计运行能发现约一半的已知漂移（Claude Sonnet 5.5平均：50%），且至少93%的发现是正确的。在Sonnet 5.5上，智能体完成了五个重放任务中的四个，其中三个任务无论是否应用修复，失败都没有发生。只有过时计数失败在没有检查时会复发，而该检查在每次运行中都阻止了它。在较旧的模型上，当em-dash lint检查启用时，智能体曾起草过一个em-dash并被检查拒绝。关于运行时估计的书面规则并未改变Sonnet 4.5的高估倾向。这些结果表明，harness中的经验教训可以比它们原本要修复的失败更长久，而漂移持续存在，仍需机械化检查。演化harness的工具添加经验的速度快于淘汰它们的速度，因此应定期重新测试规则并淘汰过时规则。
translation.brief: 该论文通过六周单仓库案例研究考察AI编码智能体harness规则的有效性，发现文档漂移是最大失败类别且需机械化检查，而规则教训往往在失败消失后仍然有效。

papers.title: GLP Networking API Specification
papers.abstract: Multiagent deterministic GLP (madGLP) runs Grassroots Logic Programs (GLP) as agents that communicate solely by asynchronous message passing, and assumes fair delivery: every message sent is eventually delivered. Each agent runs on a person's smartphone, named by the person's public key. A grassroots platform depends on no global resource but the network, so agents must reach one another over Bluetooth Low Energy, on a local network, and across the Internet from behind NAT, via rendezvous servers anyone can run. What madGLP requires of such a network, and what the network requires of the platform, has not been specified. We specify the networking layer beneath madGLP. Anything that can be done in GLP is done in GLP: the layer provides only what GLP cannot reach - the network stack, the location service, application attestation, and cryptographic primitives. Three transport underlays share one interface. Over PAN and LAN, an agent advertises a rotating recognition token derived from its key and time slot, so a peer who knows the key recognises it before contact and nobody else can track it; whether it answers unrecognised contacts is a per-underlay trust level set by GLP. Over WAN, a rendezvous server is a static-address host running the headless layer and a GLP rendezvous agent that coordinates hole punching, relays no payload, and belongs to no social graph. On every underlay, peers establish a mutually authenticated Noise session from Ed25519 keys, then attest, bound to the handshake hash, that each runs the application published under its developer's key, verified against Apple's and Google's roots with no third party contacted. One message protocol, over UDP datagrams and GATT writes, provides the fair, unordered, atomic and authenticated delivery madGLP assumes.

translation.title: GLP网络API规范
translation.abstract: 多智能体确定性GLP（madGLP）将Grassroots Logic Programs（GLP）作为智能体运行，智能体之间仅通过异步消息传递通信，并假设公平投递：每条发送的消息最终都会被送达。每个智能体运行在个人智能手机上，以该人的公钥命名。草根平台不依赖网络之外的任何全局资源，因此智能体必须通过Bluetooth Low Energy、局域网以及经由任何人都可以运行的会合服务器从NAT后跨越互联网相互联系。madGLP对此类网络的要求，以及网络对平台的要求，此前从未被规范化。我们规范了madGLP之下的网络层。凡GLP能做的事都在GLP中完成：该层只提供GLP无法触及的内容——网络协议栈、位置服务、应用证明和密码学原语。三个传输底层共享一个接口。在PAN和LAN上，智能体广播由其密钥和时隙派生的轮换识别令牌，因此知道密钥的对等方在接触前即可识别它，而其他人无法追踪它；是否响应未识别的接触是由GLP设定的每个底层的信任级别。在WAN上，会合服务器是运行无头层和GLP会合智能体的静态地址主机，协调打洞，不转发有效载荷，且不属于任何社交图谱。在每个底层上，对等方从Ed25519密钥建立相互认证的Noise会话，然后证明（绑定到握手哈希）各自运行的是在其开发者密钥下发布的应用，并对照Apple和Google的根证书进行验证，无需联系第三方。一种消息协议运行在UDP数据报和GATT写入之上，提供madGLP所假设的公平、无序、原子且经过认证的投递。
translation.brief: 该论文为madGLP平台规范化其底层网络层，定义跨PAN/LAN/WAN三种传输底层的统一接口，提供隐私保护发现、相互认证Noise会话、应用证明及公平原子消息投递。

papers.title: Political sense-making in "individual" human-technology-world relations: the case of LLM-generated autobiographies
