papers.abstract: As AI systems increasingly mediate how people describe, recognize, and present themselves, their politics cannot be reduced to what remains hidden inside the "black box." This chapter argues that AI's political significance emerges within technologically, intersubjectively, and temporally mediated interpretive practices. Bringing Arendt's political philosophy into conversation with Gadamerian hermeneutics, the chapter develops a postphenomenological relational-temporal account of political sense-making across Human-Technology-World relations. Against the charge that postphenomenology remains individualistic and using the case of LLM-generated biographies, the chapter shows how seemingly private human-LLM encounters are worldly and collective. When users ask systems such as ChatGPT to describe them, they do not simply receive algorithmic representations. They interpret, contest, edit, share, and publicly test these descriptions. In doing so, people move interpretively among affective resonance, friction, public re-articulation, and the sedimentation of meaning. This means that the so-called "micro-level" of postphenomenological analysis is already saturated with publicity: affective uptake becomes communicable, reflection becomes accountable, and uses sediment into shared standards of appearance. Simultaneously, we show that once mediation is treated as relational and temporal, the political is not an add-on at the "macro" level; it is intrinsic to the very movement through which technologies amplify and reduce, stabilize and unsettle, and thereby compose a shared world in which judgment can take place. The chapter finishes by discussing several design and policy implications for AI of such political foregrounding in postphenomenology.

translation.title: "个体"人-技术-世界关系中的政治意义建构：以LLM生成的自传为例
translation.abstract: 随着AI系统日益中介人们描述、认识和呈现自我的方式，其政治性不能被简化为隐藏在"黑箱"内部的东西。本章认为，AI的政治意义产生于技术性、主体间性和时间性中介的诠释实践之中。本章将阿伦特的政治哲学与伽达默尔诠释学对话，发展出一种跨越人-技术-世界关系的后现象学关系-时间性政治意义建构理论。针对后现象学仍属个人主义的指责，并以LLM生成的传记为例，本章展示了看似私密的人-LLM相遇如何具有世界性和集体性。当用户要求ChatGPT等系统描述自己时，他们并非简单地接受算法表征，而是对这些描述进行诠释、质疑、编辑、分享和公开检验。在此过程中，人们在情感共鸣、摩擦、公开重新表述和意义沉淀之间进行诠释性移动。这意味着后现象学分析中所谓的"微观层面"已经充满公共性：情感接受变得可传达，反思变得可问责，使用沉淀为共同的显现标准。同时，我们表明，一旦中介被视为关系性和时间性的，政治性就不再是"宏观"层面的附加物；它内在于技术放大与缩减、稳定与动摇的运动本身，由此构成一个可以进行判断的共同世界。本章最后讨论了后现象学中这种政治凸显对AI的设计与政策启示。
translation.brief: 该论文结合阿伦特政治哲学与伽达默尔诠释学，以LLM生成自传为例论证AI的政治意义内在于关系性、时间性中介的诠释实践，而非隐藏于黑箱之中。

papers.title: Automated Multi-Line Bug Repair Using Model Checker Aided LLMs: A Case Study on RISC-V Processors
papers.abstract: Functional verification of Register-Transfer Level(RTL) designs has become a critical bottleneck in modern semiconductor development, often consuming the majority of project resources. Debugging, in particular, remains an especially time-consuming task, requiring careful analysis of simulation traces or counterexamples. Recent work has explored applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to RTL debug and repair with great promise. However, the existing approaches typically are for single-line bugs, operate in open-loop, rely heavily on prompts or retrieval, lack scalability, and often produce incorrect fixes. In this paper, we propose a novel automated RTL bug repair methodology that combines LLMs, assertions, and a model checker to provide scalable, trustworthy semantic grounding and formal guarantees. Concretely, the methodology leverages failing assertions to guide the LLM in generating patches for multi-line bugs. Each candidate patch is formally verified using a model checker (JasperGold), ensuring only valid repairs are accepted. We evaluate the efficacy and scalability of our methodology on the BRISC-V RISC-V core using mutation testing, introducing several mutation types, and demonstrate that our methodology can repair up to 98% of single-line RTL bugs and 93% of the multi-line bugs. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to show automated, LLM-assisted RTL multi-line bug repair results on a complex RISC-V processor design in a scalable manner.

translation.title: 基于模型检测器辅助LLM的自动多行缺陷修复：以RISC-V处理器为例
translation.abstract: 寄存器传输级（RTL）设计的功能验证已成为现代半导体开发的关键瓶颈，往往消耗项目的大部分资源。调试尤其耗时，需要仔细分析仿真轨迹或反例。近期工作探索将大语言模型（LLM）应用于RTL调试与修复，前景可观。然而，现有方法通常只针对单行缺陷、以开环方式运行、严重依赖提示或检索、缺乏可扩展性，且常产生错误修复。本文提出一种新颖的自动RTL缺陷修复方法，结合LLM、断言和模型检测器，提供可扩展、可信的语义基础和形式化保证。具体而言，该方法利用失败的断言引导LLM为多行缺陷生成补丁。每个候选补丁使用模型检测器（JasperGold）进行形式化验证，确保只接受有效修复。我们在BRISC-V RISC-V核上通过变异测试评估该方法的有效性和可扩展性，引入了多种变异类型，结果表明该方法可修复高达98%的单行RTL缺陷和93%的多行缺陷。据我们所知，这是首个在复杂RISC-V处理器设计上以可扩展方式展示自动化LLM辅助RTL多行缺陷修复结果的工作。
translation.brief: 该论文提出结合LLM、断言与模型检测器JasperGold的闭环RTL缺陷自动修复方法，利用失败断言引导补丁生成并用形式化验证保证修复正确性。

papers.title: From archive to resource: bringing legacy data back to life at scale with large language models
papers.abstract: Pharmaceutical companies maintain vast archives of legacy preclinical study reports that contain study-context details, such as fasting, anesthesia, and laboratory instrumentation, that are rarely captured in structured data formats, yet they can correlate with clinical pathology parameters values and limit the reuse of historical data. This work demonstrates practical, scalable solutions to recover such descriptors from heterogeneous report texts using large language model (LLM)-based extraction pipelines developed independently by two industry teams. The pipelines identify and normalize metadata fields and return verbatim evidence with page and section reference, hasting human verification and iterative refinement. Evaluation of over 400 documents against expert-curated reference values showed high agreement across a broad set of metadata fields. Performance was strongest for consistently reported items and lower for descriptors subject to linguistic or report structure variability. Extraction time has shrunk from 25 minutes in the manual benchmark to 1.6 minutes. As a concrete biological demonstration, we show that fasting status extracted from report text was associated with species- and analyte-specific shifts in clinical chemistry parameters, illustrating how recovered metadata can improve selection of historical controls. Key strengths of the approach are scalability, traceability, and the ability to recover information missing from current industry standards. Main limitations are dependence on source-report quality and initial expert effort to define and refine schemas. These results establish how LLMs can convert heterogeneous, unstructured legacy reports into evidence-grounded, reusable and structured metadata, leading to better experimental comparability, and thus enabling reliable data pooling or informed virtual control selection.

translation.title: 从档案到资源：利用大语言模型大规模唤醒遗留数据
translation.abstract: 制药公司保存着大量临床前研究报告档案，其中包含禁食、麻醉、实验仪器等研究背景细节，这些信息很少以结构化数据格式记录，却可能与临床病理学参数值相关并限制历史数据的复用。本工作展示了使用基于大语言模型（LLM）的抽取流水线从异构报告文本中恢复此类描述符的实用、可扩展的解决方案，该流水线由两个行业团队独立开发。流水线识别并规范化元数据字段，返回带有页码和章节引用的逐字证据，辅助人工验证和迭代改进。对400多份文档与专家整理的参考值的评估显示，在广泛的元数据字段上具有高度一致性。对一致报告的项目性能最强，而对受语言或报告结构变化影响的描述符性能较低。抽取时间从人工基准的25分钟缩短至1.6分钟。作为具体的生物学演示，我们展示了从报告文本中抽取的禁食状态与临床化学参数的物种和分析物特异性变化相关，说明恢复的元数据可以改善历史对照的选择。该方法的主要优势是可扩展性、可追溯性以及恢复当前行业标准中缺失信息的能力。主要局限是对源报告质量的依赖以及定义和改进模式所需的初始专家投入。这些结果确立了LLM如何将异构、非结构化的遗留报告转换为有证据支撑、可复用且结构化的元数据，从而提升实验可比性，进而实现可靠的数据汇集或明智的虚拟对照选择。
translation.brief: 解决临床前遗留报告中结构化元数据缺失难以复用的问题，采用基于LLM的抽取流水线从异构报告文本中抽取并规范化元数据。

papers.title: What Transfers Across Protein Pockets? Experience Reuse in Molecular Optimization for Agentic Structure-Based Drug Design
papers.abstract: LLM agents optimize a ligand in a protein pocket by editing it step by step and docking each edit. Recent agents first spend extra dockings probing the complex with controlled edits; guidance induced from these probes is reported to help more than the chemical knowledge the model already carries. The probes are then discarded with the instance that produced them, so the obvious next step is to keep them in an experience base, letting a new pocket inherit what earlier ones already paid for. Such a base is read through a \emph{key}: the record properties under which past edits are pooled and a new one is looked up. Using the full log of one such run over the CrossDocked2020 test-set pockets, we ask whether its keys recur on a pocket the base has never seen and still separate improving from worsening edits. \crchange{Using} the contacts at the site being edited, the action, and the round as \crchange{a} key, the base separates them sharply. Within our analysis, this separation is largely explained by how much the edit changed the molecule's size, the action, and the round, none of which describes the target. That is not because the target is irrelevant: naming it outright separates them several times more sharply. For a pocket absent from the base, transfer must rely on a description rather than its identity. Among the exact-match descriptions we evaluate, the more specific ones rarely recur, whereas the coarser ones provide little separation; the signals that do transfer primarily describe the edit and the molecule it produced rather than the target. Under the representations and lookup scheme studied here, an experience base may be more useful for prioritizing an agent's own proposals for docking than for directly prescribing what to build.

translation.title: 什么能在蛋白口袋间迁移？面向智能体结构药物设计的分子优化中的经验复用
translation.abstract: LLM智能体通过逐步编辑配体并对每次编辑进行对接来优化蛋白口袋中的配体。现有智能体首先花费额外的对接来通过受控编辑探测复合物；据报道，从这些探测中归纳的引导比模型已有的化学知识更有帮助。这些探测随后随产生它们的实例一起被丢弃，因此显而易见的下一步是将它们保存在经验库中，让新的口袋继承先前口袋已经付出的代价。这样的库通过一个键（key）来读取：即过去编辑被汇集以及新编辑被查找时所依据的记录属性。利用一次此类运行在CrossDocked2020测试集口袋上的完整日志，我们探究其键是否在一个经验库从未见过的口袋上重现，并仍能区分改进与恶化的编辑。使用被编辑位点的接触、动作和轮次作为键，该库能清晰地区分它们。在我们的分析中，这种区分主要由编辑对分子大小的改变程度、动作和轮次解释，而这些都不描述靶标。这并非因为靶标无关紧要：直接指明靶标能将区分度提高数倍。对于经验库中不存在的口袋，迁移必须依赖描述而非其身份。在我们评估的精确匹配描述中，更具体的描述很少重现，而更粗略的描述提供的区分很小；能够迁移的信号主要描述编辑本身及其产生的分子，而非靶标。在本文研究的表示和查找方案下，经验库可能更适合用于对智能体自身的对接提议进行优先级排序，而非直接规定要构建什么。
translation.brief: 解决LLM药物设计智能体经验能否跨蛋白口袋迁移的问题，通过分析经验库键在未见口袋上的重现与区分能力来评估迁移性。

papers.title: LGMT: A Tool for Testing the Logical Reasoning Reliability of LLMs
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as reasoning components in modern software systems, yet a model that answers a logical query correctly can contradict itself when the same problem is restated in an equivalent form. Static benchmarks evaluate queries in isolation and therefore fail to expose such inconsistencies. To address this limitation, we present LGMT, an open-source tool that detects reasoning inconsistencies through metamorphic relations grounded in first-order logic. Given a source test case in premise-conclusion form, LGMT generates logically equivalent follow-up cases and checks whether the model's entailment predictions agree across the pair, without ground-truth labels. The tool provides 20 built-in metamorphic relations, supports custom ones verified by the Z3 theorem prover, and runs from a CLI or a web studio, including an offline mock mode requiring no API key. Across six widely used LLMs on a bundled benchmark of 3,091 metamorphic groups, LGMT reveals inconsistency rates ranging from 20.84% to 29.44%. LGMT is publicly available on GitHub at https://github.com/MaxwelsDonc/lgmt-tool, with a demonstration video at https://youtu.be/gou4opptu1U.

translation.title: LGMT：一个测试LLM逻辑推理可靠性的工具
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益成为现代软件系统中的推理组件，然而一个能正确回答逻辑查询的模型，当同一问题以等价形式重述时可能自相矛盾。静态基准孤立地评估查询，因此无法暴露此类不一致性。为解决这一局限，我们提出LGMT，一个开源工具，通过基于一阶逻辑的蜕变关系检测推理不一致性。给定一个前提-结论形式的源测试用例，LGMT生成逻辑等价的后续用例，并检查模型的蕴含预测在用例对之间是否一致，无需真实标签。该工具提供20个内置蜕变关系，支持经Z3定理证明器验证的自定义关系，可从CLI或Web工作室运行，包括无需API密钥的离线模拟模式。在六个广泛使用的LLM上，针对包含3,091个蜕变组的内置基准，LGMT揭示的不一致率介于20.84%至29.44%之间。LGMT已在GitHub上公开发布：https://github.com/MaxwelsDonc/lgmt-tool，演示视频见 https://youtu.be/gou4opptu1U。
translation.brief: 解决静态基准无法暴露LLM逻辑推理不一致性的问题，采用基于一阶逻辑蜕变关系的等价用例对生成与预测一致性检测。

papers.title: Toward Open ISA Supercomputing: A Comparative Study of RISC-V, Arm, and x86 Architectures on HPC Workloads
papers.abstract: RISC-V is emerging as a candidate architecture for high-performance computing (HPC), but its competitiveness against established x86 and Arm processors remains difficult to assess because existing studies use different platforms, workloads, and methodologies, and rarely consider energy efficiency. Our work provides an evaluation of contemporary HPC RISC-V, Arm, and x86 processors using a common software stack and methodology. We characterize the Sophgo SG2044 and compare it with the NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip and Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+ across four HPC benchmarks (STREAM, HPL, HPL-MxP, and HPCG) and four representative applications (iPIC3D, PLUTO, OpenFOAM, and llama.cpp). The version of HPL-MxP linked to OpenBLAS built and used for this work is made available as open-source software. The SG2044 reaches 8.02 GFLOP/s of FP64 performance and 7.8 GB/s of memory bandwidth per core, increasing to 294 GFLOP/s and 107 GB/s at 64 cores. L2-cache-aware process placement enables near-linear scaling up to 16 cores, beyond which memory-bandwidth saturation limits further gains. Across generations of RISC-V hardware, in the context of the Monte Cimone (MC) project, the SG2044-based MCv3 doubles both single-core performance and peak memory bandwidth relative to MCv2, while improving memory bandwidth, node-level FP64 performance, and energy efficiency by approximately 100x, 158x, and 10x, over MCv1. Against the Arm and x86 systems, the SG2044 shows 8-15x less absolute performance, reflecting its narrower vector resources and less advanced technology node, but delivers competitive scaling and energy efficiency on several workloads. Its most notable result is LLM decode, where 64-core execution provides the highest relative scaling and energy efficiency among the evaluated platforms while exceeding Intel in throughput. Our results show that RISC-V processors are closing the gap with the competition.

translation.title: 迈向开放ISA超级计算：RISC-V、Arm与x86架构在HPC工作负载上的比较研究
translation.abstract: RISC-V正成为高性能计算（HPC）的候选架构，但由于现有研究使用不同的平台、工作负载和方法，且很少考虑能效，其相对于成熟的x86和Arm处理器的竞争力仍难以评估。我们的工作使用统一的软件栈和方法对当代HPC RISC-V、Arm和x86处理器进行评估。我们表征了Sophgo SG2044，并将其与NVIDIA Grace CPU Superchip和Intel Xeon Platinum 8480+在四个HPC基准（STREAM、HPL、HPL-MxP和HPCG）和四个代表性应用（iPIC3D、PLUTO、OpenFOAM和llama.cpp）上进行比较。本工作构建并使用的链接OpenBLAS的HPL-MxP版本已作为开源软件发布。SG2044单核达到8.02 GFLOP/s的FP64性能和7.8 GB/s的内存带宽，64核时提升至294 GFLOP/s和107 GB/s。感知L2缓存的进程放置实现了接近线性的扩展直至16核，超过此范围后内存带宽饱和限制了进一步收益。在RISC-V硬件的世代演进中，在Monte Cimone（MC）项目背景下，基于SG2044的MCv3相对MCv2将单核性能和峰值内存带宽翻倍，而相对MCv1将内存带宽、节点级FP64性能和能效分别提升约100倍、158倍和10倍。与Arm和x86系统相比，SG2044的绝对性能低8-15倍，反映了其较窄的向量资源和较落后的工艺节点，但在多个工作负载上提供了有竞争力的扩展性和能效。其最显著的成果是LLM解码，其中64核执行在所评估平台中提供了最高的相对扩展性和能效，同时吞吐量超过Intel。我们的结果表明RISC-V处理器正在缩小与竞争对手的差距。
translation.brief: 解决RISC-V在HPC领域竞争力难以评估的问题，采用统一软件栈和方法对RISC-V、Arm、x86处理器进行基准与应用的对比评测。

papers.title: InferSlice: A Reference Architecture for SLO-driven LLM Inference over a Telco Wide-Area Network
papers.abstract: LLM inference is increasingly deployed as a core service for enterprise and interactive applications, but sovereignty, compliance, latency and resource-locality requirements can limit the suitability of centralised cloud deployments. Telco operators offer geographically distributed compute and network infrastructure for addressing these constraints. However, existing LLM serving frameworks are designed for tightly coupled data centres and provide limited support for coordinating geographically distributed and heterogeneous resources. We present InferSlice, a reference architecture for Service-Level Objective (SLO)-driven LLM inference over a telco infrastructure, integrating network slicing, GPU partitioning, elastic serving and observability. Led by BT in collaboration with the University of Bristol and NVIDIA, and realised on the JOINER UK national-scale wide-area network (WAN), InferSlice is evaluated on service differentiation across tiers, elastic scale-out, client-edge bandwidth as a bottleneck, and the reach of tensor, pipeline, data parallelism, and prefill/decode disaggregation over the WAN. Our results show that, on a general-purpose telco network, tiers yield distinct latency-throughput regimes, and weight streaming shortens scale-out time. Replication is placement-insensitive but memory-bound; pipeline parallelism tolerates near- and mid-cross-site hops, while tensor parallelism and disaggregation fail beyond a single subnet hop. We share practical insights from operating SLO-driven inference on a telco network, lessons learned and open questions, and hope to encourage further research on distributed and heterogeneous LLM inference systems.

translation.title: InferSlice：面向电信广域网上SLO驱动的LLM推理的参考架构
translation.abstract: LLM推理日益被部署为企业和交互式应用的核心服务，但主权、合规、延迟和资源本地性要求可能限制集中式云部署的适用性。电信运营商提供地理分布的计算和网络基础设施来应对这些约束。然而，现有的LLM服务框架是为紧耦合的数据中心设计的，对协调地理分布的异构资源支持有限。我们提出InferSlice，一个在电信基础设施上进行服务级别目标（SLO）驱动的LLM推理的参考架构，集成了网络切片、GPU分区、弹性服务和可观测性。由BT牵头，与University of Bristol和NVIDIA合作，并在JOINER英国国家级广域网（WAN）上实现，InferSlice在跨层级服务差异化、弹性扩容、客户端-边缘带宽瓶颈以及张量、流水线、数据并行和prefill/decode分离在WAN上的可达性方面进行了评估。我们的结果表明，在通用电信网络上，不同层级产生不同的延迟-吞吐量模式，权重流式传输缩短了扩容时间。副本对放置不敏感但受内存限制；流水线并行可容忍近程和中程跨站点跳数，而张量并行和分离在超过单个子网跳数后失效。我们分享了在电信网络上运营SLO驱动推理的实践见解、经验教训和开放问题，希望鼓励对分布式异构LLM推理系统的进一步研究。
translation.brief: 解决集中式云部署难以满足LLM推理的主权、合规与延迟要求的问题，提出集成网络切片、GPU分区与弹性服务的电信广域网SLO驱动推理参考架构。

papers.title: StateMirror: Pre-Execution Detection of Hallucinated Tool Calls in Coding Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based coding agents may propose invalid actions that are not applicable in the execution environment, such as accessing non-existent paths or missing packages. We term this mismatch hallucinated tool use. A preliminary study of 4,398 agent trajectories reveals that these hallucinations are pervasive and costly, requiring a median of 3 additional interaction steps and 22.4K tokens to recover. Existing frameworks rely on reactive, post-execution feedback, wasting runtime resources. Nevertheless, since an agent's execution environment is grounded in concrete codebase and harness components, many action prerequisites can be extracted and validated prior to execution. To this end, we introduce StateMirror, a lightweight pre-execution detector. StateMirror intercepts actions at the harness boundary, extracts state predicates via AST and command analysis, and deterministically validates them against the live repository. By pinpointing exact environment mismatches before execution, StateMirror preempts invalid actions and subsequent recovery cycles. Evaluation on 2,508 actions shows StateMirror achieves 0.940 precision and 0.817 F1 in detecting such hallucinations, surpassing the strongest LLM judge by 35.3% in F1 while reducing median detection latency from 17.73 s to 1.50 ms with zero token consumption. For practical mitigation, StateMirror's pre-execution feedback enables agents to rectify over 95% of hallucinated tool calls. During live mitigation on 79 tasks, StateMirror reduces agent execution time by 15.8% and token consumption by 11.8% while maintaining task resolution.

translation.title: StateMirror：面向编码Agent的幻觉工具调用执行前检测
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的编码Agent可能提出在执行环境中不可用的无效动作，例如访问不存在的路径或缺失的软件包。我们将这种不匹配称为幻觉工具使用。一项对4,398条Agent轨迹的初步研究显示，这类幻觉普遍存在且代价高昂，恢复平均需要额外的3次交互步骤和22.4K tokens。现有框架依赖被动式的执行后反馈，浪费运行时资源。然而，由于Agent的执行环境根植于具体的代码库和harness组件，许多动作前提条件可以在执行前被提取并验证。为此，我们提出StateMirror，一个轻量级的执行前检测器。StateMirror在harness边界拦截动作，通过AST和命令分析提取状态谓词，并对实时仓库进行确定性验证。通过在执行前精确定位环境不匹配，StateMirror预先阻止了无效动作及其后续的恢复循环。在2,508个动作上的评估显示，StateMirror在检测此类幻觉方面达到0.940精确率和0.817 F1，比最强的LLM judge高出35.3%的F1，同时将中位检测延迟从17.73秒降至1.50毫秒，且零token消耗。在实际缓解方面，StateMirror的执行前反馈使Agent能够纠正超过95%的幻觉工具调用。在79个任务的实时缓解中，StateMirror在保持任务解决率的同时，将Agent执行时间降低15.8%，token消耗降低11.8%。
translation.brief: 针对编码Agent提出的幻觉工具调用问题，提出在执行前于harness边界拦截动作并通过AST分析和实时仓库验证状态谓词的轻量级检测器StateMirror。

papers.title: Do Language Models Trust Their Own Justifications? A Study on Functional Consistency
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely adopted in text classification tasks, where they not only output class predictions but also generate explanations that highlight the tokens deemed most relevant for reaching the predicted label. Yet it remains unclear whether these highlighted elements are behaviorally consistent with the model's own predictions under targeted interventions, which we refer to as functional auto-consistency. While much of the literature evaluates the textual plausibility of such explanations, few studies assess their functional consistency with the model's actual behavior. In this work, we propose an experimental framework based on the principle of auto-consistency: if a model identifies certain tokens as decisive, then isolating, removing, or semantically inverting them should produce systematic and interpretable changes in its predictions. We operationalize this evaluation through sufficiency, comprehensiveness, and counterfactuality metrics, and conduct experiments on IMDB and Steam reviews across both closed-source (GPT-4o-mini) and open-source LLMs (Gemma3, Granite8B, DeepSeek). Results show that GPT-4o-mini follows the expected progression across all metrics, Gemma3 and Granite8B maintain coherence under sufficiency but lose consistency under more demanding interventions, while DeepSeek variants display structural deviations, either failing to preserve sufficiency or overreacting under comprehensiveness and counterfactuality. These findings show that explanation reliability varies across LLM families and scales, with smaller models displaying contradictions and larger ones exhibiting over-sensitivity. By combining sufficiency, comprehensiveness, and counterfactuality, our approach provides a systematic methodology for assessing the functional consistency of LLM self-explanations.

translation.title: 语言模型相信自己的解释吗？一项功能性一致性研究
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已被广泛应用于文本分类任务，它们不仅输出类别预测，还会生成突出显示对预测标签最相关token的解释。然而，这些被突出显示的元素在针对性干预下是否与模型自身的预测在行为上一致，即我们所称的功能性自一致性，仍不清楚。尽管大量文献评估了此类解释的文本合理性，但很少有研究评估其与模型实际行为的功能一致性。在本工作中，我们提出一个基于自一致性原则的实验框架：如果模型将某些token识别为决定性的，那么隔离、移除或语义反转这些token应当导致其预测产生系统性且可解释的变化。我们通过充分性、全面性和反事实性指标来操作化这一评估，并在IMDB和Steam评论上对闭源（GPT-4o-mini）和开源LLM（Gemma3、Granite8B、DeepSeek）进行实验。结果表明，GPT-4o-mini在所有指标上均符合预期 progression，Gemma3和Granite8B在充分性下保持一致但在更严格的干预下失去一致性，而DeepSeek变体表现出结构性偏差，要么无法保持充分性，要么在全面性和反事实性下反应过度。这些发现表明，解释的可靠性因LLM家族和规模而异，较小的模型表现出矛盾，较大的模型表现出过度敏感。通过结合充分性、全面性和反事实性，我们的方法为评估LLM自我解释的功能一致性提供了系统化的方法论。
translation.brief: 针对LLM自我解释是否与其实际预测行为一致的问题，提出基于充分性、全面性和反事实性干预实验的功能性自一致性评估框架。

papers.title: OpenDraco: A Platform for Engineering and Experimenting with Configurable Multi-Agent Architectures for Software Engineering
papers.abstract: Experimenting with LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) involves an iterative cycle of modeling configurations, executing and evaluating them, comparing results, and refining system designs. Existing approaches provide limited end-to-end support for this experimentation lifecycle. We present OpenDraco, an open-source platform that integrates these activities into a single workflow. OpenDraco represents agents, prompts, tools, models, parameters, and communication topology in exportable, versioned JSON specifications, translated into executable LangGraph workflows supporting different interaction structures. Users can modify and re-evaluate configurations using local or cloud-based LLMs. We instantiate OpenDraco for automated program repair (APR) and evaluate a sequential baseline and seven reconstructed configurations on synthetic and real-world SWE-bench Lite issues. The results reveal substantial cost differences among configurations with similar repair outcomes, while the baseline resolves 12 of 77 SWE-bench issues using open-source LLMs. Additional proof-of-concept tasks illustrate applicability beyond APR. OpenDraco supports iterative experimentation with heterogeneous MAS configurations, enabling researchers to examine their outcomes and costs within a common environment. Demonstration video: https://youtu.be/278sOR4lBEk.

translation.title: OpenDraco：面向软件工程的可配置多Agent架构工程与实验平台
translation.abstract: 对基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）进行实验涉及一个迭代循环：建模配置、执行与评估、比较结果以及改进系统设计。现有方法对这一实验生命周期提供的端到端支持有限。我们提出OpenDraco，一个将这些活动整合到单一工作流中的开源平台。OpenDraco将Agent、提示词、工具、模型、参数和通信拓扑表示为可导出、可版本化的JSON规范，并转换为支持不同交互结构的可执行LangGraph工作流。用户可以使用本地或云端LLM修改和重新评估配置。我们将OpenDraco实例化用于自动化程序修复（APR），并在合成和真实SWE-bench Lite问题上评估一个顺序基线和七个重构配置。结果显示，修复结果相近的配置之间存在显著的成本差异，而基线在使用开源LLM的情况下解决了77个SWE-bench问题中的12个。额外的概念验证任务说明了其在APR之外的适用性。OpenDraco支持对异构MAS配置的迭代实验，使研究人员能够在统一环境中考察其结果和成本。演示视频：https://youtu.be/278sOR4lBEk。
translation.brief: 针对LLM多智能体系统实验缺乏端到端支持的问题，提出将配置建模、执行、评估整合为单一工作流的开源平台OpenDraco。

papers.title: Foundation Models Meet Power Grid Topology for Cascade Prediction
papers.abstract: Accurate early-stage prediction of cascading failure severity is essential for assessing the vulnerability of power transmission networks. However, existing data-driven approaches often rely on network-specific representations, limiting their generalizability across power system topologies. This work investigates the complementary capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for cascading failure severity prediction. First, standalone LLM predictors are developed using a LoRA-fine-tuned LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct model with varying degrees of topological information. A hybrid Graph-LLM fusion framework is then proposed, integrating a Topology-Aware Graph Attention Transformer (TAGAT) with the LLM through confidence-gated fusion. TAGAT captures structural dependencies among transmission lines, while the LLM extracts representations from early-stage power-flow observations and aggregated cascade descriptors. The frameworks are evaluated on 30,000 simulated cascading failure scenarios for each of the IEEE 118-bus and IEEE 300-bus systems. Using only the first four cascade steps, the hybrid framework achieves weighted F1 scores of 0.94 and 0.92, respectively. In cross-system transfer from IEEE 118-bus to IEEE 300-bus, it achieves 0.72 zero-shot accuracy, improving to 0.83 with limited target-system calibration, outperforming standalone models and conventional baselines. These results show the potential of combining graph-based structural learning with foundation models to improve cascading failure severity prediction and cross-system transferability.

translation.title: 基础模型与电网拓扑结合的级联故障预测
translation.abstract: 对级联故障严重性的准确早期预测对于评估输电网络的脆弱性至关重要。然而，现有的数据驱动方法通常依赖特定于网络的表示，限制了其在不同电力系统拓扑间的泛化能力。本工作研究大语言模型（LLM）和图神经网络（GNN）在级联故障严重性预测中的互补能力。首先，使用经过LoRA微调的LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct模型并加入不同程度的拓扑信息，构建独立的LLM预测器。随后提出一个混合Graph-LLM融合框架，通过置信度门控融合将拓扑感知图注意力Transformer（TAGAT）与LLM集成。TAGAT捕捉输电线路间的结构依赖，而LLM从早期潮流观测和聚合的级联描述符中提取表示。框架在IEEE 118节点和IEEE 300节点系统各30,000个模拟级联故障场景上进行评估。仅使用前四个级联步骤，混合框架分别达到0.94和0.92的加权F1分数。在从IEEE 118节点到IEEE 300节点的跨系统迁移中，零样本准确率达到0.72，经有限的目标系统校准后提升至0.83，优于独立模型和传统基线。这些结果表明，结合基于图的结构学习与基础模型在改进级联故障严重性预测和跨系统可迁移性方面具有潜力。
translation.brief: 针对级联故障严重性预测跨拓扑泛化差的问题，提出融合拓扑感知图注意力Transformer与LoRA微调LLM的置信度门控混合预测框架。

papers.title: Agent-Based Transport Model Calibration via Online Stochastic Batch Optimization
papers.abstract: Calibrating agent-based models (ABMs) is computationally demanding, as traditional black-box optimization typically requires hundreds or thousands of independent simulation runs. To reduce this burden, we introduce an online calibration framework that estimates parameters within a single simulation run. The approach combines black-box optimization with stochastic batch optimization, a method widely applied in machine learning but not yet explored in ABM calibration. Using MATSim as a case study, we treat each simulation iteration as a stochastic batch, enabling incremental parameter updates as agents make decisions. This online calibration paradigm allows model parameters and agent behaviors to co-evolve, achieving convergence without restarting the simulation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method by calibrating utility function parameters in MATSim for a large-scale transportation scenario of Switzerland. Results show that mode shares align closely with observed data within a typical simulation timeframe, confirming the feasibility and efficiency of the approach. By embedding calibration directly into the simulation loop, our method opens new possibilities for real-time, scalable, and efficient calibration of complex ABMs.

translation.title: 基于在线随机批量优化的Agent式交通模型校准
translation.abstract: 校准基于Agent的模型（ABM）计算开销巨大，因为传统的黑盒优化通常需要数百或数千次独立仿真运行。为减轻这一负担，我们提出一个在线校准框架，可在单次仿真运行内估计参数。该方法将黑盒优化与随机批量优化相结合，后者在机器学习中广泛应用但尚未在ABM校准中被探索。以MATSim为案例研究，我们将每次仿真迭代视为一个随机批量，使参数能够随着Agent的决策进行增量更新。这种在线校准范式允许模型参数和Agent行为共同演化，无需重启仿真即可实现收敛。我们通过在瑞士大规模交通场景中校准MATSim的效用函数参数来展示方法的有效性。结果表明，在典型的仿真时间范围内，出行方式分担率与观测数据高度吻合，验证了该方法的可行性和效率。通过将校准直接嵌入仿真循环，我们的方法为复杂ABM的实时、可扩展和高效校准开辟了新的可能性。
translation.brief: 针对ABM校准需要大量仿真运行的问题，提出将随机批量优化嵌入单次仿真运行、实现参数随Agent决策增量更新的在线校准框架。

papers.title: CounselPlex: A Stressor-Aware Full-Duplex Counseling Model
papers.abstract: Full-duplex speech models can listen and speak at the same time, enabling natural, low-latency interaction. In counseling, however, these models often focus on the latest utterance and lose track of the seeker's underlying problem. We call this failure Stressor Blindness. We propose CounselPlex, a stressor-aware full-duplex framework that uses two operations. CounselPlex updates a short stressor state during seeker silence and injects this state into <PAD> positions while listening. We also introduce RoPE Position Shift Augmentation (RPSA), which broadens positional coverage during training and improves performance at longer turn depths in our evaluation. LLM-judge evaluations show improved counseling quality and stressor grounding over strong baselines.

translation.title: CounselPlex：一种压力源感知的全双工心理咨询模型
translation.abstract: 全双工语音模型可以同时听和说，实现自然、低延迟的交互。然而在心理咨询场景中，这些模型往往只关注最新的话语，而丢失了对求助者潜在问题的追踪。我们将这种失败称为压力源盲区（Stressor Blindness）。我们提出 CounselPlex，一个压力源感知的全双工框架，它使用两种操作：CounselPlex 在求助者沉默期间更新一个简短的压力源状态，并在倾听时将该状态注入 <PAD> 位置。我们还引入了 RoPE 位置偏移增强（RPSA），它在训练期间拓宽位置覆盖范围，并提升了评估中较长轮次深度下的性能。LLM 评审评估显示，与强基线相比，CounselPlex 在心理咨询质量和压力源锚定方面均有提升。
translation.brief: 针对全双工心理咨询模型遗忘求助者潜在压力源的问题，提出在沉默期更新压力源状态并在倾听时注入该状态、辅以 RoPE 位置偏移增强的 CounselPlex 框架。

papers.title: Beyond Hotness: High-Resolution Memory Characterization of Cloud and LLM Workloads for Tiered Memory with ARM SPE
papers.abstract: Memory demands from data analytics and LLM workloads grow rapidly, driving up memory costs in cloud and data centers. Multi-tier memory has emerged as a promising solution to balance performance and cost. However, effectively leveraging it requires a deep understanding of workload memory behaviors. This work introduces a high-resolution memory characterization methodology for analyzing workload-specific opportunities for multi-tier memory usage. In response to the increasing deployment of ARM-based processors in data centers, we implement our methodology using the recent Statistical Profiling Extension (SPE) for ARM. By characterizing eight memory-intensive workloads from CloudSuite and LLM applications, we identify region-specific access patterns, evaluate the effectiveness of cloud-oriented cache hierarchies, and propose new metrics based on memory idle periods and latency profiles to determine suitable data placement for tiered memory.

translation.title: 超越热度：基于 ARM SPE 的云与 LLM 负载高分辨率内存特征分析以支持分层内存
translation.abstract: 数据分析和 LLM 负载的内存需求快速增长，推高了云和数据中心的内存成本。多层级内存已成为平衡性能与成本的有前景方案。然而，有效利用它需要深入理解负载的内存行为。本工作提出一种高分辨率内存特征分析方法，用于分析特定负载使用多层级内存的机会。鉴于基于 ARM 的处理器在数据中心日益普及，我们使用最新的 ARM 统计分析扩展（SPE）实现该方法。通过对来自 CloudSuite 的八个内存密集型负载和 LLM 应用进行特征分析，我们识别出区域特定的访问模式，评估了面向云的缓存层次结构的有效性，并提出了基于内存空闲周期和延迟画像的新指标，以确定适合分层内存的数据放置。
translation.brief: 针对多层级内存缺乏对负载内存行为深入理解的问题，提出基于 ARM SPE 的高分辨率内存特征分析方法，并据此提出用于数据放置决策的新指标。

papers.title: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction from Structured Metadata and Climate Science Publications
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of scientific literature far outpaces the speed of manual curation, creating a fundamental bottleneck in extracting structured knowledge from scientific texts. To address this, we introduce an agentic, ontology-guided framework for knowledge graph (KG) construction. Our framework utilizes specialized agents for document understanding, information extraction, ontology conformance, and entity linking. First, an LLM extracts factual knowledge in the form of triples with explicit textual evidence from research papers. Then the triplets undergo a multistage verification process to ground the triplets in the ontology. By enforcing schema constraints and requiring evidence in the form of text fragments, we ensure the data is both semantically consistent and traceable. In an agreement study over 1,000 extracted triplets, Gemini-2.5-flash achieves Cohen's $\kappa$ scores of 0.640--0.700 against three human annotators, matching the human--human agreement range of 0.616--0.689. We applied this framework to 2,000 scientific publications and construct a novel, ontology-grounded KG for climate science with 133,990 nodes and 755,308 relations; of the 23,327 triplets that the publications contribute after validation, 98.96\% are judged correct. The pipeline code and KG is publicly available https://github.com/aayushacharya/climatekg.

translation.title: 基于本体引导、从结构化元数据与气候科学出版物构建知识图谱
translation.abstract: 科学文献的快速扩张远超人工整理的速度，形成了从科学文本中提取结构化知识的根本性瓶颈。为此，我们引入一个智能体化的、本体引导的知识图谱（KG）构建框架。该框架利用专门的智能体进行文档理解、信息抽取、本体一致性和实体链接。首先，LLM 从研究论文中抽取带有明确文本证据的三元组形式的事实知识；然后三元组经过多阶段验证过程以锚定到本体。通过强制模式约束并要求以文本片段形式提供证据，我们确保数据在语义上一致且可追溯。在一项针对 1,000 个抽取三元组的一致性研究中，Gemini-2.5-flash 相对三位人类标注者取得 0.640–0.700 的 Cohen's $\kappa$ 分数，与人类之间 0.616–0.689 的一致性范围相当。我们将该框架应用于 2,000 篇科学出版物，构建了一个新颖的、基于本体的气候科学知识图谱，包含 133,990 个节点和 755,308 条关系；在出版物贡献的 23,327 个经验证的三元组中，98.96% 被判定为正确。流水线代码和 KG 已公开于 https://github.com/aayushacharya/climatekg。
translation.brief: 针对科学文献人工整理速度不足的问题，提出由多个专门智能体执行抽取、本体一致性验证和实体链接的本体引导知识图谱自动构建框架。

papers.title: Agentic Hazard Mapper: Emulating Expert Map-Making with AI Agents for Risk Communication
papers.abstract: Hazard maps are essential tools for public risk communication, preparedness, and evacuation planning, yet effective cartographic design is not always ensured due to limited access to cartographic expertise across local governments and communities. We present Agentic Hazard Mapper, a multi-agent system that automates hazard-map production by emulating professional cartographic workflows and iterative design trade-offs while adapting design decisions to different data, locations, and hazard contexts. We conducted a formative study with map experts to inform the system design, followed by a user study and interviews with map experts and hazard practitioners. The generated maps improved participants' spatial understanding and evacuation-planning performance, reduced perceived workload and task completion time, and were generally preferred over corresponding municipal maps. We further discuss human oversight, adaptation across users and communication contexts, and opportunities to extend agentic support across broader stages of hazard-map production and risk communication.

translation.title: Agentic Hazard Mapper：用 AI 智能体模拟专家制图以支持风险沟通
translation.abstract: 灾害地图是公众风险沟通、备灾和疏散规划的重要工具，但由于地方政府和社区难以获得制图专业知识，有效的地图设计并不总能得到保证。我们提出 Agentic Hazard Mapper，一个多智能体系统，通过模拟专业制图工作流程和迭代设计权衡来自动化灾害地图制作，并根据不同的数据、地点和灾害情境调整设计决策。我们与地图专家开展了形成性研究以指导系统设计，随后进行了用户研究以及对地图专家和灾害从业者的访谈。生成的地图提升了参与者的空间理解和疏散规划表现，降低了感知工作量和任务完成时间，并且总体上比相应的市政地图更受青睐。我们进一步讨论了人类监督、跨用户和沟通情境的适应性，以及将智能体支持扩展到灾害地图制作和风险沟通更广泛阶段的机会。
translation.brief: 针对地方政府缺乏制图专业知识导致灾害地图质量不佳的问题，提出通过多智能体模拟专业制图工作流来自动生成灾害地图的系统。

papers.title: ActionRAG: Evidence-Refining Graph Diffusion for Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents need long-term memory that can recover precise and mutually consistent evidence from growing interaction histories, particularly when answers depend on relations among facts rather than isolated semantic matches. Current memory pipelines remain vulnerable at two stages: indexing errors can fragment repeated entities or merge distinct ones, and online retrieval often treats initial similarity scores as final even when the surrounding graph provides evidence for revising them. We introduce ActionRAG, a graph memory architecture that couples cautious indexing with query-time graph retroevaluation. Its indexing pipeline reconciles type labels and applies tiered entity resolution. Given a query, dual-channel entity and triple retrieval forms an initial evidence set and induces a bounded local graph. Query-conditioned receiver-normalized diffusion refines triple scores using local path structure. Seed protection, hub-penalized flux, and triple materialization preserve direct evidence while recovering missed connections. We evaluate ActionRAG on MemoryAgentBench (MAB), which tests accurate retrieval, conflict resolution, long-range understanding, and test-time learning. Across its eight deterministic-scoring columns, ActionRAG achieves 55.1 average accuracy, improving over the strongest retrieval-based memory baseline by 5.4 points. Under MAB's query-time cost accounting, mean synthesis cost stays below \$0.001 per query on the four reported cost columns, and the sum of separately measured retrieval-side p99 components is 440.7 ms on our consumer Apple Silicon setup.

translation.title: ActionRAG：面向 LLM 智能体长期记忆的证据精炼图扩散方法
translation.abstract: LLM 智能体需要能够从不断增长的交互历史中恢复精确且相互一致证据的长期记忆，尤其是当答案依赖于事实之间的关系而非孤立的语义匹配时。当前的记忆流水线在两个阶段仍然脆弱：索引错误可能碎片化重复实体或合并不同实体；在线检索往往将初始相似度分数视为最终结果，即使周围图结构提供了修改它们的证据。我们提出 ActionRAG，一种将谨慎索引与查询时图回溯评估相结合的图记忆架构。其索引流水线协调类型标签并应用分层实体消解。给定查询时，双通道的实体和三元组检索形成初始证据集并诱导一个有界局部图。查询条件下的接收者归一化扩散利用局部路径结构精炼三元组分数。种子保护、枢纽惩罚通量和三元组物化在保留直接证据的同时恢复遗漏的连接。我们在 MemoryAgentBench（MAB）上评估 ActionRAG，该基准测试精确检索、冲突消解、长程理解和测试时学习。在其八个确定性评分列上，ActionRAG 取得 55.1 的平均准确率，比最强的基于检索的记忆基线提升 5.4 分。在 MAB 的查询时成本核算下，在四个报告的成本列上平均合成成本保持在每查询 \$0.001 以下，在我们消费级 Apple Silicon 设备上单独测量的检索侧 p99 分量之和为 440.7 ms。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 智能体长期记忆中索引错误和检索分数不可修正的问题，提出结合谨慎索引与查询时图扩散回溯评估的 ActionRAG 图记忆架构。

papers.title: Semantic Representation for Agentic Self-Play in Automated Laboratories
papers.abstract: Navigating complex, high-dimensional biological search spaces necessitates scalable physical and computational intelligence to explore beyond local optima through iterative self-play across ideation, experimentation, and automation. Translating experimental designs into reliable physical execution remains bottlenecked by static laboratory automation and unmodeled physical variability. To address this, we introduce VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories, or VERID, a foundational infrastructure designed to bridge the gap between the high-level reasoning of artificial intelligence (AI) agents and complex, error-prone physical realities of wet labs. VERID is a persistent, high-fidelity semantic digital twin of the laboratory workcell that provides four core services: queryable introspection for agentic reasoning, time-compressed simulation for protocol validation, comprehensive trace persistence for a complete scientific record, and a framework for safe execution. We present three case studies using aqueous dye and deionized water mixtures to validate the optical and fluidic foundations of VERID. These studies demonstrate how VERID enables pre-emptive detection of critical errors in experimental protocols, stateful mid-run error recovery and post-hoc identification of subtle physical failures. The simulation functions as a discrete accounting engine, allowing agents to safely and inexpensively explore experimental designs in silico and refine experimental strategies through iterative self-play. VERID also captures structured multimodal experimental data for downstream analysis, knowledge mining and agent training. We argue that this semantic layer is an essential prerequisite for deploying autonomous agents in the biochemical and biomedical sciences, ensuring data integrity, operational safety, and paving the way for tackling previously intractable grand challenges in biology.

translation.title: 面向自动化实验室智能体自博弈的语义表示
translation.abstract: 在复杂、高维的生物搜索空间中导航，需要可扩展的物理与计算智能，通过在构思、实验和自动化之间的迭代自博弈来探索局部最优之外的空间。将实验设计转化为可靠的物理执行仍受限于静态的实验室自动化和未建模的物理变异性。为此，我们提出了 VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories（VERID），一个旨在弥合人工智能（AI）智能体高层推理与湿实验室复杂、易错的物理现实之间差距的基础设施。VERID 是实验室工作单元的持久、高保真语义数字孪生，提供四项核心服务：支持智能体推理的可查询内省、用于协议验证的时间压缩仿真、构成完整科学记录的全面轨迹持久化，以及安全执行框架。我们通过三个使用水性染料与去离子水混合物的案例研究验证了 VERID 的光学与流体基础。这些研究展示了 VERID 如何实现对实验协议中关键错误的事前检测、运行中有状态的错误恢复，以及对细微物理故障的事后识别。仿真充当离散的核算引擎，使智能体能够在计算机中安全且低成本地探索实验设计，并通过迭代自博弈改进实验策略。VERID 还捕获结构化的多模态实验数据，用于下游分析、知识挖掘和智能体训练。我们认为，这一语义层是在生物化学与生物医学科学中部署自主智能体的必要前提，可确保数据完整性与操作安全，并为攻克此前难以处理的生物学重大挑战铺平道路。
translation.brief: 解决AI智能体与湿实验室物理现实之间的鸿沟问题，核心方法是构建实验室的语义数字孪生基础设施VERID，提供内省、仿真、轨迹持久化和安全执行四项服务。

papers.title: Density control of large-scale multi-agent systems via tuning of agent interactions
papers.abstract: Collective behavior in biological systems emerges through adaptive interactions among units, enabling large populations to coordinate without centralized control. This mechanism raises the question of whether collective behavior in engineered multi-agent systems can likewise be regulated by modifying the interaction law between agents, rather than by directly controlling individual units. To answer this question, we consider large-scale multi-agent systems evolving on a ring and treat the interaction kernel as a time-varying control variable whose evolution regulates the collective dynamics. Using a mean-field formulation, we develop a framework for the analysis and design of kernel-based controllers. We derive explicit conditions for controllability in application-relevant scenarios, and synthesize a state-feedback controller to regulate the kernel dynamics, validated on the microscopic, discrete dynamics. Numerical simulations demonstrate the approach's effectiveness and robustness to unmodeled perturbations. This work constitutes a first step in the design of bio-inspired control strategies for large-scale multi-agent systems by modulation of interactions between agents.

translation.title: 通过调节智能体交互实现大规模多智能体系统的密度控制
translation.abstract: 生物系统中的集体行为通过单元间的自适应交互涌现，使大规模群体无需集中控制即可协调。这引出一个问题：工程化多智能体系统中的集体行为是否同样可以通过修改智能体之间的交互规律而非直接控制个体单元来调节。为回答该问题，我们考虑在环上演化的大规模多智能体系统，并将交互核视为时变控制变量，其演化调节集体动力学。基于平均场表述，我们发展了基于核的控制器分析与设计框架。我们推导了在应用相关场景下可控性的显式条件，并综合出一个调节核动力学的状态反馈控制器，在微观离散动力学上进行了验证。数值仿真展示了该方法的有效性及对未建模扰动的鲁棒性。这项工作是通过调节智能体间交互来设计大规模多智能体系统仿生控制策略的第一步。
translation.brief: 解决大规模多智能体系统集体行为的调控问题，核心方法是将智能体交互核作为时变控制变量，基于平均场框架设计状态反馈控制器。

papers.title: AI Alignment for Digital Democracy: Fairer Voters Representation against LLM Biases
papers.abstract: AI representation is emerging in digital democracy, assisting in voter emulation and decision-making. Large language models (LLMs) behave differently depending on the model, the prompt context, and the voter information they receive, representing some groups more accurately than others and potentially making the emulation unfair to certain groups. We investigate demographic biases in LLM-emulated electorates: how accurately LLMs represent individual votes, whether some voter groups are represented more accurately than others, and whether AI alignment can reduce these disparities without sacrificing overall accuracy. Using three U.S. presidential elections, we compare a closed-source and an open-source LLM across voters' demographic features and test AI alignment strategies toward fairer voter representation. Removing gender from the voter profile reduces the largest group error of the models by 22-42%, and removing education reduces it by 64%, whereas removing self-reported race increases the mean group error by over 40%, all without lowering accuracy. Common alignment strategies, such as repeated queries or fairness instructions, do not reduce these errors and can double them.

translation.title: 面向数字民主的AI对齐：对抗LLM偏差的更公平选民代表
translation.abstract: AI代表正在数字民主中兴起，协助模拟选民和辅助决策。大语言模型（LLM）的行为因模型、提示上下文及其接收的选民信息而异，对某些群体的代表比对其他群体更准确，可能使模拟对某些群体不公平。我们研究LLM模拟选民中的人口统计偏差：LLM对个人投票的代表准确度如何、某些选民群体是否被更准确地代表，以及AI对齐能否在不牺牲整体准确性的情况下减少这些差距。基于三届美国总统选举，我们比较一个闭源与一个开源LLM在选民人口统计特征上的表现，并测试面向更公平选民代表的AI对齐策略。从选民画像中移除性别可将模型的最大群体误差降低22-42%，移除教育可降低64%，而移除自我报告的种族会使平均群体误差增加超过40%，且均不降低准确性。常见的对齐策略，如重复查询或公平性指令，并不能减少这些误差，甚至可能使其翻倍。
translation.brief: 解决LLM模拟选民中的人口统计偏差导致代表不公平的问题，核心方法是在三届美国大选中评估不同选民画像特征与对齐策略对群体误差的影响。

papers.title: Every Edge Needs a Quote: Building a Quote-Grounded Knowledge Graph of Healthcare Software Adoption with Language-Model Agents
papers.abstract: Hospitals regularly buy software that clinicians and patients depend on. Because these purchases are costly, hard to reverse and can affect patient care, buyers look for evidence of which peer institutions already use a product and which systems it connects to. This evidence is public but scattered across vendor websites, press releases and third-party pages. Language-model agents can now collect it at low cost, but the correctness of the extracted claims is difficult to establish, and a wrongly listed customer can mislead buyers and misrepresent an organisation. We present a pipeline that builds a knowledge graph of customer and integration relations from the open web under one rule: every edge must be supported by a verbatim quote from its source page. Pages come from a deterministic crawl of each vendor's site and a budgeted ReAct agent that searches the rest of the web. A permissive extractor proposes relations with quotes, and a layered grounding stage decides which to keep, using a referent step that reads the whole page when a quote names only one side, deterministic checks, and a panel of five model calls voting on nine criteria. On 61 vendors, the pipeline reaches 0.94 precision and 0.71 recall against a page-level key covering the 6,428 candidate relations proposed by its extractor, whose verdicts were drafted by one model and re-checked with a second. Against the golden reference, the marketplace's own curated list, it scores lower, but 89% of the relations it keeps that the reference lacks are stated on a page. A confidence score built from the panel's votes keeps more correct relations than the fixed rule at the same precision, and reaches 0.90 precision at 0.90 recall. We also discuss how narrow, bounded model calls, string-matched evidence and voting address long-context degradation and run-to-run variance.

translation.title: 每条边都需要引文：用语言模型智能体构建以引文为依据的医疗软件采用知识图谱
translation.abstract: 医院经常购买临床医生和患者依赖的软件。由于这些采购成本高昂、难以逆转且可能影响患者护理，买方希望寻找哪些同行机构已使用某产品以及该系统与哪些系统连接的证据。这些证据是公开的，但分散在供应商网站、新闻稿和第三方页面中。语言模型智能体现在可以低成本收集这些信息，但提取声明的正确性难以确立，错误列出的客户会误导买方并歪曲一个组织。我们提出一个从开放网络构建客户与集成关系知识图谱的流水线，遵循一条规则：每条边必须由其来源页面的逐字引文支持。页面来自对每个供应商网站的确定性爬取和一个搜索网络其余部分的预算化 ReAct 智能体。宽松的提取器提出带引文的关系，分层接地阶段决定保留哪些，包括当引文仅提及一方时读取整页的指代步骤、确定性检查，以及由五次模型调用组成的、按九项标准投票的评审组。在61个供应商上，该流水线针对覆盖其提取器提出的6,428个候选关系的页面级基准达到0.94精确率和0.71召回率，其判定由一个模型起草并由第二个模型复核。相对于黄金参考（市场自身的精选列表），其得分较低，但它保留而参考缺失的关系中有89%确实在页面上有陈述。由评审组投票构建的置信度分数在相同精确率下比固定规则保留更多正确关系，并在0.90召回率下达到0.90精确率。我们还讨论了如何通过狭窄、有界的模型调用、字符串匹配证据和投票来应对长上下文退化和运行间方差。
translation.brief: 解决从开放网络提取医疗软件客户与集成关系时正确性难以验证的问题，核心方法是构建要求每条边都有逐字引文支持的知识图谱流水线，结合分层接地检查与多模型投票。

papers.title: SREdit: Scene Response Guided Appearance Editing for Projection Mapping
papers.abstract: Projection-based appearance editing changes selected visual attributes of a physical object through projection mapping (PM). To display a desired appearance, PM typically uses projector compensation, which computes a projector input that counteracts the geometric and photometric distortions of the scene. Compensation can only approximate this appearance within the available projection range, and it cannot revise the appearance itself. Pretrained LLM-based image editors provide a direct way to produce the desired appearance from a text prompt or reference image; projector compensation can then attempt to reproduce the edited result through projection. However, these editors do not have an accurate measure of the scene geometry or scene response. Therefore, their outputs may contain geometric misalignment, inconsistent shading, or changes outside the available projection range, which downstream projector compensation cannot correct. To address this problem, we introduce SREdit, an efficient response-guided framework for projection-based appearance editing. SREdit estimates a scene response map from the reconstructed scene that reflects how strongly projected illumination can affect different surface regions. SREdit uses the source appearance to constrain the early sampling process and preserve registration with the fixed physical object, while the scene response map adapts the amount of editing across surface regions. Experiments across two pretrained image editors show that SREdit improves projected appearance quality and reproduction fidelity. It adds less than one second per image with negligible VRAM overhead. Participants also consistently preferred the results produced with SREdit in our user study.

translation.title: SREdit：面向投影映射的场景响应引导外观编辑
translation.abstract: 基于投影的外观编辑通过投影映射（PM）改变物理对象的选定视觉属性。为显示期望的外观，PM 通常使用投影仪补偿，即计算一个抵消场景几何与光度畸变的投影仪输入。补偿只能在可用投影范围内近似该外观，且无法修改外观本身。预训练的基于 LLM 的图像编辑器提供了一种从文本提示或参考图像直接生成期望外观的方式；随后投影仪补偿可尝试通过投影复现编辑结果。然而，这些编辑器无法准确度量场景几何或场景响应，因此其输出可能包含几何错位、不一致的着色或超出可用投影范围的更改，而下游的投影仪补偿无法纠正这些问题。为解决该问题，我们提出 SREdit，一个高效的响应引导的基于投影的外观编辑框架。SREdit 从重建的场景中估计场景响应图，反映投影光照对不同表面区域的影响强度。SREdit 使用源外观约束早期采样过程以保持与固定物理对象的配准，同时场景响应图调节各表面区域的编辑量。在两个预训练图像编辑器上的实验表明，SREdit 提升了投影外观质量和复现保真度。它每张图像增加不到一秒的开销，VRAM 开销可忽略不计。用户研究中参与者也一致偏好 SREdit 生成的结果。
translation.brief: 解决LLM图像编辑器输出与投影映射场景不匹配导致投影复现失败的问题，核心方法是估计场景响应图来引导编辑强度并保持与物理对象的配准。

papers.title: Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond
papers.abstract: On-policy distillation aligns teacher feedback with a student's current behavior, yet acquiring useful supervision for multi-turn agents requires identifying both where guidance is needed and whether the student can sustain the interaction afterward. We introduce Frontier-OPD, which addresses this problem through the student's learning frontier: decision situations that remain challenging but admit useful autonomous continuation after brief teacher guidance. To operationalize this frontier, Frontier-OPD organizes on-policy experience into a shared-state trajectory graph, where trajectory-balanced aggregation of teacher-student disagreement identifies distinct intervention candidates while preserving the histories needed for replay. Short teacher bridges are then assessed by comparing agreement over the bridge and the ensuing student continuation with an equally long segment of the original trajectory, providing a behavioral proxy for guidance that the current student can build on. Accepted teacher responses augment ordinary distillation data, and fresh rollouts renew the frontier estimate as the policy changes. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld report higher mean autonomous performance than the compared distillation baselines across the evaluated student scales and teacher configurations, with ablations indicating complementary effects of candidate selection and guidance filtering. In one ALFWorld timing setting, the additional collection cost is offset by a shorter time to a target success rate.

translation.title: Frontier-OPD：发现智能体能力的边界并教会智能体超越它
translation.abstract: 在策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）将教师反馈与学生当前行为对齐，但为多轮智能体获取有用的监督信号需要同时确定哪里需要指导、以及学生之后能否维持交互。我们提出 Frontier-OPD，通过学生的学习前沿（learning frontier）来解决这一问题：即那些仍然具有挑战性、但在教师短暂指导后能够进行有用的自主延续的决策情境。为将该前沿可操作化，Frontier-OPD 将在策略经验组织为一个共享状态轨迹图，其中对师生分歧进行轨迹平衡的聚合，在保留回放所需历史的同时识别出不同的干预候选。随后通过比较桥接段及其后学生延续与原始轨迹中等长片段上的一致性来评估短教师桥接，为当前学生能够借力的指导提供行为代理。被接受的教师回复会扩充普通蒸馏数据，而新的 rollout 会在策略变化时更新前沿估计。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上的实验表明，在所评估的学生规模和教师配置下，其平均自主性能高于对比的蒸馏基线；消融实验显示候选选择与指导过滤具有互补效果。在 ALFWorld 的一个计时设置中，额外的采集成本被更短的达到目标成功率所需时间所抵消。
translation.brief: 解决多轮智能体在策略蒸馏中难以确定何时何地需要教师指导的问题，核心方法是通过学生学习前沿识别干预候选并用一致性比较过滤短教师桥接。

papers.title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
papers.abstract: Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action. We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency through guarded decision reuse and recursive self-improvement (RSI). RSI iteratively refines companion harness configurations from training feedback, with validation selecting the configuration for deployment. A controller at the model-tool boundary reuses resolved decisions to replace later reasoning callbacks while actor weights remain fixed. Executable Decision Graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, causal dependencies, and public guards. Guarded Decision Reuse activates these persistent decisions from observed receipts; Certified Callback Substitution executes them through the native interface and records removal of the registered slow callback. New semantic decisions, unsupported evidence, and selector abstention invoke the original actor again. The representation restricts what feedback may change, while complete-task measurements establish quality and cost. On HumanEval, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82\% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02 (29.54\% saving). For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43\% to 85.71\% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62 (87.93\% saving). A separate MBPP ablation measures 26.91\% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52\% lower cost than retained callbacks. These results establish guarded decision reuse as a practical way to reduce repeated reasoning in existing harnesses.

translation.title: HarnessMM：面向 Harness Token 效率的递归自我改进
translation.abstract: 智能体 harness 在收到工具反馈后会反复调用推理，即使更早的调用已经确定了下一步动作。我们提出 HarnessMM（Harness Minus Minus），一种通过受保护决策复用（guarded decision reuse）和递归自我改进（RSI）来提升 harness token 效率的方法。RSI 从训练反馈中迭代精炼配套的 harness 配置，并通过验证选择部署配置。位于模型-工具边界的控制器复用已解析的决策来替代后续的推理回调，同时 actor 权重保持不变。可执行决策图（Executable Decision Graphs）存储精确动作、字面参数、因果依赖和公开守卫。受保护决策复用从观测到的回执激活这些持久决策；认证回调替换（Certified Callback Substitution）通过原生接口执行它们并记录已移除注册的慢回调。新的语义决策、不受支持的证据和选择器弃权会再次调用原始 actor。该表示限制了反馈可以改变的内容，而完整任务测量确立了质量与成本。在 HumanEval 上，HarnessMM 保持 Codex 成功率为 90.82%，同时将 Tokens/task (k) 从 66.72 降至 47.02（节省 29.54%）。对于 DeepSeek Harness，成功率从 71.43% 升至 85.71%，Tokens/task (k) 从 96.28 降至 11.62（节省 87.93%）。一项独立的 MBPP 消融测得其成本比单次使用图低 26.91%，比保留回调低 19.52%。这些结果确立了受保护决策复用是减少现有 harness 中重复推理的实用途径。
translation.brief: 解决智能体 harness 在工具反馈后重复调用推理造成 token 浪费的问题，核心方法是用可执行决策图进行受保护决策复用并结合递归自我改进精炼 harness 配置。

papers.title: Reimagining Enterprise RAG for Multi-Agent Systems: A Knowledge Layer That Organizes Before It Retrieves
papers.abstract: Enterprises are deploying agentic AI across the software development lifecycle, and they need the behavioral logic of the systems they act on, not stakeholder documentation. A seven-agent reverse-engineering pipeline recovered this logic, processing 241 repositories across 18 services into thousands of artifacts describing scope, journeys, rules and acceptance criteria. Recovery does not confer usability. Entities like offer, eligibility, and activation recur across services under a shared vocabulary, related in name but operationally distinct, so one end-to-end journey implicates over a thousand near-identical rules that must not be conflated. Flat vector retrieval fails, returning an identical rule from the wrong service at high similarity with no signal of error. Content-level ontology, the traditional remedy, did not exist, and relating every occurrence of recurring entities would have cost more than the engagement and not survived a release cycle. We place the ontology at the artifact level. In this machine-generated corpus, each artifact retains its producer, component, service, domain and type, provenance that disambiguates before content is read. We present a knowledge layer that organizes before retrieving: a self-describing catalog, a sparse metadata registry, and a navigation hypergraph defined over artifacts rather than extracted entities. Queries resolve to artifact identifiers that constrain vector search, so the competing rule from another service is absent rather than outranked, making disambiguation structural, not statistical. Built in under a week and admitting new services by convention, the layer serves SDLC agents, developers, quality engineers and analysts. It supported root-cause analysis and resolution of 100+ production defects with developer verification and attributed 35 release regression failures to specific rules and services.

translation.title: 面向多智能体系统的企业 RAG 重构：先组织后检索的知识层
translation.abstract: 企业正在软件开发生命周期中部署智能体 AI，它们需要所作用系统的行为逻辑，而非利益相关者文档。一个七智能体逆向工程流水线恢复了这一逻辑，将跨 18 个服务的 241 个代码仓库处理成数千个描述范围、旅程、规则和验收标准的制品。恢复并不等于可用性。像 offer、eligibility 和 activation 这类实体在共享词汇下跨服务重复出现，名称相关但操作上各不相同，因此一个端到端旅程会牵涉上千条近似的、绝不可混淆的规则。扁平向量检索会失败——以高相似度返回来自错误服务的相同规则且没有错误信号。传统补救手段的内容级本体并不存在，而关联每个重复实体的出现其成本会超过整个项目，且无法在一个发布周期中存活。我们将本体放在制品（artifact）层面。在这个机器生成的语料库中，每个制品保留其生产者、组件、服务、领域和类型——这种来源信息在读取内容之前就完成消歧。我们提出一个先组织后检索的知识层：一个自描述目录、一个稀疏元数据注册表，以及定义在制品而非抽取实体之上的导航超图。查询解析为约束向量搜索的制品标识符，因此来自其他服务的竞争规则是不存在而非排序靠后，使消歧成为结构性的而非统计性的。该层在一周内建成，并可通过约定接纳新服务，服务于 SDLC 智能体、开发者、质量工程师和分析师。它在开发者验证下支持了 100 多个生产缺陷的根因分析与解决，并将 35 个发布回归失败归因到具体规则和服务。
translation.brief: 解决企业多智能体系统中向量检索无法区分跨服务近似规则的问题，核心方法是在制品级构建自描述目录、稀疏元数据注册表和导航超图，实现先组织后检索的结构化消歧。

papers.title: Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
papers.abstract: Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA, extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025), an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the $k$ largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. We demonstrate this sparse LoRA adapter in a sleeper-agent backdoor case study where we create model organisms by fine-tuning gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Qwen2.5-7B on a poisoned instruction-following dataset. For each organism, we identify and ablate a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the backdoor. Furthermore, our new fine-tuning method produces sparse circuits that are up to an order of magnitude smaller than a dense LoRA baseline, allowing surgical ablation of the malicious capability without sacrificing instruction-following performance. Finally, we propose a technique to construct model organisms with localised circuits using TopKLoRA latents and gradient-routing, which we use to validate the findings of our circuit search algorithm. We consider these findings as a step toward interpretable-by-design architectures that provide faithful units of analysis without compromising model performance. We share our code: https://github.com/interpretable-finetuning/TopKLoRA.

translation.title: 基于 TopKLoRA 的可解释稀疏微调实现忠实的电路发现
translation.abstract: 在来源未知的数据集上微调可能在训练出的模型中制造后门，当数据包含被投毒的样本时。后门难以定位和移除，并可能在安全训练后持续存在。虽然参数高效微调方法捕获训练期间引入的全部参数变化，但它们不易解释。我们给出 TopKLoRA 的完整方法，扩展了 Masiak et al. (2025) 的初步提议——一种设计上可解释的 LoRA 变体，其中每个 token 只有 $k$ 个最大的 adapter 潜变量处于激活状态。与 SAE 不同，TopKLoRA 纯粹以下游损失训练，优化压力促使学习功能性因果的潜变量。我们在一个 sleeper-agent 后门案例研究中展示这种稀疏 LoRA adapter，通过在投毒的指令遵循数据集上微调 gemma-2-2b、Qwen2.5-1.5B 和 Qwen2.5-7B 来创建模型生物（model organisms）。对于每个生物体，我们识别并消融了实现该后门既必要又充分的电路。此外，我们的新微调方法产生的稀疏电路比稠密 LoRA 基线小最多一个数量级，允许在不牺牲指令遵循性能的情况下对恶意能力进行外科手术式消融。最后，我们提出一种使用 TopKLoRA 潜变量和 gradient-routing 构建具有局部化电路的模型生物的技术，用于验证电路搜索算法的发现。我们将这些发现视为迈向设计上可解释架构的一步，这类架构在不损害模型性能的前提下提供忠实的分析单元。代码分享：https://github.com/interpretable-finetuning/TopKLoRA。
translation.brief: 解决微调后门难以定位与移除的问题，核心方法是提出 TopKLoRA——每 token 仅激活 k 个最大潜变量的稀疏 LoRA，从而发现并外科手术式消融后门电路。

papers.title: From Deliberately Constructed Systemic Representations of the World of Activity to Dialogue: A Five-Level Communication Architecture for Strong Language-Based ASI
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a five-level organization of message formation and understanding within thinking and activity in which ASI participates. Its central thesis is that a language model's context is fundamentally incapable of presenting the foundations of utterance formation for examination and verification. These foundations are established in advance by acquired schemas, systemic representations of the world of activity, and connections accepted as true within them. Neither context nor trained LLM weights, in themselves, attest to the presence of deliberately constructed systemic representations. The five levels distinguish systemic representations of the world of activity, a particular situation cut out from those representations, its narrative description, the full sense of a message, and text. A situation's schema-model is not identical to a story about it. A recipient reconstructs the full sense from an abbreviated text through jointly constructed and agreed-upon representations and joint activity. Reverse work proceeds from the full sense through an extended description and the situation's schema-model to the reconstruction of systemic foundations. The theoretical foundations draw on the systems methodology of G. P. Shchedrovitskiy, the structural differential of A. Korzybski, and the Meaning-Text theory of I. A. Mel'chuk. The contribution is a specific systemic-activity organization of content for examining and adjusting message foundations and controlling the consequences of their transformation. Further research concerns large graphical models of activity on reconstructible systemic foundations, distinct from text generation from context.

translation.title: 从刻意构建的活动世界系统表征到对话：面向强语言型 ASI 的五层通信架构
translation.abstract: 本文提出 ASI 参与的思维与活动中消息形成与理解的五层组织。其核心论点是：语言模型的上下文从根本上无法呈现话语形成的基础以供检验和验证。这些基础由习得的图式、活动世界的系统表征以及其中被接受为真的联系预先建立。上下文与训练出的 LLM 权重本身都不能证明存在刻意构建的系统表征。五个层次区分了活动世界的系统表征、从这些表征中切出的特定情境、其叙事描述、消息的完整意义以及文本。情境的图式模型不等同于关于它的故事。接收者通过共同构建和商定的表征与共同活动，从缩略文本中重构完整意义。反向工作从完整意义出发，经扩展描述和情境的图式模型，重构系统性基础。理论基础借鉴 G. P. Shchedrovitskiy 的系统方法论、A. Korzybski 的结构微分和 I. A. Mel'chuk 的意义-文本理论。其贡献是一种具体的系统-活动内容组织，用于检验和调整消息基础并控制其转换的后果。后续研究涉及在可重构系统基础上的大型活动图形模型，不同于从上下文生成文本。
translation.brief: 解决语言模型上下文无法呈现话语形成基础以供检验的问题，核心方法是提出基于活动世界系统表征的五层消息形成与理解通信架构。

papers.title: J-Comm: Jacobian-Guided Latent Communication between LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Latent communication requires both an effective continuous reasoning process and an interface through which an external model can leverage its intermediate computation. We present J-Comm, a framework comprising two core components. First, a training-free Geometric Agreement for Latent Reasoning (GEAR) reweights token candidates over existing model embeddings, which monotonically optimizes geometric consensus among candidate tokens in embedding space at each step. Second, we introduce an H+J (Hidden-and-Jacobian) communication interface that gives the Receiver two complementary views of the Sender's reasoning. The H channel supplies continuous inputs derived from feedback distributions, while the J channel conveys intermediate-state cues in vocabulary-indexed Jacobian-lens coordinates. Intuitively, H provides inputs for the Receiver to reason from, while J offers additional guidance within its computation. The Receiver reconstructs these cues using its own dictionary and injects them into intermediate layers during prefill, enabling communication without sharing key-value caches or requiring identical model widths. In Qwen3-8B to Qwen3-4B communication, J-Comm achieves the highest mean score across seven benchmarks, including 94.80% on MATH500, 54.55% on GPQA-Diamond, 73.33% on AIME2024+2025, and 62.93% success on ALFWorld. Compared with TextMAS, it improves performance by 1.29-8.59 percentage points and reduces generated text tokens by 19.2-74.8%.

translation.title: J-Comm：基于Jacobian引导的LLM智能体间潜在通信
translation.abstract: 潜在通信既需要有效的连续推理过程，也需要一个能让外部模型利用其中间计算的接口。我们提出J-Comm框架，包含两个核心组件。首先，免训练的Geometric Agreement for Latent Reasoning（GEAR）在现有模型嵌入之上对候选token进行重加权，在每一步中单调地优化嵌入空间中候选token之间的几何一致性。其次，我们引入H+J（Hidden-and-Jacobian）通信接口，为接收方提供发送方推理的两个互补视图。H通道提供源自反馈分布的连续输入，而J通道在以词表索引的Jacobian-lens坐标中传递中间状态线索。直观地说，H为接收方提供推理所需的输入，而J在其计算过程中提供额外引导。接收方使用自己的字典重建这些线索，并在prefill阶段将其注入中间层，从而无需共享key-value缓存或要求模型宽度相同即可实现通信。在Qwen3-8B到Qwen3-4B的通信中，J-Comm在七个基准上取得最高平均分，包括MATH500上的94.80%、GPQA-Diamond上的54.55%、AIME2024+2025上的73.33%以及ALFWorld上62.93%的成功率。与TextMAS相比，其性能提升1.29-8.59个百分点，生成文本token减少19.2-74.8%。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体间潜在通信问题，方法是将嵌入空间几何一致性重加权（GEAR）与Hidden-and-Jacobian双通道通信接口相结合。

papers.title: Do "True" and "False" Add Up to One? Complement Consistency in LLM-Agent Opinion Simulations
papers.abstract: In LLM-agent opinion simulations, each agent reports the probability that a claim is true after seeing its own previous probability and the probabilities reported by its neighbors, and that number becomes its state in the next round. If the number describes the agent's position rather than the sentence it was shown, then rewriting the claim as its complement and replacing every probability p with 1 - p should return the complementary answer, so the two reports should sum to one. We test this with three small open models: Qwen3-4B, Llama-3.2-3B and Gemma-3-4B. On 2,304 agent states taken from a running network simulation, Qwen's paired reports sum to 1.18 on average, and on 48 real fact-checking claims from AVeriTeC they again exceed one. A controlled benchmark of 24 worlds, each with exactly two possible outcomes, shows the same failure in all three models. The discrepancy is two to ten times larger than the change produced by a same-meaning paraphrase, and it persists under repeated sampling and across peer group sizes and report strengths. When the reports are fed back into two populations that start from complementary states, the populations do not remain mirror images: their divergence is positive after five rounds for every model. Averaging each answer with the complement of its paired answer restores consistency by construction and lowers Brier loss averaged over the two wordings, but at the final round it beats the better of the two original wordings for only one of the three models. A schedule-by-targeting experiment on the same model gives a small, stable interaction because such sweeps keep the claim wording fixed. Consistency under rewording therefore needs its own test before simulated probabilities are read as beliefs

translation.title: “真”与“假”加起来等于一吗？LLM智能体观点模拟中的互补一致性
translation.abstract: 在LLM智能体观点模拟中，每个智能体在看到自己先前的概率和邻居报告的概率后，报告某个断言为真的概率，该数字成为其下一轮的状态。如果该数字描述的是智能体的立场而非其看到的句子，那么将断言改写为其补集并将每个概率p替换为1-p，应返回互补的答案，即两次报告之和应为一。我们用三个小型开源模型进行测试：Qwen3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B和Gemma-3-4B。在取自运行中网络模拟的2,304个智能体状态上，Qwen的成对报告平均和为1.18，在AVeriTeC的48条真实事实核查断言上同样超过一。一个包含24个世界（每个世界恰好有两种可能结果）的受控基准显示三个模型都存在同样的失败。该偏差是同义改写所产生变化的两到十倍，并且在重复采样、不同同伴群体规模和报告强度下持续存在。当报告被反馈回两个从互补状态出发的群体时，两个群体不再保持镜像关系：每个模型在五轮后的分歧均为正。将每个答案与其配对答案的补集取平均在构造上恢复了一致性，并降低了两种措辞下的平均Brier损失，但在最后一轮，三个模型中只有一个优于两种原始措辞中较好的那个。在同一模型上的调度-目标实验给出了小而稳定的交互，因为此类扫描保持断言措辞不变。因此，在将模拟概率解读为信念之前，需要先对措辞改写下的一致性进行独立测试。
translation.brief: 解决LLM智能体观点模拟中概率在断言补集改写下不满足互补一致性的问题，方法是通过改写实验和受控基准系统测量该失效现象。

papers.title: Trusting the Tool: Asymmetric Deference of LLM Vulnerability Auditors to Static-Analysis Evidence
papers.abstract: Pipelines that combine large language models (LLMs) with static analysis let the model consume the analyser's output as evidence, but whether the model distinguishes true from false evidence, and whether its scrutiny depends on what the evidence claims, has not been measured. We built an intraprocedural analyser for C/C++ that produces proof obligations and audited vulnerable and patched functions from PrimeVul under six evidence conditions that differ only in the notes, including fabricated assurances that a missing check exists and fabricated alarms that an added check is missing. The study covers 916 pairs in four disjoint sets, eleven model configurations from four vendors and 16,572 audits; no model is trained or fine-tuned. True evidence barely improved accuracy (+0.02). False evidence acted asymmetrically: relative to true notes about the same operations, false assurances lowered the detection of real vulnerabilities by up to 19 points, whereas false alarms never significantly lowered accuracy and were disputed far more often. An internally registered replication on seven new models confirmed that false assurances move verdicts towards their claim more than false alarms do (mean asymmetry +0.16, 95% CI +0.10 to +0.24). Instructions in the audit prompt did not reliably reduce deference; the best one failed to replicate. Verifying each claim in a separate call and showing the refuted claims raised accuracy under false assurances by 12 points in a pre-specified test (p=0.002) without loss under true evidence; for a second model the gain was smaller and not significant. Pipelines should therefore verify a tool's guarantees before the model relies on them, and studies should measure deference in a direction-aware way.

translation.title: 信任工具：LLM漏洞审计者对静态分析证据的不对称遵从
translation.abstract: 将大语言模型（LLM）与静态分析相结合的流水线让模型将分析器的输出作为证据消费，但模型是否能区分真假证据，以及其审查是否取决于证据所声称的内容，尚未被测量。我们构建了一个针对C/C++的过程内分析器，生成证明义务，并在六种仅注释不同的证据条件下审计PrimeVul中的易受攻击函数和已修补函数，包括捏造的“缺失检查存在”的保证和捏造的“新增检查缺失”的警报。该研究涵盖四个不相交集合中的916对、来自四家厂商的十一种模型配置和16,572次审计；没有任何模型被训练或微调。真实证据几乎没有提升准确率（+0.02）。虚假证据表现出不对称性：相对于关于相同操作的真实注释，虚假保证使真实漏洞的检测率最多下降19个百分点，而虚假警报从未显著降低准确率，且被质疑的频率高得多。在七个新模型上进行的内部注册复制证实，虚假保证比虚假警报更能使判定朝其声称的方向移动（平均不对称性+0.16，95% CI +0.10至+0.24）。审计提示中的指令未能可靠地降低遵从度；最佳的一条未能复制。在单独调用中验证每条声明并展示被反驳的声明，在预先设定的测试中将虚假保证下的准确率提高12个百分点（p=0.002），且在真实证据下无损失；对第二个模型，增益较小且不显著。因此，流水线应在模型依赖工具的保证之前先对其进行验证，而研究应以方向感知的方式测量遵从度。
translation.brief: 解决LLM漏洞审计中模型过度信任静态分析证据的问题，方法是通过受控实验测量真假证据（保证与警报）对审计判定的不对称影响并测试缓解策略。

papers.title: Advancing SVD-based LLM Compression via Layer-Wise Error Model Search
papers.abstract: Low-rank SVD-based compression offers a powerful strategy to reduce the computational costs of LLMs. However, existing methods face two key limitations: (i) global rank allocation, where uncalibrated error proxies fail to capture complex error propagation, and (ii) decomposition quality, where Fisher-based estimators suffer from severe rank collapse. In this work, we address these limitations by introducing Layer-wise Error Modeling Search (LEMS) and KFAC-SVD. LEMS advances rank allocation by introducing a layer-wise error surrogate that integrates local and global layer importance alongside a propagation bias, enabling effective global rank allocation via an ILP formulation. KFAC-SVD improves decomposition quality by utilizing token-wise statistics, mitigating the rank deficiency observed in prior Fisher-based SVD approaches. Across Mistral, Qwen3, and Llama 3 model families, we show that LEMS consistently outperforms existing search strategies, delivering significant zero-shot accuracy gains of up to 4.8 p.p. that generalize to model sizes of 70B parameters, while KFAC-SVD achieves an average perplexity improvement of 15%. Project page and code: https://lems-svd.github.io

translation.title: 通过逐层误差模型搜索推进基于SVD的LLM压缩
translation.abstract: 基于低秩SVD的压缩是降低LLM计算成本的强大策略。然而，现有方法面临两个关键局限：（i）全局秩分配，未经校准的误差代理无法捕捉复杂的误差传播；（ii）分解质量，基于Fisher的估计器存在严重的秩坍缩。在本工作中，我们通过引入逐层误差建模搜索（LEMS）和KFAC-SVD来解决这些局限。LEMS通过引入一个整合局部与全局层重要性以及传播偏差的逐层误差代理来推进秩分配，从而通过ILP公式实现有效的全局秩分配。KFAC-SVD通过利用token级统计来提升分解质量，缓解了先前基于Fisher的SVD方法中观察到的秩不足问题。在Mistral、Qwen3和Llama 3模型家族上，我们表明LEMS持续优于现有搜索策略，带来高达4.8个百分点的显著零样本准确率提升，并可推广至70B参数规模的模型，而KFAC-SVD实现了平均15%的困惑度改进。项目页面与代码：https://lems-svd.github.io
translation.brief: 解决SVD压缩中全局秩分配不准和Fisher分解秩坍缩的问题，方法是引入逐层误差代理的ILP搜索（LEMS）和基于token级统计的KFAC-SVD。

papers.title: When Should I Trust This? Designing and Evaluating Factuality Indicators for LLM-based Chatbots
papers.abstract: Generative AI systems increasingly mediate how people seek information, yet communicating AI factuality to laypeople remains challenging. Through a mixed-methods investigation involving interviews (N=8), a survey (N=1,000), and an experiment (N=5,151), we examine how people evaluate AI-generated information for gardening, mathematical, and medical queries, and how factuality indicators (confidence and sources) shape perceptions. Our interviews and survey show people selectively verify AI responses using external and AI-provided evidence, moderated by contextual factors. Although confidence-indicators affected trust and accuracy perceptions, people hold diverse, ambiguous interpretations of AI confidence. Sources were viewed as crucial, yet users raised concerns about source reliability and verification effort. Our experiment showed that confidence and source-based indicators influenced initial perceptions, but effects disappeared once participants learned the response's correctness. Medical queries elicited skepticism regardless of indicator. Findings motivate helping users interpret model confidence and integrating source information into the interface to support calibrated trust in AI-supported information-seeking.

translation.title: 何时该信任它？面向基于LLM的聊天机器人的事实性指标设计与评估
translation.abstract: 生成式AI系统日益成为人们获取信息的媒介，但向普通用户传达AI事实性仍然具有挑战性。通过一项混合方法研究，包括访谈（N=8）、调查（N=1,000）和实验（N=5,151），我们考察人们如何评估AI生成的园艺、数学和医疗查询信息，以及事实性指标（置信度和来源）如何塑造感知。我们的访谈和调查显示，人们会借助外部证据和AI提供的证据有选择地验证AI回复，并受情境因素调节。尽管置信度指标影响了信任和准确性感知，但人们对AI置信度持有多样且模糊的解读。来源被视为至关重要，但用户对来源可靠性和验证成本表示担忧。我们的实验表明，置信度和基于来源的指标影响了初始感知，但一旦参与者得知回复的正确性，这些效应便消失。无论何种指标，医疗查询都引发了怀疑。研究结果启发我们帮助用户解读模型置信度，并将来源信息整合到界面中，以支持对AI辅助信息获取的校准信任。
translation.brief: 解决如何向普通用户传达LLM事实性的问题，方法是通过访谈、调查和大规模实验评估置信度与来源指标对用户信任感知的影响。

papers.title: Green Code or Costly Code? Evaluating the Energy Costs of Iterative LLM-Based Code Optimizations
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to optimize code for performance. This practice often assumes that improvements in execution speed naturally translate into overall lower energy consumption. We challenge this assumption empirically by measuring whether performance-optimized code produced by LLM self-refinement pipelines is also energy-efficient relative to canonical human reference solutions, and whether the energy cost of the optimization process can be offset by subsequent execution-time savings. We evaluate 11 open-source models across four decoding configurations on all 1,000 problems of EffiBench, a state-of-the-art performance benchmark, while collecting per-process, hardware-level energy measurements throughout. Inference energy spans 0.79 to 8.68 MJ across model-variant pairs, which is roughly equivalent to the energy of 250 to 2800 GPT-4.1 queries. Limiting the maximum number of output tokens has the largest impact, reducing energy use by up to 69% compared to the default configuration. On the execution side, 42 of 44 configurations produce code that consumes more energy per problem than the canonical human reference, with overheads ranging from +4% to +886%. The two exceptions achieve only marginal gains, with break-even points on the order of 10^6 to 10^7 executions. Mixture-of-Experts architectures consume substantially less inference energy than equivalently-sized dense models without sacrificing correctness, making architectural choice a more consequential sustainability lever than decoding parameters. Performance optimization and energy efficiency are not always aligned goals: LLM self-refinement consistently produces faster-seeking but energy-heavier code relative to what a human engineer would write. All artifacts are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23598170.

translation.title: 绿色代码还是昂贵代码？评估基于 LLM 的迭代式代码优化的能耗成本
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于优化代码性能。这种做法通常假设执行速度的提升自然会转化为更低的整体能耗。我们通过实证测量挑战了这一假设：考察 LLM 自我精炼流水线生成的性能优化代码相对于规范的人类参考解是否也节能，以及优化过程本身的能耗能否被后续执行时间的节省所抵消。我们在性能基准 EffiBench 的全部 1,000 个问题上评估了 11 个开源模型在四种解码配置下的表现，并全程收集进程级、硬件级能耗测量。推理能耗在模型-变体组合间跨度为 0.79 至 8.68 MJ，大致相当于 250 至 2800 次 GPT-4.1 查询的能耗。限制最大输出 token 数影响最大，相比默认配置最多可减少 69% 的能耗。在执行侧，44 个配置中有 42 个生成的代码每个问题的能耗高于规范的人类参考解，开销从 +4% 到 +886% 不等。两个例外仅取得边际收益，其盈亏平衡点在 10^6 到 10^7 次执行量级。混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）架构在不牺牲正确性的情况下，推理能耗显著低于同等规模的稠密模型，使架构选择成为比解码参数更具影响力的可持续性杠杆。性能优化与能效并非总是一致的目标：相对于人类工程师所写的代码，LLM 自我精炼持续产出追求更快但能耗更高的代码。所有产物可在 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23598170 获取。
translation.brief: 该论文验证 LLM 代码优化是否真正节能，通过在 EffiBench 上对 11 个模型进行硬件级能耗测量，发现 LLM 生成的代码通常比人类参考解更耗能。

papers.title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models often uses separate systems for inference and training. Even with identical weights and BF16 tensors, implementation differences can make an intended on-policy update off-policy and destabilize training. Existing remedies align the entire inference and training stacks, change global precision, or modify the learning algorithm. We ask whether aligning selected parts of the execution stack can stabilize BF16 RL while other implementation differences remain. We align training-side rounding locations with inference in three regions---RoPE, SwiGLU, and residual RMSNorm---by retaining selected intermediates in FP32 until their BF16 outputs. Across four Qwen-family models, aligning all three regions prevents the collapse observed under the default BF16 baseline; RoPE-path alignment alone also suffices in the studied runs, despite remaining numerical discrepancies. The interventions keep the inference engine, matrix-multiplication and attention kernels, and learning objective unchanged.

translation.title: 舍入发生的位置很重要：舍入位置对齐可稳定 LLM 强化学习
translation.abstract: 大语言模型的强化学习通常使用独立的推理和训练系统。即使权重和 BF16 张量完全相同，实现上的差异也可能使预期的 on-policy 更新变为 off-policy，从而破坏训练稳定性。现有补救措施要么对齐整个推理与训练栈，要么改变全局精度，要么修改学习算法。我们探究是否只需对齐执行栈中的选定部分，就能在保留其他实现差异的情况下稳定 BF16 强化学习。我们在三个区域——RoPE、SwiGLU 和残差 RMSNorm——中通过将选定的中间量以 FP32 保留直至其 BF16 输出，使训练侧的舍入位置与推理对齐。在四个 Qwen 系列模型上，对齐全部三个区域可防止默认 BF16 基线下观察到的训练崩溃；在所研究的运行中，仅对齐 RoPE 路径也足以奏效，尽管仍存在数值差异。这些干预保持推理引擎、矩阵乘法与注意力核以及学习目标不变。
translation.brief: 该论文解决推理与训练系统实现差异导致的 RL 训练不稳定问题，核心方法是在 RoPE、SwiGLU 和 RMSNorm 区域对齐训练侧与推理侧的舍入位置。

papers.title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox
papers.abstract: Personal email agents decide, for every message, what it is, whether it is urgent, whether to draft a reply, create a task, or ignore it. Their error rate is rarely measured: the stored labels were written by the system itself. We present Foyer, a self-hosted personal inbox agent in daily use, and a measurement protocol (stratified sampling, frozen snapshots, thread-grouped splits, pre-registered hypotheses, human labels in the agent's review loop) that yields ground truth before any training. On 739 real Italian/English emails labelled by the owner (231 unbiased, 500 adversarially sampled), we compare nine systems under thread-grouped cross-validation: the production keyword rules, a TF-IDF + logistic-regression baseline, local typed decision models (Tev1, Nimble), a hosted decision model (Nimble v4-max), and hosted generative LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma 4 26B/31B). Four results. The production rules score 28% on message type against a 58% majority class: the field shown most prominently carried no information. With ~200 labels, logistic regression has the highest accuracy on every field (type 0.79, urgency 0.74, needs-reply 0.83, is-noise 0.90), though it never predicts the two rarest classes and is statistically tied with Gemma 4 on type; few-shot prompting does not close the gap. The sender's relationship (client, supplier, service) is recovered from other emails of the same contact with 98.6% accuracy where the contact has been seen, and is not inferable from a single message by any model: it belongs in the contact graph, not the prompt. Finally, accuracy is not the product metric: composed into actions, the most accurate system most often ignores emails needing action (18% vs 4% for the best LLM); a cost-chosen threshold on its noise probability halves that rate and makes it the cheapest system.

translation.title: 训练之前先测量：类型化决策模型、经典基线与生成式 LLM 在个人多语言收件箱路由中的对比
